overview: A local football team defines what it takes to win. Through their ups and downs they train through the tension leading up to the most important game in the season.

title: Shumei: The Living Legacy of Kabuki
overview: A look at the succession ceremony in which Ichikawa Danjūrō XIII formally inherited the storied Danjūrō name in Kabuki, Japan’s classical performing art. The film records the behind-the-scenes preparations for the actor’s name-inheritance debut performance.

title: The Intro
overview: This film chronicles the beginning of R&B/Pop icon Zaire Bloomfield's music career through the music videos leading up to the release of his first album

title: Resan till Piemonte
overview: The film follows four newly retired people who travel to Italy to help Eva sell an olive farm she inherited. But during their sunny stay, new thoughts arise about life, freedom and the dreams they have yet to realize. The trip becomes a chance to reevaluate what really matters when you reach the second half of life.

title: Showstopper
overview: A young woman is trapped in the clutches of a musical-obssesed serial killer, having to perform for her life to free herself from the perfection she is expected to achieve.

title: ee
overview: When a young girl attempts to shoplift an old blind box figure from a collectibles store, the shopkeeper’s seductive wife takes an interest in her.

title: A PINT OF BITTER.
overview: You are trying to enjoy a quiet pint in the pub but a patron and his son seemingly have a problem with your demeanour ...

title: Knowing Gaze
overview: Knowing Gaze is a loving roast of gay culture. This animated short moves fluidly through a series of interconnected vignettes—from online personas to offline hookups, from the thrift store to the dance floor to the bathhouse.  Rendered in expressive brush strokes, the story unfolds as candid conversations carried by acidic dialogue and vulnerable interior monologues. At its core, the film probes the tenderness and tension of modern gay identity. Beneath a million witty one-liners, the soul cries out.

title: Shadows of Beirut
overview: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

title: No Limbs No Limits
overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

title: Beasts Clutching at Straws
overview: After stumbling upon 100m yen at work, Kanji finds himself involved in a battle royal for the money. Based on the novel by Keisuke Sone

title: Days Yet Unknown
overview: A road movie in reverse across Europe: Jola Wieczorek traces her family’s past from Poland to the idyllic Salzkammergut. The documentary The Days Yet Unknown is a moving portrait of origin, displacement, and the question of what home truly means.

title: Dorothy
overview: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

title: Hunter
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Pauline Julien: Woman of the Country
overview: The story of Pauline Julien, a singing icon and independence activist, across several decades of Québec history.

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: The Lost Children of Tuam
overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
overview: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

title: Charlie Harper
overview: The journey of a young woman, Harper, and a young man, Charlie, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

title: We Are Metal Dragon
overview: A rock band in the 80s made a promise to never give up on their dream of becoming the next Iron Maiden. Forty years later, they're still rehearsing in the same garage - and realize that dream will never come true. They decide to go out on one final tour... where everything goes hilariously wrong.

title: The Stunt Driver
overview: Based on the true story of Montrealer Ken Carter, the “Mad Canadian” stunt driver who tried to jump the Saint Lawrence River in a rocket car in the mid-’70s. Carter's dream was to end his 30-year career with a big jump, a big paycheck, and mega stardom. In the process of accomplishing it, he hired a big sports manager and enlisted the best in rocket car design, with the National Film Board of Canada filming a documentary leading up to the event.

title: Numb
overview: A boy who no longer speaks, shaped by a tyrannical father and a mother he both resents and loves, grows up on Japan's northern coast. With nowhere to belong, he returns to seek his father and sets his fate in motion.

title: This is a Genocide
overview: A child explains what a genocide is.

title: How To Walk, A Guide For Fun and Profit
original_title: How To Walk, A Guide For Fun and Profit
overview: A depiction of societal collapse in the form of an animated walk cycle.

title: Fit Check
overview: A man sees a mannequin dressed exactly like him.

title: Roll Over and Play Dead
overview: I don't know much about truth but I do know how to obey. And that's what I love to do; kiss ass, roll over, play dead.

title: XYZ
overview: A man cannot figure out why everyone is staring at him...

title: Ibadah & Cinta
overview: Rico, a young man raised in Melbourne, and Santun, the pious daughter of a respected Islamic boarding school leader (Kiai Umar), fall deeply in love despite coming from different worlds. Through Santun, Rico learns to appreciate religious values, and they both view their relationship as a form of worship. However, their romance faces a major obstacle: Santun's father has already betrothed her to Ustad Salman, the man her parents chose for her.

title: Ibu, Bagaimana Aku Tanpamu?
overview: Plot under wraps. Based on a book with the same title.

title: 7 Қарақшы
overview: No description

title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
original_title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
overview: Upcoming TV special.

title: Street Race
overview: A meatheaded man is stopped next to an innocent baby in a stroller who accidentally intimidates him into a street race.

title: (in)significant
overview: Through contemplation of our place within the universe, (in)significant is a mixed-media film that finds beauty in simple moments, anchored in the warmth of the sun on a nostalgic summer day.

title: 1 ROOM
overview: An animated documentary shedding light on the daily struggles of individuals living in poverty as they fight to provide for their families and preserve a sense of dignity and joy.

title: Expo Inferno
overview: In 2067, the Canadian government resurrects Expo 67 using advanced projection technology. As a woman searches for the ghost of her grandfather, the exhibition catches fire.

title: Doomsday Radio
overview: On April 15, 2025, a forgotten Soviet "Doomsday" radio suddenly comes to life, broadcasting encrypted messages. An abstract animated film about echoes from the past disrupting the present.

title: Mortal Lace
overview: Mortal Lace depicts existence as a conscious hallucination created by our own experience of life. This is explored through the context of a week where each day progress closer to absolute reality.

title: The Maggots
overview: Yinfeng’s abusive father is seriously ill when she is far away from home. What will she do about this blood relationship that has caused her so much pain?

title: Because, I Am a Girl
overview: Through personal reflections, Kyrgyz girls speak about everyday expectations and social roles they grow up with.

title: Crocodile Tears
overview: In a forest, a mysterious creature attracts different animals. A wolf photographs it, a fox cooks it as food, and a cat is drawn to consume it. Together, they circulate through image, object, and perception.

title: Bury Me
overview: A grieving girl unravels, turning to an unexpected habit to cope with the loss of her mother.

title: insomn
overview: Somn Moon, an overworked office worker, ends another monotonous day and dreams of a window embedded in his chest: an eerie portal into his unconscious. Inside, he encounters a haunting replica of himself.

title: Amalgam
overview: Gaby invites her inner circle into her living room. Trying to capture her growing awareness of how others’ gaze shapes her, she puts herself in front of the camera. A dialogue emerges. Which version of her is the most authentic?

title: Thief of Night
overview: By stealing the beautiful night scenery by heart, thieves understand the pure love and embracement.

title: Brohr
overview: In the near future in Blokhavn, 24-year-old craftsman Ali lives in the ghetto area Valhalalparken with his wife Yasmina. Their everyday life changes drastically when the rich man Jasper Puch sends high-tech robots into the labor market, which immediately take over all the underpaid jobs. The residents of Valhalalparken, including Ali and Yasmina, lose their income and are reluctantly forced to relocate to Nakskov on Lolland. In the meantime, the robots start demolishing Valhalalparken so that expensive luxury apartments can be built for the rich citizens. However, Ali refuses to let go of his beloved hometown and decides to gather his old group of friends Hassan, Davito, Ahmed, Abdi, Musti, even though they are no longer on speaking terms. Ali manages to persuade them, and together they go on a wild and crazy adventure in the fight against the robots and Jasper Puch to win back their jobs and their beloved Blokhavn.

title: Plans
overview: Stopped at a traffic light in Maianga, Luanda, a man drifts into his inner world to the sound of ‘Planos’. Between reality and dream, he revisits youth, fears and lost hopes in a poetic journey blending memory, music and animation.

title: Are You Sleeping?
overview: Night. Air raid sirens. Insomnia. A girl returns to a city she barely recognizes and confronts the changes in it and its inhabitants.

title: Sing to the Wind
overview: Orphaned and displaced from their home in Gaza City, two brothers must find their way to a "safe zone" to survive.

title: When Will You Be Back?
overview: A quiet journey through hand-drawn memories of a familiar, bygone Hanoi, where a grandson gradually comes to understand his grandmother’s life of waiting, uncovering the weight of a question he can no longer answer.

title: Seeing Hands
overview: A pair of hands makes peace with hallucinations.

title: What Lies Between Us
overview: A quiet suburban community is shaken by the alleged sexual assault of a teenage boy by two of his peers. As the town reels, successful real estate agent Anne Sofie discovers her own son may be more involved than she imagined. Determined to protect him and the family's reputation, she makes a choice that sets her on a collision course with the other boys' mothers, Sarah and Ulrikke. As accusations against her son begin to spread, the pressure mounts and to shield her family, Anne Sofie pins the blame on one of the other boys. But as her relationships fracture and her moral compass wavers, she’s forced to make a life-altering decision.

title: When the Mountains Shook
overview: The world that appears calm on the surface is, in fact, quietly changing. One day, a man as unshakable as a mountain fell because of a toothache.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Documentary Enzo9000: The History
overview: An intimate documentary exploring the journey of Enzo Lemes Farias, professionally known as Enzo9000. The film traces his path from early content creation in Mauá to becoming a prominent and occasionally controversial figure in the Brazilian indie horror scene. Through narrative sagas of games like Five Nights at Freddy’s and Undertale, the documentary reveals the challenges of early fame, the resilience against digital harassment, and the profound artistic and personal transformation of this young digital filmmaker.

title: Девочки учатся бриться
overview: The late 1990s. Best friends Misha and Taya dream of escaping the small coastal town where adults have long since decided what their future should be. The brash Misha falls in love with a new teacher, while the quiet Taya hides the fact that her parents are planning to marry her off to a foreigner to save the family. Their friendship, through betrayal and pain, becomes a pillar of strength: they understand that growing up doesn't mean running away, but rather learning to stand up for yourself, even if it means being hurt by reality.

title: Капитан Невельской и земли Чёрного дракона
original_title: Капитан Невельской и земли Чёрного дракона
overview: Captain Gennadiy Nevelskoy, an excellent student at the Naval Academy, is forced by his talent to teach naval science to the Tsarevich instead of conquering distant seas, watching as other people's dreams replace his own. Fourteen-year-old Nadezhda, a young student at the Institute for Noble Maidens, has never found her place in the capital. Deep down, she knows her true home is lost somewhere in the lands of the Far East, and she must return there. Upon meeting each other, Gennadiy and Nadezhda embark on a great and dangerous adventure-a search for themselves and their place in the world.

title: The Day I Smoked a Cigarette with My Father
original_title: Le jour où j'ai fumé une cigarette avec mon père
overview: Cairo, 1964. Alaa, a 12-year-old boy, and his three younger siblings hear shouting from the street. Outside, the crowd is cheering for a man. The children can barely believe their eyes: the man is their father, Ibrahim.

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: Whispers of Fatimah
overview: Hesti searches for her missing father whose path leads her to the cursed village of Desa Gringsing, where she becomes enmeshed in the terror of a restless spirit named Fatimah.

title: Shame and Money
overview: After losing their livelihood in a village, a Kosovar family is forced to move to the capital in pursuit of a place in a hypercapitalist society.

title: Láska
overview: 30-year-old Anna seeks a stable foundation in her relationships but unknowingly repeats the manipulative patterns learned from her mother. When she crosses paths with a terminally ill patient and his devoted wife, Anna experiences a profound love that transforms her life.

title: Bibi Blocksberg - Die total verhexte Zeitreise
original_title: Bibi Blocksberg - Die total verhexte Zeitreise

title: POSSESSION: The Darkness Within
overview: Odysseas Zervas, a grieving painter plagued by visions, confronts a sinister figure who mirrors his fears. As reality dissolves, his family seeks help, while a monk races to save him from a spiritual force that claims both sanity and soul.

title: Virtuous Women
overview: A VIP retreat for women seeking their best selves turns into an absurd and dangerous journey.

title: The Paradise
overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

title: Western Blot!
overview: Western Blot! is a drawn-on-film animated short inspired by an analytical technique used in molecular biology, called a western blot.

title: Echo of Tomorrow's War
overview: The EU has fallen apart, and in Germany, far-right populists are forming a new government. War is imminent. Jonas has deserted; he and his sister go into hiding at the home of their father, Stuber, whom Jonas has not seen since childhood. But there, the situation escalates. A catastrophe occurs even before the war has begun.

title: Not Every Love Story Ends in Death
original_title: Nem Toda História De Amor Acaba Em Morte
overview: Sol falls in love with Lola, a young deaf actress, and they begin a romance. Everything gets complicated when Lola starts living under the same roof as Sol's ex-husband, Miguel. In this curious triangle, they will discover that the death of one love can be the birth of another.

title: Mrs Winkler Leaves the House
overview: In 2030, retired actress Mrs. Winkler lives bitterly and marked by pain. When her daughter Emi accepts a theater offer, a care robot named Pavlovich takes over the care of her mother. Unexpectedly, his knowledge of classical plays seems to reawaken Mrs. Winkler's will to live...

title: The Ultimate Planet
overview: After an accident, memories of his service on the Ninth Planet flash in the mind of auto mechanic Dima Khrust: amazing landscapes, the base of earthlings, battles with monsters, friends and his beloved girl Polina, whom he once saved... Khrust's colleagues twist their fingers at their temples, because theirs is completely different - ordinary army memories. But when Dima meets Polina in real life, he no longer doubts: someone corrected their memories. Who and why? The truth can only be found out by returning to the dangerous planet.

title: Fuse
overview: After two middle class teenagers commit a horrific crime, their parents debate whether they should protect their loved ones or let them face the consequences for their actions.

title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

title: Memburu Pemangsa
overview: 7 children vanish from the same neighborhood. 4 are later found brutally dismembered, and the clock is ticking to find the rest. AGNES, editor-in-chief of Daily Wave News, has long dismissed the supernatural after the tragic loss of her daughter. But when a child is abducted before her very eyes, she is forced to confront a mystery far darker than she ever imagined. Alongside fellow journalists CIA, BRINA, and ANYA , and aided by police officer PETRA, Agnes uncovers a chilling case that blurs the line between reality and the unknown. As the danger closes in, they are left with only two choices: walk away and save themselves, or risk everything to protect the children they still have a chance to save.

title: Emil and the Detectives
overview: Emil is spending his summer vacation with his grandmother in Berlin. But on the train there, he is robbed by the ruthless con artist Max Grundeis and a wild adventure begins! Together with his friends Pony, Gustav, Dienstag, Anh, and Jason, Emil sets off in pursuit and embarks on a fast-paced detective hunt across Berlin.

title: The Tailcoat Collector
overview: Peri works as a debt collector for a loan shark in downtown Rio de Janeiro. One day, after making a serious mistake at work, he is sent out of Brazil. It is during his journey to his new country, Portugal, that he meets Abgail, a woman who helps him calm down. In Lisbon, Peri starts working for “The Tailcoat Collector”, a curious debt collection company whose job is to follow debtors dressed in tailcoats, intimidating them into paying their debts. Peri is always very successful until the moment he is called to collect from Abgail, the woman he met on the plane and with whom he will fall madly in love.

title: Memórias do Cárcere
overview: Accused of adultery, Ana Augusta Plácido and Camilo Castelo Branco were imprisoned for more than a year in the Porto Prison, she in June 1860, he in October of the same year, after an adventurous escape from justice through the lands of the North.

title: Keys
overview: A woman returns to her ex's flat, where a quiet reunion begins to slip between holding on and letting go

title: Starfish
overview: Returning to his province, a male sex worker from Manila discovers that oppression clings to him like a shadow wherever he goes.

title: Ang Huling Banlaw ni Susan
overview: A Filipina labandera’s vivid fantasies slowly take over her reality, exposing the hidden cost of surviving in a broken system.

title: Lovavieja
overview: The short film portrays the cultural heritage of Barranco de Loba through the tambora and the people who keep the town's traditions and identity alive.

title: Kapag Tapos na ang Umpukan
overview: A young man trapped between family obligation and personal ambition finds himself at a crossroads when the rituals of lambanog-making and a night of celebration force him to confront the courage he has long been postponing.

title: Sa Mga Nagdaan at Lumipas
overview: Ella, a mourning queer archivist, reminisced about her lover by preserving a historical video documenting the first Pride March in the Philippines in 1994 which features them both.

title: Teks Battle: Shoot Pati Pato!
overview: In a small barangay where a children’s game of teks reflects real power, Maya challenges Rod, the reigning champion turned tyrant, in a teks battle that could change the fate of their community.

title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: Local Squalls
overview: On the beach. The world is a much more dangerous place.

title: Attack on Paradise
overview: After seven years in prison, Suleyman is released and determined to pick up his life again. During his incarceration, his home, the flat block ‘Paradise’, has been taken over by gangs and drug dealers. When the police decide to raid Paradise, Suleyman gets caught in the violence, with only one goal: to get back to his mother and get her to safety. Alongside rookie police officer Yasmine, Suleyman battles his way up, floor by floor.

title: Kengur Returns Home
overview: After a glittering playing career in England, where he played in the Premier League, and a not-so-glamorous coaching stint in London, Kengur returns to Serbia with his dark-skinned fiancée Elektra. He arrives in style, full of plans and patriotic fervor.

title: The Magic Garden
overview: Two friends discover a hidden treasure, but both refuse to accept it. Together, they find a solution that will bring about a beautiful future for the entire village.

title: FINI DE RIRE ! L'humour politique au garde-à-vous ?
original_title: FINI DE RIRE ! L'humour politique au garde-à-vous ?

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: Apol of my Ai
overview: A young boy falls in love with his teacher, only to discover a shocking and awkward twist: his main romantic rival for her affection is his own father.

title: Uncle, Where Are You Going?
overview: A peculiar journey begins on Jeju Island. The artists transform into Sim Bong-sa and Ppaengdeok Eomeoni, slipping into a playful parody of The Tale of Simcheong, where reality and performance blur. A philosophical yet joyful road movie about failed artists restoring themselves.

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: Justin the Just
overview: France, World War I. Justin (Alban Ivanov), an illiterate peasant farmer is enrolled in French army. Knowing nothing of the World or the War, Justin finds himself on the front without understanding why he must kill men he’s never met. Naïve and open minded, Justin will cross the path of a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, escape a prisoner camp and start a mutiny to prevent his fellow comrades to risk their lives. Through his journey Justin will question the absurdity of war, make lifetime friends and inspire many…

title: Multwoh
overview: Marcel is a queer individual who mysteriously becomes a ghost (“multwoh”) on the night she finally decides to confess her love to her long‑time crush, Miguel. Because Marcel dies before she can say “I love you,” her spirit lingers, trying to find a way to express her feelings from beyond the grave.

title: Take Me Home
overview: Anna, a 38-year-old Korean adoptee with a cognitive disability, cares for her aging parents in a fragile balance of meeting each others’ needs. When a Florida heat wave shatters their family and Anna’s routine, her future is uncertain - until she creates a world where she can thrive.

title: Stuck On You
overview: A heartbroken manicurist accidentally takes a hitman's job, landing her in a deadly conspiracy where she must choose between saving her family or killing the man of her dreams.

title: Dead Hungry
overview: The story follows a grumpy shut-in whose third eye is accidentally opened after eating an offering meant for a charming but lonely ghost. Now bound together, they discover family secrets, shared heartaches, and a love that blurs the line between life and the afterlife.

title: Wantawsan
overview: Finalist for the 2026 Puregold CinePanalo Film Festival

title: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: Another Day
overview: Garance is a young actress, but not a star. She manages everything as best she can, valiant, cheerful, a soldier, and she finds in alcohol an unconditional fuel, a source of comfort. Garance changes her life and begins an eight-year journey of moves, work, encounters, parties and anxieties, joys and hardships… An intimate, friendly, and sexual revolution. But she consumes, more and more. Until the very possibility of death…

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: Possible Love
overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

title: Red Rocks
overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: HalloWiebe: Overdrive
overview: Wiebe and his team of security guards face their most challenging task yet.

title: Ultimo - Tutto. Live a Tor Vergata
original_title: Ultimo - Tutto. Live a Tor Vergata
overview: The film shows every facet of the record-breaking concert, faithfully following the passage of time and the crescendo of emotions that accompany ULTIMO's "everlasting fairy tale": song after song, fans will be able to relive every moment of this legendary live show, which represents the consecration of an artist who has effectively changed the landscape of the contemporary Italian music scene.

title: Please Fix Me
overview: Wanting to fix herself and fed up with her therapist’s lack of quick solutions, Leah goes for a spa day. In the name of self-care, Leah puts herself in the hands, and ultimately skin, of the larger-than-life Amber.

title: Fight of Fury 2 Retaliation
overview: Brandon exerts great effort and patience to rescue his daughter, abducted by a sex trafficker named Brutal. He comes so close to meeting his nemesis, but the villain escapes to avoid capture by the authorities, who he fears more than Brandon. The search must continue, or all is lost!

title: Bedford Park
overview: Haunted by an abusive childhood, Audrey, a Korean American woman in her 30s, faces her emotional past. When her mother’s car accident brings her back to her parents’ home, she meets the man responsible for the accident. Their relationship builds, passions ignite, and they form a loving connection.

title: Erratics
overview: Freeing himself after spending a hundred years trapped in a glacier, the ghost of the filmmaker Lucien Castelnau wanders through a futuristic Patagonia, where technological progress clashes with forgotten stories. Unable to rest while his cinematic legacy remains unseen, he crosses a world that has deleted him from its memory, in search of a place in history and of spectators, who can finally bring his lost work back to life.

title: Isolation
overview: Isolation explores loneliness, grief, loss, and the struggles of mental health. All within a pursuit of understanding one's purpose. It's a coalescence of one's trauma and working through it while performing at a high level.

title: Motherbaby Runs a Race
overview: A new mom trains for a 5k race while navigating shifts in identity and postpartum depression.

title: Footsteps on the Ceiling
overview: After moving into a new house with his mother, a young man begins hearing noises in the attic.

title: Terms & Conditions
overview: A douchey techbro gets more than he bargained for when the genderqueer demon he used AI to summon sloughs off his control and sows chaos instead.

title: Mr. Creamjeans' Hidey Hole
overview: Henry, a man plagued by chronic pain and unresolved guilt, receives a chilling message: "I know what you did." The note leads him to The Hidey Hole, an underground museum of erotic nightmares, curated by the charismatic and unsettling Mr. Creamjeans. There, Henry is offered a chance to erase all traces of his secret crime... but only if he submits to a guided tour of the museum's most depraved exhibits. With every tale, Henry's pain worsens and his grip on reality slips, until he's forced to confront the twisted role he's played in the lives (and deaths) of others. By the end, Henry must decide: confess the truth and face the consequence, or lose himself to the Hidey Hole forever.

title: The Seedling
overview: Stress, stress, stress When you still trust in tales of storks there's not much there to be proud of. Something in the space below my stomach is growing roots — is it what I think it is, or just stress? Kama is creating a huge tree, her period is late, and her best friend wants to become an apron wife. The premiere of the play is in a week.

title: noise of waves
overview: Thirteen-year-old Antek is grieving over his Mum’s death and seeking a way to contact her. He comes across an internet advert for the GHOSTPHONE, a mysterious device resembling a 1980s TV set.

title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
original_title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
overview: Caffeine-deprived Cand Caff’s day goes from bad to apocalyptic when his sentient fridge threatens to blow up the entire neighborhood unless he delivers a fresh energy drink — fast. What follows is a chaotic sprint filled with push-up battles, Karen attacks, and unhinged inner demons in this pitch-black, low-budget comedy.  The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End cranks the absurdity, self-loathing, and dark humor to eleven while somehow feeling like the start of something much bigger.

title: Eskipesimk

title: Al Tuck My Blues Away

Nick seems to be accustomed to these interactions; he plays along, and life moves on. At least, it does until the day Nick is murdered outside their apartment.  Consumed by grief and knowing that the criminal justice system tends to disregard the thorough investigation and prosecution of crimes perpetrated against Black people, Claire embarks on her own search for the truth about Nick’s death. What begins as a tale ends in a spell cast upon unsuspecting characters and audiences alike

title: Ekeko: El Muñeco de la Suerte
original_title: Ekeko: El Muñeco de la Suerte
overview: The story follows Gabriela, a young woman seeking to heal the deep wounds of a traumatic past. The plot explores how the unbridled pursuit of prosperity distorts the amulet's essence when it interacts with Taitaorco, a powerful mountain spirit. Under the stark premise that "greed is a deadly sin" and "every stroke of luck comes at a price," a sinister ancestral rule is revealed: if the cigarette offered to the statuette goes out before burning completely, a portal to the underworld (Uku Pacha) opens, awakening malevolent entities ready to violently collect on favors rendered in exchange for your very soul.

title: Captain Newfoundland
overview: Media mogul, athlete, creator of the psychedelic superhero Captain Newfoundland, and an activist against his home province joining Confederation: Geoff Stirling was all these things and more. To do justice to a character as complex as this film’s protagonist, Mike Feehan turns the camera on himself and his co-director Jamie Miller as they weave together archival footage, animation, and fantastical recreations from Stirling's experimental 1970s late-night TV show, all very in keeping with NTV's original broadcast mission. Captain Newfoundland is an illuminating and wildly entertaining portrait of a complex man and his impact on the province that, according to Stirling, may or may not be the tip of the long-lost island of Atlantis.

title: Revel

title: Coloring

overview: Bára Basiková is an icon of Czech rock and other music genres. To what extent can her public, media-distorted image differ from the person she really is? The answer comes in the form of the latest long-term documentary study from Helena Třeštíková, whose empathy, coupled with admirable self-reflection and openness on the part of the protagonist, gives rise to a fascinating film portrait: over the course of fifty years we follow a woman who demonstrates remarkable strength as she faces the challenges of both her professional and private lives.​

overview: Two rogue journalists clash over a damning video that could topple a crooked regime. As betrayal and blackmail mount, their twisted road trip spirals into chaos, murder, and a scandal that could bring the whole system crashing down.

title: Terbang

overview: 'Rooted' is a dream-like experimental short film created by Elke Hounshell and Ash Carroll. This short film explores how nature is a healing practice to the bodies, and how many connections we have to nature without even realizing it. It captures how the human body connects with nature, the river, roots, emotions, and everything else.

title: The Sign of the Dragon
overview: Detective Michael loses his hearing during an operation and subsequently withdraws from active duty. Years later, a former colleague asks him to take on a mysterious case involving a dangerous dragon cult. Despite his limitations, he is called back into action and must confront his past in order to solve the case.

title: Nonna

title: Family Album
overview: Alex will soon become a father. In a storage room, he discovers deeply disturbing family photographs. Some suggest his mother’s marital infidelity; others indicate his father, a retired officer, was involved in various acts of violence. Alex’s investigation leads him to a town devastated years before by the violence of the Internal Armed Conflict, where he uncovers his true and intricate family album.

title: Gentle Monster
overview: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

title: 9 Temples to Heaven
original_title: 9 วัด สู่สวรรค์
overview: A family of 9 takes their grandmother on a merit-making trip to 9 temples in 1 day, hoping to prolong her life. But the trip takes an unexpected turn.

title: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
original_title: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
overview: On their way to his wife's hometown in West Sumatra, Teddy and his best friend, Kevin, recklessly continue their journey at night and become lost in a forbidden area believed to be the realm of the Urang Bunian. Amidst a forest filled with supernatural terrors and illusions, they must find their way home before they disappear forever.

title: Henry's First Dates
original_title: จีบซ้ำซ้ำ เฮนรี่จำไม่ได้
overview: Lucy, a woman who's living her first date on repeat with Henry, a good-natured, animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can't remember anything from the day before.

title: The Violinist
overview: It is Singapore in the late 1930s. Kai and Fei are childhood friends and aspiring violinists. When Japan invades Malaya in 1941, Kai chooses to forgo his music career to join the anti-Japanese forces. After the war Kai goes missing. Determined to find him, Fei performs all over Southeast Asia, all the while seeking any news of Kai. Yet, as time fades, Fei has to decide if she must find her own music to define the remaining years of her life.

title: Nyepi
overview: Tae-pyeong, Yoon-chae and their friends embark on a journey to Bali, captivated by its mystical landscapes. Their local guide, Nova, explains the significance of the upcoming Nyepi Day — Bali's sacred Day of Silence, when all forms of eating, pleasure, travel and even lights must cease. While exploring the island, Tae-pyeong accidentally breaks a mysterious urn, triggering a series of strange and terrifying events that soon force them to violate the sacred rules of Nyepi Day against their will. As reality warps around them, Tae-pyeong begins to realize that a far more sinister force is at play — one that may not let them leave the island alive.

title: Antarctic
overview: A brutal crime shocks an isolated Brazilian research station in Antarctica, transforming the enviroment filled with scientists and military personnel into a veritable pressure cooker. The men at the station become suspects, and a female deputy commander takes on the mission of investigating what happened and, with the support of the women at the base, faces silence and violence in her search for justice.

title: Under the Gaze of Night
overview: Set in a park at night during the pandemic, the story follows a gay man who suffers from an intense fear of AIDS. This fear isolates him and prevents him from engaging in sexual relationships, yet he is drawn to the park’s charged atmosphere of desire. The park, a known cruising spot for gay men, becomes a place where he encounters a range of strangers — each searching, escaping, or surrendering in the shadows.

title: Paradise
overview: Suleyman returns home after serving seven years, only to find his apartment block has been seized by drug dealers. When drawn into the violence surrounding the complex, his sole focus becomes keeping his mother safe.

title: Big and Large: A Basketball Story
original_title: Big and Large: A Basketball Story
overview: The story behind the intramural basketball team known as "Tha Biggest Tha Largest," a team made for the big fellas, and their road to the championship in their inaugural season.

title: Djinn Wedding
overview: When four estranged siblings reunite in their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, long-buried memories begin to resurface. As the celebrations unfold, two of them are drawn back into the unbreakable bond they once shared. Family secrets slowly come to light, leading them on a journey through grief and the invisible ties between generations.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: After Islamic terrorists hijack a college's pro-Palestine encampment with the goal of enforcing Sharia law on students and executing dissidents whom they deem "infidels", a group of students, a security guard, and a Delta Force veteran team up to fight back.

title: Where Our Flowers Grow
overview: For generations, many Métis people were pressured to hide their identity and culture. Through intimate testimonies and innovative stop–motion beadwork animation, Where Our Flowers Grow follows those reclaiming connections to reveal how a culture marked by silence and erasure continues to define itself from one generation to the next.

title: RE/ROUTE
overview: Blending documentary footage with striking visual collage, RE/ROUTE imagines two competing visions of urban life. One is ruled by cars, productivity, unchecked capitalism and individualism; the other prioritizes connection, leisure and inclusion. As familiar cityscapes morph into surreal tableaux, the film invites us to reconsider how urban design shapes our communities, our relationships, our futures.

title: Restaurant Kids
overview: Raised between dining rooms and take–out counters, the children of Halifax’s Chinese restaurateurs share stories of family, hard work and identity. Through intimate conversations and personal memories, Restaurant Kids celebrates a tight-knit community whose businesses became gathering places, livelihoods and second homes for a generation growing up between cultures.

title: Butter Chicken to Go
overview: Three South Asian delivery drivers brave Toronto’s winter dinner rush, zipping through slushy, frigid streets. Through intimate portraits of the drivers, Butter Chicken to Go exposes a deep contradiction: a country that eagerly consumes South Asian cuisine while increasingly excluding the people whose labour sustains it. What does it mean to belong when your presence is both essential and contested?

title: In Her You'll Find Sanctuary
overview: After the arrival of a nun with mystical visions, Sister Miriam becomes envious of her rival's sudden notoriety and begins falsifying miracles in a grotesque game of spiritual cat-and-mouse.

title: Neil Peart: No One's Disciple
overview: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson team up with four revered drummers — Stewart Copeland, Danny Carey, Chad Smith, and Gavin Harrison — for an exhilarating and poignant tribute to late Rush legend Neil Peart.

title: pahkwêsikan sâkihitowin: Bannock is Love
overview: Gathering family, friends and community members around a beloved traditional food, pahkwêsikan sâkihitowin: Bannock is Love reflects on the role of bannock in sustaining Indigenous identity, memory and connection. Through stories shared across generationsand moving through different contexts, the film reveals how cultural traditions nourish not only the body, but also the spirit, resilience and future of a people.

title: Jacques Henri Lartigue – La vie en relief
original_title: Jacques Henri Lartigue – La vie en relief

title: The Weight
overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

title: The Age Of Goodbyes
overview: Set in Malaysia, the film follows a young woman named Du Li An who falls in love with a man named Lin Sang in 1969 before he mysteriously disappears. Years later, after marrying a gangster and becoming stepmother to a teenage girl, Du Li An encounters a man who looks exactly like her vanished lover. The decade-spanning narrative blends elements of romance, mystery and coming-of-age storytelling.

title: Think Good
overview: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

title: Edjop
overview: Based on the life of Edgar Jopson, a young man from an affluent family who became an underground activist who confronted President Ferdinand Marcos and his regime of terror.

title: The Assassin(s)
overview: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

title: The Difficult Bride
overview: Novera, a bride-to-be in present-day Dhaka, is in love with her groom and dreams of a fairytale wedding, but secretly struggles with her body’s resistance to wedding rituals. As stress and emotional pain intensify, a mysterious woman with long hair begins appearing in Novera’s imagination.

title: Forgotten Island
overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

title: Resident Evil
overview: Bryan, a medical courier, unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: Mousey
overview: Babette unexpectedly finds herself sharing her small Parisian apartment with Edo, a Congolese refugee. When an escaped lab mouse makes itself known, their lives are turned upside down as they try to navigate conflicting expectations.

title: The Blue Line
overview: What remains of the Natzweiler Struthof concentration camp, established by the Nazis in the Bruche valley in Alsace? The last remaining witnesses share their stories. Between topography of places and memory mapping, the accounts bring fragments of resistance back to light.

title: A Long Winter
overview: High in the mountains, autumn comes to an end and a family prepares for the long winter ahead.

title: Stella by Starlight
overview: On Stella’s 29th birthday, four days before her band is set to embark on a career-altering tour, she learns that it is canceled. As she scrambles to salvage the tour and rally her bandmates, tensions rise, threatening not just the tour but the band's future.

title: This is Not a French Film
original_title: Ceci n’est pas un film français
overview: Tired of being offered the same cliché roles over again, Tom, a committed Franco-Beninese actor decides to make his first feature film with non-white performers. Through a film-within-a-film approach, the ensemble challenges norms and works toward empowerment.

title: Painting the Lake
overview: A house painter in a small town turns to insurance fraud in order to pay for his brother's medical bills.

title: Myosotis
overview: When a nursing home resident tries to embark on her dream trip, the constant disappearances of her suitcase force her into a frantic battle with her own mind.

title: Tehran, Under the Skin
overview: In an age of body anxiety, filmmaker Afsaneh Salari embeds herself in the offices of Iranian plastic surgeons to interview their clients with humour and empathy.

title: Thirteen in Gaza
overview: Palestinian director Hosam Abu Dan makes his narrative feature debut with a nuanced and deeply human portrait of a father and his teenage daughter navigating everyday life in a refugee camp in the Gaza Strip.

title: Rescue
overview: On a dead-calm morning in the Mediterranean, the migrant rescue ship of Doctors Without Borders spots a deflating rubber boat. Dozens of people are struggling in the water. Among the refugees is Roro, a Yemeni mother traveling with her husband, Hani, their two-month-old baby, and two young sons. As the rescue begins, a Libyan militia intervenes and abducts Roro and the children, dragging them back to Libya. Meanwhile, Hani is rescued and arrives in Europe alone. A family is violently torn apart across the Mediterranean. While Hani fights from Europe to reunite the family, Roro struggles to survive captivity in Libya and to protect her children. Trapped by a violent system deeply entangled with EU border politics, she relentlessly attempts to cross the sea again. RESCUE is a gripping story of survival and injustice, and a powerful portrait of a young mother whose strength drives the film.

title: James McNeill Whistler
overview: Tate Britain is now holding the first major retrospective of Whistler in three decades. This blockbuster exhibition promises to reawaken the world to just how important Whistler is to art history, uniting world-famous masterpieces with rarely seen works. Exhibition on Screen will bring these stunning works and the incredible story behind them to cinemas around the world while the exhibition is still running, bringing this truly global artist to a global audience. This will be an unmissable chance to get to know this visually spectacular artist and the influence he has had on those who followed.

title: The Fortunate Isles
overview: In the arid Canary Islands of the 15th century, Fátima is enslaved by a decadent marquis who controls the island’s only source of fresh water. When rebellion erupts and the well runs dry, she ventures into the barren landscape in search of water — and a chance of survival for the entire community.

title: The Pervert's Guide to Utopias
overview: Philosopher Slavoj Žižek is our guide through landscapes of classic film, music, social media, archive and webcasts. Making unexpected twists and turns, he maps the utopian illusions of our times. Through absurd juxtapositions and startling insights, we are seduced into recognising our fate, in order to change it.

title: Ba's Book
overview: Production/Post-production. After a father writes a memoir in the form of letters to his daughter about his harrowing experiences of the Vietnam War and the Iranian Revolution, the daughter responds by making a film.

title: Ladies and Gentlemen, Brian Mulroney
overview: Haunted by visions of the future. Vilified by the political establishment. Charming beyond belief. Behold the dazzling ascent of Brian Mulroney, the “Boy from Baie-Comeau” who built a brand-new Canada.

title: The World Is A Wedding
overview: A teenager joins his grandmother at a mahjong game, where he encounters a mysterious woman threatening to unravel secrets from their family's past.

title: Ulya
overview: A giant girl lives in a wild rural environment. When the modern world enters this isolated Russian Old Believer milieu, the girl is taken away and dragged into the world of professional sports. The aim does not differ much from that of a circus in the Middle Ages – to entertain audiences and exploit the limits of people’s mental and physical abilities. But the girl proves to have unbelievable willpower and athletic talent. She is able to adapt and triumph in this new world. This is the story of the famous basketball player Ulyana Semyonova.

title: The Idiot(s)
overview: Fyodor Dostoyevsky and his wife Anna travel to Europe for their honeymoon and end up staying in a health resort in Switzerland, only to return to Russia after four years. Fyedya can’t shake his roulette habit and keeps losing their money. His wife accepts this fate since he keeps assuring her that it’s all for inspiration and soon he shall write his to-be masterpiece, 'The Idiot'.

title: Angh
overview: In 1960s Nagaland, a proud Konyak chief struggles to protect his dying traditions when an American missionary arrives with promises of aid that threaten his people’s identity. As his wife’s health deteriorates and famine looms, he and his mute son must make an impossible choice between survival and staying true to their ancestral ways.

title: Brace Your Heart
overview: In a remote Sámi village high in the mountains, 20-year-old Ejva inherits her late father's reindeer herd. As she struggles to keep the herd thriving, local leader Heaika develops romantic feelings for her, and though hesitant, she feels compelled to accept. But everything changes when Nejla, Heaika's cousin, arrives, and Ejva discovers true love for the first time. Betrayed and jealous, Heaika reacts harshly, leaving Ejva with a condition that makes her hands shake uncontrollably, threatening her ability to care for the herd. Now, Ejva must find a way to reclaim control over her life and her future.

title: Gina
overview: After spending three years in jail, Juan goes free with the aim of recovering Eva's love. Zoe and Ismael, two ex-partners who he betrayed, will return to cross in his way.

title: Imichki
overview: In 1975, in a village in southern Morocco, a young illiterate woman’s attempt to write to her absent husband becomes an intimate act of resistance against silence, distance, and the limits imposed on her world.

title: Kick On
overview: When a night of partying leads four friends to kick on, at the extravagant drug-fueled lair of a mobster's reckless son, they find themselves fighting for their lives amidst a brutal spiral of paranoia, violence and ultimate betrayal.

title: Eklipse
overview: Twelve-year-old Tomy spends the summer of the 1999 solar eclipse with his best friend Chris on an alpine pasture. When Chris learns that Tomy's father is in hospital with AIDS, their friendship falls apart – and Tomy suddenly finds himself torn between exclusion and the secrecy of his own family.

title: Like Magic
overview: Blending archival footage, personal testimony and a decades-long search for answers, Melissa Saavedra Gil transforms a childhood tragedy into a powerful exploration of memory, truth, and healing. An intimate and deeply resonant debut that illuminates both a personal story and a generation shaped by violence.

title: Sunburn
overview: When a citywide blackout knocks out the power on one of the hottest days on record, a group of neighborhood kids set out in search of relief, unaware that the day will quietly mark the end of their childhood.

title: 2:LOVE
overview: A major tennis tournament is about to begin, and the tension is palpable. On the court, two ball girls crouch on either side of the net. Each believes her moment has arrived. They want to be the best ball girls in the tournament's history. The ultimate ball girl championship.  But when the match begins and the girls look into each other's eyes, they are surprised to discover another force beyond the net: attraction. A dynamic that begins as bitter rivalry transforms into a magnetic passion, during which the girls search for a way to escape the competition that stands in the way of their love.

title: No Handouts
overview: In a hyper-capitalistic future, rookie EMT Joanna Broz finds herself in a struggle between job security and an Innocent boy's life.

title: Zjili: A Story of Sisterhood and The Burdens of Excess
original_title: Zjili: A Story of Sisterhood and The Burdens of Excess
overview: The story draws from the experiences of several kayayei, who carry 55-kilogram bales of imported secondhand clothing around Kantamanto, Accra’s principal secondhand clothing market.

title: Strong Son
overview: A dedicated South Asian bodybuilder returns home to care for his aging father, juggling his own well-being with the demands of care-giving. He strives to balance personal goals and filial duty in this touching exploration of family bonds.

title: Neverman
overview: A transgender woman with Alzheimer's moves into a retirement home. As her lucidity wanes, she must confront the challenges of her condition and fight for her identity once more.

title: A Common Story
overview: Erika and Mauro live in the province, living a simple life made up of reassuring habits and small gestures. When their daughter Irene leaves to study abroad, the house empties, and the balance on which the couple has built their existence seems to be shaken.

title: The Spectacular Death of Prisca
overview: On her daughter’s wedding day, a mother finds herself catapulted into a fever-dream quest to rescue her daughter.

title: Where the River Begins
overview: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.

title: Voices
overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
original_title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
overview: A documentary on Darlene Love, the singer and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee known for “He’s a Rebel” and collaborations with Cher, Bruce Springsteen, Dionne Warwick, Sam Cooke and other greats.

title: Wild Wild East
overview: In occupied Poland 1943, German official Martin Wolff is sent to a remote village to investigate the disappearance of a Jewish lawyer. His arrival unsettles the fragile order between scarred villagers, corrupt collaborators, and Nazi authorities, unearthing a web of betrayal and greed tied to whispers of the lawyer’s hidden fortune. Yet as the village’s darkest truths come to light, Wolff’s search may be hiding more than it reveals.

title: God Bless You, Mr. Kopu
overview: A struggling Tongan immigrant is taken under the wing of a charismatic American salesman. What begins as a dream job quickly unravels into a nightmare as the protégé begins questioning his mentor’s methods.

title: Future Tense
overview: Plot TBA. Described as an eco-thriller film.

title: Love Is the Monster
overview: In a dystopian world marked by inequality and everyday violence, a grandmother is determined to make the most of the time she has left with her granddaughter. But as a series of events pushes them into increasing danger, love and fear begin to blur, forcing her to cross lines she never imagined.

title: Seventeen
overview: Set over the course of seventeen hours, the lives of three Indigenous sex workers intersect through chance, relation, and the shared experience of familial and colonial displacement.

title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

title: Target: Captain Black!
overview: Brand New Super Space Theatre Movie

title: Head to Head
overview: Bahar is an acclaimed Iranian director, having made numerous films selected in international festivals. So when she casts actors and asks them to wear women’s outfits for her latest film, they agree in the hope of an international career — or even a visa to leave the country. But wearing skirts and headscarves under the heat is harder than they expected … as is the hit to their pride.

title: The Black Box is Orange
overview: Follows a multimodal, autobiographical essay that deploys both personal memory and incomplete archives to reflect on a childhood in a militarized border town.

title: Out of Context
overview: The documentary explores contemporary art in Southeast Asia and Indonesia. Seeing an artwork becomes insufficient to judge it when the context of the artist is so different from the experience of the viewer on the other side of the earth.

title: Through Breath and Sound
overview: The main character is Vera, a 40-year-old midwife; she is divorced and has two teenage children. She is keen on hiking, loves working out at the gym, and is training to become a fitness instructor. For her, childbirth is a natural process, like the flow of a turbulent mountain river or the drift of clouds. Vera prepares her clients for childbirth using a variety of methods, giving them a sense of security and calm support. It is important to her that, during labour, a woman embarks on the road of self-discovery and experiences it as naturally as possible, just as nature intended.

title: В поисках сенсорной депривации
overview: A recursion film where the search for a lost masterpiece of Soviet cinema becomes the starting point for the study of secret experiments and extreme human conditions, drawing authors and viewers into the abyss on the other side of the screen.

title: Blindspot Berlin
overview: The investigation and its shortfalls in the months before the December 2016 attack at the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz, Berlin.

title: Cheyenne
overview: Cheyenne follows a group of fearless cowgirls who compete at riding wild broncos on the rodeo circuit after nearly a century of being excluded because of their gender.

title: Alpha Gang
overview: Alien invaders, in the form of a 1950’s biker gang, are sent on a mission to conquer Earth.

title: All That She Wants
overview: Emma desperately wants a baby but as she sets about getting her life in order to make it happen, she just won't let herself give in to the idea that the man she really loves is a recent college grad ten years younger than her, whom she used to babysit when she was a teenager and he was four.

title: Steamboat Killie
overview: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
original_title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
overview: A teacher in an abusive marriage takes a job at a maximum security prison, where she falls for a charismatic inmate. The disastrous consequences call into question not only the nature of punishment and retribution, but the very limits of our humanity.

title: Love of Your Life
overview: A young woman loses her husband and goes on a journey to find a way forward in her life.

title: Meat Finders 2
overview: A man buys meat without knowing anything. The meat was very rare, drawing everyone's attention...

title: Silenced Nights
overview: An ordinary worker witnesses the extrajudicial killing of a teenage boy by police officers. Inspired by real-life events during the Philippine anti-drug campaign, the film tracks the lone witness who risks his safety in an attempt to make the truth known.

title: Splits in Two
overview: 'Splits in Two' takes influence from Cantonese Ghost Stories as it parses both the physical and figurative landscape of contemporary Hong Kong, a city whose underground art scene persists as a larger cultural identity risks dissipation.

title: Под кожей
overview: Prosthetic makeup artist Elena Rubtsova, who creates images for theater and film, leaves the world of fiction behind to help people with missing facial parts. She creates silicone prosthetics for cancer patients, special forces soldiers, and those recovering from injuries and surgeries. While helping others cope with loss, Lena begins to face loss herself.

title: Пава
overview: Valentina works as a construction crane operator. At 67, she decides to step outside the confines of her usual life and try her hand at modeling. The Pava fashion house becomes a space where she rethinks her life, cultivates self-love, and finds inner strength.

title: Il desiderio di essere inutile - Hugo a Venezia
original_title: Il desiderio di essere inutile - Hugo a Venezia
overview: The title 'The desire to be useless' recalls a famous Hugo Pratt's expression and contains a double meaning. On one hand, it representes the comic's claim as an art form, long considered  marginal but elevated, but by Pratt was considered a language with high literary and artistic value. On the other, it expresses a life philosophy founded on freedom, on the rejection of reducing existence to fiction or to commodity, and on the possibility of the adventure and the unexpected. Containing interviews with Patrizia Zanotti, Dominique Petitfaux, Thierry Thomas e Marco Steiner, the documentary completes a cinematic research lasted twenty years, returning Hugo Pratt as one of the most important auhor of illustrated literature and an artist still capable of being received by the contemporary audience.

title: Dough Man
overview: When a quirky newcomer moves in, the eldest of three sisters, Evelyn, becomes convinced he’s a witch. Her middle sister dismisses it, the youngest falls for him, and Evelyn descends into a string of increasingly absurd attempts to prove her theory, ending with one final test.

title: Under the Same Clouds
overview: On a quiet winter morning, Céline and Pierre, an elderly couple, go about their separate routines, never crossing paths. Their gestures speak of tenderness and a shared life. In the stillness of the snowy forest, they find each other once again.

title: Сказка каменной пустыни
overview: Summer 2025. Donetsk People's Republic. The film's protagonist, a young volunteer named Seryozha, is sent on another humanitarian mission to Donbas with other volunteers. The goal is to deliver medicine to civilians and military medics. They are accompanied by two "observers"—a photojournalist and a filmmaking student. The cameras capture a military doctor with the call sign "Storyteller."

title: Here and There, in the Wind
original_title: Aquí y Allá, en el Viento
overview: Fabi, a housekeeper in Wisconsin, moves through her days balancing chores and a search for normalcy during a lonely, wintry holiday far from her home in Puerto Rico.

title: Exit Only
overview: Cade hears about strange noises coming from one of his theater exits.

title: Countryside
overview: Estranged brothers, Sean and Luke, return to their rural childhood home. When a zombie outbreak throws the world into chaos, they have no choice but to confront the sacrifices they are willing to make for family.

title: Одинокий подсолнух
overview: Sergey Manuylov was a Leningrad artist who passed away in the mid-1990s. A posthumous exhibition was never destined to take place, and time passed mercilessly, leaving only a trace in people's memories. With the help of artists, friends, and family, his son Alexander recreates the space of memory, interpreting moments from the era, life, and work of his father. Loss becomes the driving force, and time the palette in a painting about the artist.

title: Nosotros
overview: Romero, a 23-year-old Indigenous man who used to drive a three-wheeled mototaxi (TucTuc) in his rural town, flees local gang extortion and migrates to Guatemala City. He finds a job as a security guard at a commercial center, where he falls in love with a trans woman who runs a local business. Together, they build an emotional sanctuary, but their bond is quickly threatened by the deep-seated prejudice and hostility of his coworkers.

title: Falling Into Place
overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

title: The bovine with the curved horns
original_title: El bovino de los cuernos curvos
overview: The bovine with the curved horns follows a boy searching for his missing father through a landscape where myth and violence coexist.

title: Gail
overview: A superfan of the Canadian band Our Lady Peace follows them on their 30th anniversary tour across Canada.

title: Above the Tree
overview: When something inhuman follows her home through the woods, Vera Landen calls the only voice she can reach - a late night radio host who decides her terror makes better entertainment than emergency.

title: Masc
overview: Robin, a young autistic man desperate to fit in, tries on different roles to understand what kind of man he's supposed to be.

title: Edward Said: Between Worlds
overview: An all archival documentary that chronicles the personal journey and ideas of Palestinian-American intellectual, Edward Said.

title: Сложить оружие!
overview: Veteran Denis regains his ability to live a peaceful life by joining a sledge hockey team where eight former soldiers are learning to be fathers, friends, and men again, so that their children will never know what war is.

title: Fire Flies
overview: The filmmaker is led on a flashlight-illuminated stroll through the mountains—with the green, digital images of a night vision camera capturing flora, fauna, and distant stars.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: The Toddling Youths
overview: Yaqin is a girl eager to see the world. WANG Jiong is a boy who stakes his career on a confession. These two newly graduated friends both want to escape their families and realise their self-worth. But when an imperfect society collides with an imperfect self, when cheerfulness becomes a mask, and when initial aspirations waver in reality, what kind of people will they turn out to be after this stumbling coming-of-age journey?

title: The Burning Giants
overview: A mysterious smoke covers western Thailand, triggering a strange infectious disease whose symptoms resemble burns inflicted by an invisible fire. A villager from the Karen ethnic group is arrested deep in the jungle and taken to a quarantine centre. There, he dreams of returning to his mountain homeland. His wife, who has sought refuge in Bangkok, shares the same longing. But their hope is threatened by forest rangers determined to burn down their village to make way for a national park. Beyond the veil of smoke, an abandoned theatre stands hidden in the jungle, haunted by ogre soldiers fleeing the King’s army in an ancient war reflecting the struggle of the villagers.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: Long Long Night
overview: The last rhino of his kind forms an unlikely bond with a penguin born from an abandoned egg. Together, they set out on a heartwarming journey toward the ocean.

title: Watcha Want
overview: A recent immigrant and trophy wife from Hong Kong rediscovers her love of dance after her wealthy husband's betrayal.

title: The Space Between Myself and Myself
original_title: The Space Between Myself and Myself
overview: A young soul called "The Self" recollects the memory of his past while having an ego death in a possible future.

title: Krux
overview: In a German village near war's end, women struggle to maintain normalcy as corpses appear along the river. When ordered to leave no Germans alive for arriving Russians, villagers face brutal choices about survival and humanity.

title: Images of Fire
overview: A couple’s conversation unravels a film shaped by memory, where images and sounds reconstruct a past marked by state violence.

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: The Betrayers
overview: A former Israeli politician and Soviet dissident finds his betrayer at a Crimean resort, sparking a confrontation with past wounds and questions of justice and forgiveness.

title: A Grey Day in June
overview: A family visit through the eyes of the young narrator Sonu transitions from the simple joys of childhood games to the solemn reality of his great-grandmother’s final moments.

title: Vintage Violence
overview: A livestreamer discovers a cache of vintage denim only to run afoul of the Yakuza when he is lured to Japan to sell the jeans by one of his subscribers.

title: Maternity Leave
overview: Screenwriter Martyna the first-time mother, in her 30s, stops her career for maternity leave, but when a producer takes an interest in her idea, she tries to manage both: the first-time motherhood and her profession dream to become a director. With her hands 24/7 full with a baby she is trying to work at night, also hoping for help from her own mother. The screenwriter feels desperate because she can not rely on her mother for help as she is struggling with her own diagnosis.

title: Ancestors
overview: 1988.  Dreams, memories and history collide as a young man searches for his missing friend.

title: Closing Night
overview: A celebrated actress's life begins to unravel on the eve of her greatest performance. When her sister April arrives in New York after a 30-year estrangement, the stage is set for a tense family confrontation.

title: Evil Genius
overview: Follows the true story of the 2003 death of Brian Wells, a notorious case known as the “collar bomb” or “pizza bomber” incident. The FBI investigation revealed an extraordinarily complex and bizarre plot, later described as one of the most intricate crimes in the Bureau’s history.

title: Smudge the Blades
overview: Treaty 6 Blades, an under-18 hockey team from an Alberta reservation, face their last season together while navigating their tough northern league.

title: The Surgeon
overview: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.

title: On Behalf of My Son
overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

title: Drifter
overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

title: Grunk The Smasher
overview: In an age of grim violence and gore-drenched savagery, a brave warrior embarks on an epic adventure to rescue a beautiful harem girl from the clutches of insidious evil. Journey with Grunk as he braves the Catacombs of Madness, bargains with fiendish witches, and smashes strange and fantastic creatures in his quest to quench his lusty barbarian appetites.

title: Babies
overview: Struggling with the decision of whether or not to bring a child into the world, Annie and her husband Aaron become instant co-parents when their newly-divorced friend moves into their home with her 4-year-old. An ensemble comedy drama about the journey to parenthood... or not.

title: AUFTRAG
overview: A scarred survivor struggles between choices that blur dream and reality, each step pulling him deeper into his own downfall.

title: After Elena
overview: When a family's matriarch dies, four relatives are forced to confront decades of silence, resentment, and buried affection. Led by Alfredo Castro, this sharp ensemble balances humour and melancholy in a moving portrait of grief and reconciliation.

title: Moon Palace
overview: Both grounded and cosmic, 'Moon Palace' conjures a (non-)space that connects Jiaqi Yu's loved ones across different realms.

title: First Person: A Film About Love
original_title: First Person: A Film About Love
overview: Stifled by her family life and the stranglehold of feminine expectations, a mother who has it all decides to pursue herself above all else and refuses to bend to society’s mores, even in the face of unspeakable tragedy.

title: Yuja
overview: Daredevil. Rebel. Powerhouse. At 39, Yuja Wang stands among the most electrifying musicians of our time and she is falling out of love with the music. In Yuja, acclaimed filmmaker Lorna Tucker crafts an immersive portrait of an artist in flux. With unprecedented access, the film weaves together performance, memory, and reconstruction to explore the forces that shape Yuja, and the woman she is still becoming.

title: Akshara
