overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Pussy Gets Bit!
overview: In an underground drag-wrestling scene, Pussy The Insane Clown, a flamboyant T-boy performer, faces off against their ex, CatRatBat, a feral and enigmatic wrestler. Still grappling with unresolved feelings, their rivalry spills into the ring, blending punk theatrics with raw emotional tension. With the sharp-tongued Red Hot Rhonda hyping up the crowd, the match becomes a wild spectacle of love, pain, and performance.

title: MENTE
overview: Mind reflects the duality between a toxic life and a artificial life.

title: The Address Book
overview: The titular index in 'The Address Book' belonged to the American iconoclast artist and recluse Joseph Cornell. As we progress through its pages it not only figuratively maps out a constellation of artists—among them Yayoi Kusama and Carolee Schneemann—but also their geographical location in mid-century Manhattan.

title: Microcosmic Orbit: Encased
overview: Poetic and tactile, 'Microcosmic Orbit: Encased' presents containers of both plants and people, asking how such barriers might not only protect but stifle.

title: The Ultra Runner
overview: Driven by a violent past and hardened by years of crime and incarceration, Romanian ultramarathoner Tibi Useriu battles endless terrain and his own demons  in search of a better life for his family, his country, and himself.

title: After Image
overview: Rita Ferrando similarly considers her family’s history of migration by way of archival fragments and a conversation across time with her artist grandfather.

title: Irina Starzhenetskaya. Secret Color
overview: A vibrant portrait of Irina Starzhenetskaya, a Russian artist born in 1943, descendant of a dynasty of female artists whose mother was a set designer and whose grandmother was a ballerina at the Bolshoi Theater. A story that intertwines art, everyday life, and an extraordinary love story. Irina transcends the male-dominated world of the Academy and Soviet "Houses of Creativity," exploring the color hidden among the clods of earth in her garden, in the glances of her friends, and in the architecture of a flower.

title: Low Lies the Land
overview: Set in the breathtaking landscapes of Piemonte in Northern Italy, the lives of three winemaking families face an uncertain future.

title: Jayanti 2
overview: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

title: Termite
overview: Shaunak Sen’s follow-up to the Academy Award–nominated documentary All That Breathes is an evocative drama set in the vibrant neighbourhoods of Old Delhi, where the routined lives of two middle-aged termite exterminators are about to drastically change when one of them receives an unexpected marriage proposal.

title: Mindflip
overview: Marilyn Hardesty is an aging horror film actress, and heiress to her ancient husband's biotech fortune through a whirlwind courtship, marriage, and funeral. Terminally ill, she is determined to cheat death and rekindle her career by transferring her mind into the body of a younger woman. With Norman Baetz, her "personal assistant", she recruits Dr. Laurence Fine, a brilliant, twisted neurobiologist, to serve her obsession with immortality. With the promise of Reality TV stardom, they lure three young women to Marilyn's remote estate. Ulterior motives unfold. Early experiments prowl the estate. The young women reach a grim realization: escape is the only means of survival. Can they evade Dr. Fine's cut and paste cybernetics? Will Marilyn achieve eternal life or drown in the fountain of youth?

title: Black Sunflowers
overview: Black Sunflowers is a mosaic of Ukrainian youth, shuttling between the frontlines and civilian life, captured by the gifted American filmmaker James Marcus Haney (No Cameras Allowed) collaborating with an esteemed Ukrainian crew.

title: Intermission
overview: Spanning nearly sixty years, Yonfan features his career in music, dance, photography, and writing through fifteen films in Intermission. This captivating cinematic journey stands as a witness to the essence of a changing world.

title: Maya Bhanekai Yesto Hola
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Três Passos para Conquistar um Esquisito
original_title: Três Passos para Conquistar um Esquisito

title: Man in Motion: The Rick Hansen Story
original_title: Man in Motion: The Rick Hansen Story
overview: This galvanizing portrait celebrates Rick Hansen, the great Canadian athlete and activist. It chronicles his 26-month Man In Motion World Tour: a 40,000-kilometre wheelchair journey that raised millions to eliminate accessibility barriers and transform public perception of people with disabilities.

title: Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors
overview: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Padre Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands in Las Islas Filipinas, rules with unrelenting toughness and insatiable libido to tame the savages.

title: America America 2
overview: America America 2 is an upcoming Kannada romantic entertainer film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar. The film stars Nirup Bhandari, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Shanvi Srivastava in the lead roles.

title: In Alaska
overview: When a suicidal Inuk teen accidentally pierces an oil pipeline with a bullet, the FBI launches a full-scale manhunt across the northern wilderness.

title: A Brief Encounter
overview: Kath, an Italian-Filipino woman, works remotely as a digital content moderator in Genoa. When she learns that a colleague in the Philippines has taken his own life—crushed by the very job that fills her own days (the endless cataloging of beheadings, torture, live-streamed suicides, and child abuse)—she initially takes two days off, then extends her break, no longer convinced she can bring herself to return to her terminal. A massage appointment introduces her to Jenny, a Filipino woman who tends to people's bodies as a side job. That scheduled hour evolves into something more—an encounter neither woman expected. Each carrying her own burdens and losses, they finally find a way, together, to stop being invisible. The screen, once capable only of wounding them, now reflects a new image: a redemptive possibility for healing.

title: Magazine
overview: A young intern faces intoxicating power dynamics at a prestigious New York City literary magazine.

title: Salvation
overview: A tenacious aspiring guru must go to extreme measures to pay off the debts he’s accrued from trying, and failing, to set up an online life-coaching business in a post-industrial Scottish town.  Exploring the world of male influencer culture and how it might be affecting the young men who come into its orbit, SALVATION blends mounting tension, dark comedy and a forensic focus on its protagonist to explore the very modern story of a delusional life coach spiralling out of control.

title: my father is a tofu
overview: Conversing in a tofu factory, a boy realize that life is just like tofu: slow and fragile

title: A Bit of Light
overview: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, an Iranian doctor loses faith in the future and resolves to end his life - but one final day among his family begins to unsettle his decision.

title: Mr. Setback
overview: A young couple, Layla and Pedro, prepare to meet Layla's parents for dinner. Pedro's anxiety about making a good impression leads him to procrastinate at every step.

title: Sounds from home
overview: When filmmaker Nathan Silver and his wife Nicole Fuentes moved halfway around the world, Nathan’s parents took up birdwatching and began sending them audio recordings from their bird identifying app. It wasn’t so much the birds you can hear on the recordings but discussions about the birds, life in the United States, and aging as a couple. From their new home in France, Nathan and Nicole began pairing these recordings with footage of the birds and life around them.

title: Los Poderes
overview: Marco is 18 years old. While his mother insists on having him admitted to a rehab clinic, he is convinced that he only needs one last chance to turn his life around.

title: Behuli
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Where Jasmine Blooms
overview: Athina is an employee at an open air cinema, while Anthi is a regular customer. Over the course of a summer, they fall in love little by little, with every different film that is shown.

title: In Balance
overview: Two young people who lost loved ones in a tragic accident, disagree on how they should pursue justice.

title: The Remotes
overview: A grieving detective finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

title: Las 3000 maravillas
overview: Pablo, a bit of an oddball – shy and obsessed with analysing the risks involved in any situation – has been waiting a year to attend a massive anime event. When the big day finally arrives, his troublesome brother asks him for a life-or-death favour: he has to go to ‘Las Tres Mil Viviendas’, Seville’s most dangerous neighbourhood, to retrieve a rucksack. Pablo will have to decide whether to put his life on the line to save his brother or attend the event he’s been waiting for all year.

title: Chrysalis
original_title: Mãi Nợ Một Lời Tạm Biệt
overview: In war-torn 1970s Vietnam, a resourceful young boy navigates his place in a chaotic world, guided by his grandmother’s wisdom while haunted by memories of his fractured family.

title: Tainted Blood
overview: A vampire is overwhelmed by her greed of blood.

title: How to Generate a Perfect Crime
original_title: 5秒で完全犯罪を生成する方法
overview: After his sister, Sara, accidentally kills her threatening teacher in self-defense, Wataru makes a desperate decision to protect her. He uses an AI chatbot to generate a plan for the "perfect crime," staging the crime scene and covering up evidence based on the AI's instructions to make it look like a random homicide.

title: Gator Face
overview: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

title: The Nest
overview: Marta, a woman so obsessed with protecting her family from outside danger that she decides to keep her mother and young son locked away in an isolated house high in a mountain village.

title: Amorphophallus
overview: Artūras finds his serenity by reviving discounted plants in his garden. Considering the Lithuanian climate, one of those plants is an exotic one— Amorphophallus. It is known for its distinctive smell, which reminds of rotting flesh. Artūras, however, is used to this, as he works as an autopsy technician. His sensitive view of the world merges the contrasts of both life and death. He shares his genuine thoughts, buried beneath work that most of us find resentful. Just like the smell of the corpse flower.

title: Anfa 8
overview: In the city of Soli, ruled by Anfa 8, where night is eternal, Horus hunts a renegade cult of solar worshippers who are desperately searching for the sun.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Snared
overview: Join us on a journey around Auckland oceans and beaches, uncovering the impacts of fisheries on ocean ecosystems in New Zealand. Discover the balance we need to protect ocean life and appreciate the beauty of our marine life.

title: Go Team!
overview: Gracias, equipo follows a struggling Spanish cheese company whose rural team-building retreat spirals into betrayal and layoffs, satirizing office politics and corporate absurdity.

title: Girl Group
overview: A pop diva, kicked out of her own group's reunion tour and slapped with a community service court order, seizes the chance to stage a comeback by coaching a group of misfit teen girls for a major record label audition, only to push them too far, forcing her to confront her toxic industry — and her own streak of self-destruction.

title: Glaxo
overview: Chivilcoy, 1957. In a quiet Argentinian town, the arrival of an ominous former police commissioner and his seductive wife fractures the bond between four inseparable young men. Decades later, the past resurfaces, forcing them to confront old wounds, guilt, and the possibility of revenge in a country which has lost its innocence.

title: Singh vs Kaur 2
overview: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

title: The Death of Time as We Know It
original_title: The Death of Time as We Know It
overview: Daisy finds a mysterious amulet which she believes is altering her perception of time.

title: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?
original_title: ネルソンさん、あなたは人を殺しましたか?
overview: Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson returns with severe PTSD, winding up on the streets before crossing paths with Dr. Daniels of the Veterans Affairs who sets about trying to help him.

title: Blood Moon
overview: Across a single night, a ghost and a vampire drift through a haunting, music-driven meditation on belonging, finding love, tragedy and resurrection in a living–dying–living world.

title: Video
overview: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

title: Sound! Euphonium: The Final Movie, Part 2
original_title: 最終楽章 響け！ユーフォニアム 後編
overview: The second part of Sound! Euphonium: The Final Movie.

title: The Smell of Apples
overview: In the insulated bubble of white Apartheid South Africa, Marnus, a sheltered 11-year old boy accuses the grandson of his family’s domestic worker of steeling his fishing rod. A brutal chain of events is set in motion, shattering the illusion of his family’s wholesome facade.

title: Haiwaan
overview: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: Morten
overview: A coming-of-age tale told in a magical-realism style about a teenage boy, Morten, who feels out of place among his wealthier classmates. While they enjoy expensive school trips, he spends his days in his family’s dilapidated farmhouse, finding solace only in a camera gifted by his grandfather, a lens through which the world seems brighter. When two girls enter his life - Miia, a street artist, and Emilie, a mysterious girl from the marsh - Morten’s world is turned upside down as he struggles to understand both his first stirrings of love and the changing world around him.

title: Lionel
overview: Lionel agrees to travel with his estranged father to visit his sister in France, a simple road trip becomes a turbulent reckoning amid unknown roads and unspoken memories.

title: The Julia Set
overview: Julia, a gifted mathematician, navigates the cutthroat world of academia. Pascal, a teaching assistant, recruits her to join an exclusive training program for the prestigious and notoriously difficult Putnam mathematics competition.

title: Primetime
overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

title: Don't Move
overview: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

title: Idda
overview: Adele and Sofia, childhood friends now in their thirties, reunite after years apart to fulfill a dream they once shared: reaching the summit of Mount Etna. But something feels off, and a bitter confrontation breaks out, opening old wounds and unveiling deeply buried secrets. They separate just as the volcano begins to tremble. Adele presses on alone, haunted by the wish that she had turned back and reached the crater together with Sofia to listen to the mountain’s magical breathing.

title: Low Expectations
overview: At the height of her music career, Maja falls apart and has to step away from her ambitions. Depressed and broke, she moves back home with her mother and works part-time at a local high school. Far from the spotlight, wrapped in everyday kindness, she slowly finds her way back to life.

title: What Love Builds
overview: Follows Crowe's passion for music and his efforts of maintaining it alongside his acting career, showcasing him and his band on their recent tour in Europe, as well as previous shows in the US, UK and Australia.

title: The Nation's Gambit
overview: Norway's Prime Minister is kidnapped by a terrorist who makes only one demand. That the politicians in power are playing a game of chess over the Prime Minister's life. Each chess piece represents people who work for the state or leaders in society. If the politicians win the game, the prime minister will live, but every piece lost on the chess boards means the loss of a human life. The politicians and their appointed rescue team, the Delta Squad, are faced with an impossible dilemma: Can they afford to sacrifice human lives in an attempt to save the Prime Minister? With only 24 hours to win the game and save the prime minister, they have no choice but to play the deadly game.

title: Beporoya
overview: The return of Adrit Roy.

title: Blue Baby
overview: A specialist nurse is given responsibility for a baby boy with a serious heart condition in the middle of nurses’ strike. She is left balancing between her own family, the baby boy and her loyalty for nurses’ cause.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Dahaan
overview: A malicious ancient spirit is unleashed in a haunted mansion. The girl's elder sister and younger brother team up with a pastor to find a way to end the curse which slowly consumes the girl who opened the box.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Pension Patta
overview: A heartfelt story of identity, family, redemption, and the transformative power of humanity, where a simple pension document becomes the beginning of an extraordinary journey of self-discovery.

title: The Highway
overview: While driving to a business dinner on the outskirts of Chongqing, Boss Li passes the body of an elderly shepherd killed in a highway hit-and-run. Pressed for time, she continues on her journey—but the encounter refuses to leave her. Unable to move on, she returns to the scene. What begins as an attempt to make sense of one stranger's death gradually becomes a disorienting journey where memory, guilt, and reality begin to dissolve into one another.

title: Bad Parenting
overview: Two young boys, from out of town, are left in the car by themselves while Daddy paddleboards in the sea. What will they do when a mischievous local youth lets himself into the backseat?

title: White Shirt
overview: The son of businessman Vahram Stepanyan, Mark, runs over a man while intoxicated, an incident that becomes life-changing for all the film’s characters. To help his son avoid punishment, Vahram has Mark admitted to a psychiatric hospital, where he meets Sally, a young woman who has been living there for a long time, and falls in love with her.  Determined to get Sally out of the hospital, Mark orchestrates their escape. The two set out to find Sally’s mother, but the journey proves difficult and is filled with challenging trials.

title: Domeownation
overview: A cat performs a satanic ritual to dominate the world.

title: Alone
overview: There are places where time seems to stand still. A father and son live there, their lives shaped by the rhythm of a small river crossing, everyday routines, and a silence that speaks louder than words. As the seasons pass, one truth becomes impossible to ignore: time never stops, and eventually we all must say goodbye.

title: Сила слова
overview: A documentary film reflecting on poetry and poets - from recognized classics to new names. The participants in the film were masters of poetry and literature researchers - Yuri Kublanovsky, Konstantin Kedrov, Dmitry Vodennikov, Maya Nikulina, Andrei Vasilevsky, Yuri Kazarin, Pavel Kryuchkov.

title: Бүркітші
overview: No description

title: Позывной «Аскет»
overview: A group of saboteurs infiltrates a chemical plant to carry out a terrorist attack. Their cunning plan is thwarted when a former Russian special forces officer with the call sign "Asket" crosses their path.

title: What Belongs to Others
overview: Kasia earns her living by breaking into other people's homes. One day on the job she finds a dead body of a man and decides to move into his apartment and find out who he was.

title: Ground Floor
overview: Follows Kristóf, a man who discovers black mould covering his apartment wall and begins questioning neighbors about leaky pipes, triggering events that turn his world upside down.

title: Haje
overview: Hoping to settle in Gunsan, filmmaker Hwang Yun encounters the ruined village of Haje in 2018. Nearly every resident has left, but Jeon Jin-hyeon remains, resisting eviction by the Ministry of National Defense. A 600-year-old hackberry tree, another of Haje's last inhabitants, is threatened by expansion of a U.S. military base. Peace activists gather to protect it, and Yun joins them. As dangerous weapons arrive at the base, they hold the monthly Paeng Paeng Cultural Festival, seeing Haje and the tree as a frontline of peace. After more than five years of effort, the tree is designated a national heritage site.

title: Emperor
overview: After taking a deserted Moscow, Napoleon occupies the Kremlin, where his loyal General Michel Clément, a descendant of a Russian boyar who came to Russia believing in the justice of Napoleon's campaign, constantly stands by his side. Meanwhile, the monks of the Chudov Monastery plot to assassinate the emperor by mining the Arsenal, and the young noblewoman Maria, seeking revenge for her dead brother, attempts to shoot Napoleon. The failed assassination attempt brings her into contact with Michel and the Polish officer Józef Sadok. Disguised as an actress in the monastery, Maria finds herself drawn into a dangerous game where rescue, suspicion, and a budding bond with Michel gradually change the fates of all involved.

title: Wolf Ticket
overview: A down on his luck man purchases the secret to success: a ticket that turns the buyer into a werewolf.

title: The Resident
overview: A caregiver trainee accidentally mentions a wealthy patient in a mansion to her boyfriend in debt. He and a friend plan to rob the place, but discover things aren't what they seem once inside.

title: Dushi Curaçao
overview: Roos travels alone to Curaçao to distance herself from her life in the Netherlands — and from her fiancé Roel, with whom she no longer feels a connection. While those around her believe they’re the perfect couple, deep down Roos knows it’s over. On the island, she meets Stijn, a defense worker, with whom she shares an intense connection. But Roos hides her background and invents a new story about who she is. As the island pulls her further away from home, the truth threatens to catch up with her.

title: Silence
overview: After his stand-up routine goes awry, Luka goes to drink his sorrows away in a bar. There he meets a mysterious woman in a bar, with the two immediately hitting it off and deciding to go to the former's apartment together. However, as the night goes on, what was supposed to be a one time hook-up leads to the two discovering much more about themselves and they form a powerful spiritual connection.

title: Angelo Azzurro
overview: Short film directed by Tommaso Acquarone.

title: Ceviche
overview: It tells the story of what the ceviche vendors themselves wanted to share, encompassing everything from myths and historical facts to funny and sad anecdotes. The film also aims to raise environmental awareness, revealing extinct marine species and promoting the protection of wildlife against overfishing.

title: Jangan Lupa Bahagia
overview: Ulla (Alghifahri Jasin) must become the backbone for her two younger siblings, Imma (Jasmin Risach) and Ikbal (M Aqif Difullah), after their parents pass away. They are staying in an empty house owned by their father’s best friend. Ulla is determined to keep her two younger siblings in school to fulfill the dreams of their late parents. To make ends meet, Ulla works hard as an online motorcycle taxi driver. But a setback occurs when her cell phone—her primary tool for work—is severely damaged after falling and being run over by a motorcycle. At the same time, they are forced to leave the house where they’ve been staying because the homeowner’s child has decided to sell it.

title: The Apple is Poison
overview: A man finds a mysterious yet threatening note in a bunch of apples.

title: A Place Like Home
overview: A son reconstructs his childhood home in a film studio to understand why his family fell apart. Can one change their fate by reliving the past?

title: Voice of the Heart
overview: Zheka is a war veteran from a small southern town who fixes cable TV and occasionally raps at local weddings. Returning to civilian life, he is completely alone and sees no prospects for his own future, until he learns that he has an 8-year-old daughter he never knew about.

title: Santo António - O Casamenteiro de Lisboa
original_title: Santo António - O Casamenteiro de Lisboa

title: Ratrace
overview: What would you do if you found a bag full of money?

title: Bloom
overview: Leo, a shy young florist, knocks on the wrong door during a flower delivery and meets Noah, a charismatic dancer. As their unexpected romantic bond deepens, Leo embarks on a journey toward love, adulthood and self-acceptance.

title: Trick
overview: Successful illustrator Daniele Mallarico travels to Naples to look after his four-year-old grand-son while his daughter is away for a few days. What begins as a simple babysitting job turns into a subtle psychological duel, as the child’s boundless imagination slowly unsettles him. Trapped together in the apartment, Daniele is forced to confront something far more disturbing than a mischievous child: the fear of aging and the loss of creativity. Through this strange encounter, he may rediscover the power of imagination he thought he had lost.

title: The Return
overview: Ivan and Ana, a young couple from Belgrade, arrive to Begaljica to sell their grandfather's old house. The rural idyll, as well as meeting a friendly grandma, affects their relationship.

title: KitKatClub: Kinks of Berlin
overview: The story of the legendary Berlin club and its founder, a woman whose life is inextricably interwoven with the bright and dark sides of a hedonistic lifestyle.

title: Dear Ajayi
overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

title: Между нами, девочками
overview: Three friends, Naika, Zhenya, and Alisa, embark on a traditional spa weekend to escape their routine and family roles, but especially their mothers-in-law. Their plans are ruined when Naika's future mother-in-law, Margarita Pavlovna, unexpectedly joins them, and the three friends' escape from reality and everyday life turns into a true test of their friendship. It turns out they all view life differently.

title: Agensi Rumah Tangga
overview: The story follows Katia, who is determined to start a domestic helper agency she names Rumah Tangga Agency ("Agensi Rumah Tangga"/ART), as she navigates various hilarious situations involving her domestic helpers as well as problems in her personal life.

title: Día Ocho
overview: Three stories of faith and hope, intertwined through time with the life of faith-healing priest Emiliano Tardif.

title: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf
original_title: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf

title: Jellyfish, The new Rulers of the Ocean
overview: Jellyfish blooms are making headlines around the world. This is due to the damage they cause to tourism, fishing and our health. How can these creatures, which are over 98% water and have no shell, skeleton or brain, expand so rapidly?  Although this is a normal stage in the life cycle of these gelatinous animals, we have to admit that blooms have become much more frequent and massive in recent decades. We're even witnessing jellyfish populations appearing in more and more regions where fish have been replaced by them, such as off the coast of Namibia, in the Black Sea, in the Sea of Japan and in certain areas of the Baltic Sea. What causes this? Why has the role of jellyfish in the ocean been underestimated, even though they outlived the dinosaurs? Are jellyfish on their way to dominating the oceans as they once did? What if they were to be the only ones left?

title: Stuffed
overview: Araminta, a brooding taxidermist whose secret ambition is to stuff a human specimen, meets Bernie, a lonely man so afraid of being forgotten that he volunteers himself, their pact unexpectedly evolves into a haunting romance.

title: Papaya
overview: Passionate about flying, a tiny papaya seed in the Amazonian forest must keep moving to avoid rooting. Through perseverance, she discovers the power of her roots, triggering a revolution that transforms her world and fulfills her dreams in an unexpected way.

title: Bernd - Operation Germanenkind
overview: An in-depth look at how fascism hides behind facades of a tolerant, intellectual and open-minded society.

title: Someone Else's Call
overview: The early 2000s. Young Natasha is torn between the pressure of her rational parents, determined to send her to law school, and her dreams of entering the Academy of Arts in St. Petersburg. A new classmate, the gifted musician Igor, helps her believe in herself and take a risk. The young people fall in love. Years later, Natasha and Igor meet by chance at an exhibition of her paintings. This brings them back to memories of their happy times.

title: Cowriters
overview: 34-year-old Moscow writer Igor Angelevskiy for the third time failed to win Russia's main literary prize. After the award ceremony, the hero's wallet is stolen, which contains the only memory of his mother. Hearing the news about the theft, 20-year-old pickpocket Aldar decides to read Angelevskiy's books and is so fascinated by them that he becomes Igor's student. The writer sees in the young man a brilliant storyteller with rich life experience. After a while, Angelevskiy and Aldar become friends.

title: River
overview: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

title: Flor Pucarina, Rebel to the Bones
original_title: Flor Pucarina, rebelde hasta los huesos
overview: Documentary about one of the greatest exponents of Andean music in Peru. This story shows the singer’s legacy based on archival footage, musical evocations, testimonials, and characters who have found struggle and inspiration in Flor Pucarina.

title: In the Heart of the South
original_title: In the Heart of the South
overview: Yura Ivalu is an ambitious Inuk multimedia artist who spirals out of control when an estranged childhood friend, Sesi Ilupaalik, forces Yura to confront the trauma she’s built her career on and the identity she built as an avenue to escape.

title: Vanishing Point
overview: Lux searches for the eraser he needs to fix his drawing, but when his attempts to get his family's attention are ignored, he begins to disappear.

title: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: Toy Gun Bandit
overview: A prank gone wrong launches a Quebec teen into a life of crime in Rémi St-Michel’s energetic and unpredictable second feature.

title: WrestleHer
overview: Women's wrestling is the fastest-growing sport in America. But it's still not fully sanctioned. In Ohio, a wrestling hotbed, girls must compete for their titles - and fight for their sport to be recognized.

title: Night Shift
overview: A night watchman encounters an unspeakable force while working at an abandoned building. His struggle for survival exposes a dark truth, dragging his sibling Kai into the terrifying events.

title: Runner
overview: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

title: No More History Without Us
original_title: Não há Mais Histórias Sem Nós
overview: Submerged in the sea of greenwashing that drowns them daily, two Amazonian filmmakers have decided to denounce, in this film manifesto, the entrails of the historical process of inventing and exploiting the forest as an inexhaustible Garden of Eden. Between Munich and Belém, they reveal how racism and prejudice, in Brazil and throughout the world, are still organised around the idea of a “savage demographic emptiness”, unable to speak for itself.

title: Viva Marília
overview: The historical, political, and social context of Brazil in the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s, and the impact of each decade on the life and work of the acclaimed actress Marília Pêra.

title: Lion Fist
overview: Martial Arts Fighter Joe goes to prison for 4 years and takes his wife's blame for a Drug Bust. After his release he finds out that his ex gave birth to his son and started a new life with a Drug Lord.

title: Iyus Jenius
overview: From legendary songs of Papa T. Bop. It follows Iyus, who lives with mother after his father's death. He has imaginary friend, Babah Tbob (only visible to Iyus), who helps him become a genius on his journey.

title: Suanggi: Ilmu Kutukan
overview: Beni, a former singer who is now unemployed and in debt to the tune of hundreds of millions, is forced to return to his hometown of Karangkas Island, Papua, taking his girlfriend Gia with him.  Beni tells Gia that his only purpose in returning is to visit Mama Lin, his adoptive mother, who is seriously ill. However, Beni actually has a secret plan to steal Mama Lin’s wealth. Since Beni’s return after 13 years, strange supernatural events have begun to occur due to the magic of Aroba, a Suanggi.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Doutor Monstro
overview: A stubborn prosecutor is tasked with putting a plastic surgeon in jail who confessed to killing and dismembering a former patient. What should be an easy case ends up becoming one of the most difficult and disturbing jobs of his career. More than presenting incontrovertible proof and evidence, she will have the challenge of making the jurors -and millions of Brazilians- forget the absurd thesis, constructed with the help of the media by a brilliant lawyer, that the defendant is not a cold-blooded killer and cruel, but a peaceful good man, driven crazy by the unhealthy pursuit of an ex-girlfriend.

title: Being Heumann
overview: In 1977, Judy Heumann leads over a hundred disabled people to take over the San Francisco Federal Building, kicking off a 28-day sit-in.

title: The Uprising
overview: In plague-ravaged 14th century England, a peasant triggers a rebellion against King Richard II and unintentionally becomes a legend of resistance.

title: Heart of Darkness
overview: Rio de Janeiro, near future. Marlow is a police officer assigned to a mission to find Captain Kurtz, a famous policeman who went missing in mysterious circumstances. Marlow has to do his mission in a boat, undertaking a dangerous journey through the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro.

title: The Oldest Person in the World
original_title: The Oldest Person in the World
overview: A decade-long global journey chronicles the ever-changing record holders of the title of oldest person alive. What begins as a portrait of longevity becomes a meditation on the passage of time, the randomness of fate, and the joy and profound human experience of being alive.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

title: The Color of the Sun
overview: A raw coming-of-age that asks what it means to belong, to fight, and to grow up among the ghosts of the past.

title: Ты мне приснишься
overview: To find a missing family heirloom, the hero travels to Mexico, where he discovers something even more valuable. And perhaps he never lost it.

title: But You Won't Notice
overview: In ’But You Won’t Notice’, the director embarks on a journey of self-discovery, unveiling the raw beauty of vulnerability and the transformative power of acceptance. Immersed in her emotional odyssey, she navigates trauma and self-discovery, revealing the healing journey of her inner child.

title: Bystanders
overview: A visual film essay explores the world of centuries-old oak trees, linking them to the human life cycle.

title: Herland
overview: In a deeply conservative Indian village where women are forbidden from stepping outside without male permission, Bhagyashree and her growing sisterhood rise in defiance, claiming their right to work and confronting generations of patriarchal control. As their resistance gathers force, the cost of being seen as equal begins to turn dangerous. How much are they willing to risk?

title: The Plage
overview: Brankec just wants to escape the horros of civilisation and enjoy his time at the beach. However, his retreat turns out to be anything but quiet.

title: Letters
overview: A hybrid documentary portraying contemporary Belarus through the individuals who have endured imprisonment, repression, and exile — voices from a silenced country, suffocated by the regime.

title: Union Town
overview: Set against the backdrop of New York City, the film follows delivery industry workers as they take on some of the world s most powerful corporate giants, touching on the challenges, joys and human elements that make this movement possible.

title: Well Being
overview: Short film written by Emir Kuliev, directed by Kevin McNally.

title: La Moula
overview: Thanks to Charlie, a cocaine trafficker, and his gangster associates, Jérôme, a struggling organized crime reporter, sees an opportunity to reboot his career. While waiting for a drug shipment near Marseille, the possible presence of a cop puts them all in danger…

title: Flesh Impact
overview: A mysterious old woman auditions for a play at a small blackbox theater in New York City. As she describes her qualifications and her acting experience, secrets about her identity and the misconceptions about her life bubble to the surface.

title: MST3K: The RiffTrax Experiments — Sting of Death
original_title: MST3K: The RiffTrax Experiments — Sting of Death
overview: The storied history of Mystery Science Theater includes many, MANY cheap rubber monster suits... and somehow, some way, Sting of Death may have the worst so far. MSTies might recognize director William Grefé as the director behind the MST3K Season 2 experiment Wild Rebels. You'll be happy to know he made Sting of Death first, so Wild Rebels was a movie he made as an even more experienced filmmaker. As an added bonus, this movie also features the aptly titled "Do The Jellyfish" by Songwriting Hall of Fame inductee Neil Sedaka. Does this tune warrant TWO extended dance sequences? Probably not, but it is an earworm that will still be drilled into your head long after the credits roll.

title: Something Seems Off
overview: A group of three teenage boys decide to go ghost hunting in their friends backyard, and when things go wrong there is nobody they can trust.

title: Something Seems Off
overview: A group of three teenage boys decide to go ghost hunting in their friends backyard, and when things go wrong there is nobody they can trust.

title: The Painting Theft
overview: What started as a simple theft of a 1-million-dinar masterpiece turns into a supernatural pursuit when two students are forced to hunt down the figures that stepped out of the frame.

title: Che Guevara: The Last Companions
overview: After the triumph of the Cuban Revolution in 1959, three guerrilla fighters followed Che Guevara in his attempt to carry the uprising beyond the island. In 1967, after their final battle in Bolivia and Che’s execution, these shadow warriors embarked on an extraordinary 2,400 km journey across Bolivia, pursued by 4,000 soldiers and navigating remote terrain in a bid to stay alive. Sixty years later, Che’s last surviving comrades recount this untold story of endurance and loyalty, in which individual destinies were shaped by the larger geopolitical currents of the Cold War. Blending rare archive footage, animation and exclusive interviews, the film brings a forgotten chapter of history into the present.

title: Il fuoco che ti porti dentro
original_title: Il fuoco che ti porti dentro
overview: Antonio, who fled Naples many years ago, has built a family and a successful career in Milan, far from his mother Angela — a woman excessive in both her virtues and her flaws, irresistible, old-fashioned and hostile like few others — who has come to visit for Christmas and seems determined to stay.  Christmas Eve dinner becomes an emotional battlefield, at once comic and fierce, bringing to the surface a past of impositions and misunderstandings. With a stubborn capon that refuses to end up in the pot, a daughter whose arrival remains uncertain, and an unexpected distinguished guest, the evening turns into a reckoning between mother and son destined to change the meaning of their bond forever: a love that burns like a fire within, one that never dies out — not even by leaving.

title: DAU
overview: Inspired by the life of Soviet physicists who created the atomic bomb, DAU tells the story of a brilliant Greek-born physicist living in the USSR from 1928 to 1968. Driven to understand the laws of the universe, Dau is soon forced to use his genius in service of the state and help create the deadliest weapon in history. In a secret research institute, everyday life is shaped by scientific dominance, power, surveillance and privilege. Increasingly stripped of his autonomy, Dau attempts to find freedom and happiness outside his marriage through an endless succession of affairs, ultimately losing both himself and his ability to love. Spanning four transformative decades, DAU is both an intimate portrait of one man and a monumental fresco of a society shaped by violence and ideology. It is a saga about the search for happiness, the price of freedom, and the countless everyday compromises that quietly shape both a human destiny and the course of history.

title: A Woman's Life
overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

title: Drawn Together
overview: Marfil Cortés, a daughter of a wealthy Spanish businessman, is kidnapped and released, leading her father to hire Sebastian Moore as a bodyguard. Despite initial clashes, they form an irremediable attraction, navigating a world where no one is who they say they are.

title: Only the Dead Fish Go with the Flow
original_title: Seuls les poissons morts suivent le courant
overview: Camille is a 6-year-old boy, but Camille feels like a girl. For Carnival, Camille goes to school dressed as a princess despite the school’s refusal to recognize Camille as a girl. The principal summons her mother for a final confrontation.

title: Purgatory: Zone of Murderers
overview: In the near future of South Korea, where it became lawless due to an economic crisis, a new authoritarian government implements the “Permanent Exile Law” to easily control the country. According to this law, death row inmates are permanently exiled to a detention center, the Purgatory, built in abandoned nuclear power plants. With a degree of self-governance granted by the government, the Purgatory gradually reaches a point where it is beyond external control, leaving the government struggling to find a solution. Yu-seong, a police officer who became a death row inmate due to the revenge for his daughter and wife, is offered a deal by the Director of NIS. Now Yu-seong must eliminate the Purgatory Boss, the king of the center, in exchange for possible pardon.

title: Are We Monsters?
overview: A gay radical outsider, a flamboyant Muslim, and a nasty single mom live in a devout Muslim area on the Thai border under decades of martial law.

title: Karlovy Vary
overview: Karlovy Vary is a beautiful city located in the western Czech Republic. Sung-Jae, the director of the film, completed the script with Karlovy Vary in mind, and his work received awards for various contests and even got investment for the film production! Sung-Jae accomplished everything he dreamed of at once. After finishing filming on the domestic set, now he only has to film in Karlovy Vary. However… all the invested production money is gone! In order not to cough up the money, Sung-Jae has to finish the movie no matter what! Will Sung-Jae and his friends be able to finish the movie without going to Karlovy Vary?

title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

title: The Devil at the Door
overview: When an ancient collective fear returns to a small town, a young man must face alone the horrors that lurk in his bedroom.

title: The Montenegro Affair
overview: In 1951, a body is found at the Peel Bassin in Montreal. An enigmatic couple; Suzanne and Daniel; tries to get rid of two private detectives, Antonio Gratelli and Eduardo Ramirez; who suspect them of being guilty of the murder of a businessman, Maxime Montenegro.

title: Drifting
overview: Hye-ja, who is struggling with her job in Seoul, dreams of moving up from a semi-basement flat to a studio apartment. Working at an insurance company's call center, she faces challenges at work due to her rough dialect and fiery personality. To borrow money for the move, Hye-ja travels to Busan to see her mother, but no matter how hard she knocks on the door, her mother does not answer.

title: Place to Be
overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

title: Blanket Wearer
overview: The protagonist sets out to find ways to survive without money. She lives in squats, feeds herself by skip-diving and works in organic farms. Leaving the UK, she hitchhikes across Europe. Travelling with hippies, she reconnects with nature and opens herself to go with the flow to find peace. She continues her journey toward the East and becomes closer to her true home.

title: Goodbye Cruel World
overview: Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.

title: The Face of Hwanhee
overview: Hwanhee wanders around looking for something. Her journey becomes a story, then she ends up losing the story.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: Gill
overview: A boy called Gon was on the verge of death, when suddenly gills started to grow and he could breathe again. Kang Ha and his grandpa rescue Gon and together they become an odd family.

title: Guria
overview: GURIA (its a region in western Georgia) is an astute dramedy about everyday life in a village in western Georgia. This poignant, yet humorous slice of life, brims with charming, loveable characters – fighting against all odds to live a proud and joyful life. Guria champions ingenuity, kindness, and the eternal search for love despite a raging civil war. Though set after the collapse of the Soviet Union, it is a timely reminder of how shared humanity and compassion are the truest measure of our capacity.

title: Shells: Shaped by Nature
overview: Since the dawn of time, Nature has sculpted the oceans with her delicate hand, weaving the tapestry of life in the shimmering depths and sunlit shallows. With infinite care, she conjured snails and mollusks to inhabit diverse marine realms around the African continent, each a reflection of her boundless creativity and wisdom. These delicate spirals, with their tender curves, ensnare our imagination, inspiring art, shaping cultures, adorning garments, and even serving as currency in ancient economies. "Shells: Shaped by Nature" is an artistic tribute to the enigmatic splendor of shells, celebrating these intricate marvels that grace Africa’s marine realms.

title: Biff the Human Slayer
overview: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

title: Dust
overview: He wanders around the Comb of the Wind, where the sea rises and breaks against the shore. Along the way, he passes an old Basque farmhouse, a silent man, a woman drinking water, a woman smoking, punks gathered in a rock bar, and people in the ancient city at sunset. The Diamond Sutra speaks of all living beings in these words: "Specks of dust are not specks of dust; therefore, they are called specks of dust".

title: On The Edge
overview: The main character of our film is Ilyas Sharbuzov, an intensivist from Dagestan, and his family. Ilyas is a perfectionist, and if an emergency occurs, he always tries to be at the epicenter to help. Ilyas's wife, Aminat, worked in the intensive care unit, so she tries to be understanding of her husband's work. His young daughters have also become accustomed to their father's work schedule. But everything changes for Ilyas and his family when he is sent on a mission to a military hospital in a war zone.

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity The Fool
original_title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity The Fool
overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

title: Racism In A*t
overview: When an organization that hunts prejudice in art finds its next target, silence is no longer an option.

title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
overview: New comedy special from Stavros Halkias, part of his 'Dreamboat' tour.

title: I Matter
overview: As she stands on the verge of leaving the orphanage she called home, Rebeca, a young Roma girl, clings to the hope that her father's release from prison will finally give her the family she has always longed for. When she is accepted into university to study acting, life finally seems to be opening up for her. But just as Rebeca begins to find her place in this new world, the life she comes from starts to catch up with her, forcing her to make choices she can no longer postpone.

title: Company
overview: A mysterious traveler tells a story that spans generations, drawing together the lives of three wounded souls struggling to choose between vengeance and forgiveness.

title: Under The Rug
overview: A man hides a dead body in his apartment and he suspects everyone who comes to the door knows what he did.

title: Boatbuilders
overview: In a set of buildings on a remote Maine harbor, some 60 workers bend wooden planks around a frame, make perfect cuts with their saws, and sand edges to create flawless joints – processes that culminate in the stunning wooden vessels made at the Brooklin Boat Yard. These boatbuilders are among the finest in the world. They are also the friends, fathers and husbands within Brooklin’s close-knit community.

title: I figli della scimmia
overview: Dario, father of a disabled child, begins to receive attention from his brother's teenage son, discovering that he prefers him to his own. In the growing complicity with his nephew he finds the son he would have liked to have, he takes on the role of the father he could have been. An illusory and dangerous role-playing game that will put the entire family at risk.

title: Arrested Memory
overview: Lee is a superstar police detective in Taipei. After losing his team during a crime investigation, he is haunted by guilt and transferred to a rural police station. Traumatized by the incident, Lee develops amnesia—but is determined to keep it a secret. Soon, he is assigned a new case: the kidnapping of the son of an influential Japanese businessman. As his memory continues to fade, Lee can only rely on his instincts—which, against all odds, lead him to the criminals.

title: The Spirit Lock
overview: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

title: They're Here
overview: They're Here is a horror film that follows Edén Villa (pseudonym) and anonymous Minneapolis residents as they evade and resist the paramilitary occupation of their city. Told in the tradition of dystopian cinema, They're Here is set in a winter landscape where masked agents abduct children, residents travel in trunks, shackled prisoners are loaded onto airplanes within eyesight of vacationers, and bicyclists track the movements of an invading force.

title: The Sound of Us Fading
overview: A quiet, introverted teenage boy records small sounds because he seems afraid to forget. When he meets Mara, a mysterious girl that is interested in his strange hobby, he slowly discovers more about Mara and about himself.

title: Roadside Assistance
overview: A short film that explores the awkward reunion of a couple dealing with a HIV diagnosis.

title: Conversation with the Sea
overview: In Jerusalem, Kamal, a 60-year-old Palestinian man, is ordered by an Israeli court to pay a large social security debt allegedly owed by his son Wael. But Wael drowned in the Red Sea decades ago. When no official record of his death can be found, Kamal follows the only remaining lead to uncover what happened to his son.

title: Караоке
overview: On a small island in a big ocean, two-meter-tall Ilya dreams of love and sings karaoke hits.

title: Under Your Skin
overview: The documentary explores how ordinary tattoos have transformed into a manifesto of national identity and a symbol of resistance for Ukrainians during the war. Through candid stories from military personnel, paramedics, and civilians, the film reveals the true price of freedom of expression amidst the Russian invasion. For the occupiers, patriotic symbols on the body became a mark for torture, turning the fundamental human right to be oneself into a brutal choice between life and death.

title: Peta Joy In...I'm Not A Lesbian
original_title: Peta Joy In...I'm Not A Lesbian
overview: Growing tired of her mediocre DL Trade, Peta Joy retreats into homoerotic female friendships while refusing to admit she's a lesbian.

title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
overview: The first ever WWE Sunday Night's Main Event takes place on Sunday, September 6, 2026, live from the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia during Labor Day weekend. The special television event streams live in the U.S. on Peacock starting at 8 p.m. ET.

title: Без мамы
overview: 25 years ago, Nadezhda's mother deprived her of parental rights. She took her daughter's three children and began raising her grandchildren. Their grandmother became the children's only fond memory of their childhood. She's long gone, but Nadezhda's children still reminisce about the years they lived without their mother.

title: La calle del amor
overview: Deisy is a teenager who believes she has found in Felipe—a truck driver older than she is—a chance to run away from home. But her decision will have consequences that will shape her forever.

title: The Haunted Hunter
overview: A hunter is terrorised by a temporarily unseen entity.

title: Сила сигнала
overview: Yury Ivanov works as an electrician at the Kolpashevo post office and Novoselovsky village council. His dreams of travel and vibrant festivals could have been dashed by the reality of provincial life, but Yury has the courage and skill to become an agent of his fantasy world, an "engineer of miracles," bringing joy to the streets of a remote Siberian town.

title: Гаркуша
overview: Seven years after their first shoot, young director Katya returns to her hero, musician Oleg Garkusha. However, the attempt to make a sequel turns into a frank conversation, where the camera proves to be merely a pretext and a mirror for the real reason for their meeting.

title: На обочине
overview: Photographer Alexander one day meets a homeless man with the same name, who has been living in a broken-down car in the Moscow region for six years. Bringing the homeless man the most scarce commodity—books—they become close, and Alexander begins a photo project about him.

title: Реальное время
overview: A poetic documentary about the perception of art, the nature of time, and the subtle distinction between image and the viewer's inner experience. Through the changing seasons, the silence of museum halls, the gazes of visitors, and pictorial imagery, the film explores time as a nonlinear medium in which the past, present, and eternal coexist in a single instant.

title: Неснятое
overview: Stories about a small town and its people who use cameras to capture images in hopes of preserving them. A film about how cinema becomes a repository of memory.

title: Отец и сын
overview: An elderly altar boy from Smolensk can't stop thinking about his son's fate. But while the father looks back, the son tries to find himself in a world that has changed for him.

title: Hombre al agua
overview: Thousands of kilometers apart, two married colleagues meet during a corporate crisis, sparking a passionate connection that makes them question their lives and choices.

title: Life of Jorge Luis Borges
overview: A biography of Jorge Luis Borges working from an exhaustive review of the papers he left, the books he read, the places he went to. And with this, an attempt to decipher a very peculiar life: someone who lived like a hidden, underground warrior, whose cause was literature, literature conceived as a kingdom and as a landscape. If Cold War spies fought from their desks or from an uninhabited house to defend their half of the world, Borges strove from a library to elevate and broaden the territories of his own tribe: the people for whom the most important part of the universe is books, plots and words. This film is devoted to that secret pilgrim (to borrow from Le Carré, the king of all spies).

title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~
original_title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~
overview: Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on September 6, 2026 at Togane Arena in Togane, Chiba, Japan.

title: Friendly Fire & Other Assorted Songs
overview: William JOSÉ unwittingly attracts vultures. Disgusted, he hitches his belongings to a trailer and sets off, but an accident interrupts his escape. Unable to continue his journey, he must confront the beasts pursuing him in a tumultuous and revealing conflict.

title: NECROPOLIS
overview: A Stone Tape film inspired by the yellow fever epidemic in 19th century New Orleans, using analog camera techniques and contact microphones to excavate the material traces of trauma. Coined by archaeologist and parapsychologist T.C. Lethbridge, Stone Tape Theory posits that material objects record traumatic events of the past… and that they can be played back.

title: Unbound Voices
overview: Village cadre Zhou Qinzhi and volunteer teacher Feng Ji overcame difficulties together to set up a choir, enabling girls in the mountainous areas to grow up amid life’s hardships and care from society.

title: simulacra
overview: A Super 8 reel found and violently treated with chlorine. Destination Tokyo—a wartime propaganda film starring Cary Grant—serves as the seed for an almost ready-made film. The revenge for Pearl Harbor, or the atomic bomb is here anticipated. Alternative history and propaganda in the age of paranormal paranoia. The empire has always been here.

title: The Studio
original_title: 더 스튜디오: 바퀴 위 공간에서, 땅 위의 공간으로
overview: The documentary chronicles Hyundai Motor Company’s ten-year journey of extending its vision beyond mobility through architecture, creating meaningful experiences on the ground.Through six Hyundai Motorstudio locations—each shaped by the unique character, culture, and community of its city—it explores how architecture can transform places, connect people, and enrich everyday life. More than branded spaces, these studios reflect Hyundai’s enduring commitment to local identity, artistic expression, and sustainability.

title: Ma the Matician
overview: Musician Pi has lost the story he once wanted to convey through his songs. With the core of his creativity gone, he drifts without direction. Heo-su, who loves mathematics, devotes himself to his research while extolling its beauty. He dreams of Paris, a city where mathematics coexists with history and the arts. Recognizing the extraordinary potential of both individuals, Lee harbors an ambitious vision: to build a multidisciplinary cultural and arts collective around them and orchestrate something on a grand scale.

title: LONDON
overview: London, a disabled young adult, has built his life around fierce independence. He works as a dominant at a fetish house alongside his crippled friends Luke and Lilá. When a medical consultation offers London the chance to understand his body and disability through an exam, he faces an unexpected dilemma. He craves answers but fears a diagnosis will reduce his identity to a clinical label, threatening everything he’s fought to build.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: 25 Cats from Qatar
overview: The nation of Qatar has a street cat population equal to the entire human population of the entire country – and is growing fast. Disease is rampant, and local adoption is rare. 25 CATS FROM QATAR follows one mission – led by a network of multinational underground animal rescuers in Doha and a Milwaukee flight attendant/ cat cafe owner – to transport out 25 lucky felines and find homes for them abroad, all the while searching for a long-term solution to the crisis.

title: Glow With The Flow
overview: Carrying her late wife’s final wish, 70-year-old Lucy returns to Hong Kong and meets 20-year-old Ellen, finding unexpected solace as they navigate grief, longing, and a fleeting connection.

title: As It Should Be
overview: During a Lunar New Year reunion in Hong Kong, Megan returns from abroad, quietly seeking acceptance amid family traditions in a tender story of love, family and gentle understanding.

title: PROCESS: The Evolving DNA of a City, Kumamoto
You Know, It Happens
overview: This film explores the lives of orphanage graduates facing adult life alone — and those who support them. Through personal stories, it builds a layered portrait of coming of age, social struggle, and the power of care in shaping a future.

title: Nothing Ever Leaves
overview: Nothing Ever Leaves tells the story of four friends who, after a tragic loss, try to cope with their grief together. As guilt, anger, and denial threaten to drive them further and further apart, they must confront the past in order to find a way forward.

title: Cave Of Dreams
overview: Pyotr is a speleologist. He has a family and a job. But in a remote cave in Bashkiria, among sheer cliffs and underground rivers, there is a place that has become a refuge for him from everyday life and a portal to the past, where he can hear his own voice again.

title: The Sun Burns Incandescent At Night
original_title: 黑夜裏的陽光特別毒辣
overview: A film student channels feelings for his roommate into a romance screenplay, but as fantasy and reality blur, he confronts imagination’s limits and emotional cost.

title: Surviving the Silence: The Roxane Gay Story
original_title: Surviving the Silence: The Roxane Gay Story
overview: When 12-year-old Roxane moves with her family to what appears to be the ideal suburban community, her life is forever changed after a devastating act of sexual violence. As she grapples with the lasting effects of that trauma, Roxane turns to food as a means of survival, beginning a lifelong journey to understand her body, reclaim her voice and confront a society that often defines women by their appearance.

title: Halloween Bird
overview: On Halloween night, a deaf girl and her grandmother carve pumpkins and wait for trick-or-treaters. They are about to receive a menacing visitor.

title: Changing Room
overview: Ayoub, 16, is getting ready for his first swimming lesson. Obsessed with a bodybuilding video, he uses a marker to draw the outlines of the muscles he doesn’t have. But he’s running late and has no time to wash the drawings off before heading to class.  Before getting into the pool, he’ll have to go through the changing room and undress in front of everyone.  Ayoub is not ready.

title: A Bitter End
overview: Mabel, a struggling artist, has reached the age of lost illusions and must face reality. Just after moving in with her boyfriend, she feels an irresistible urge to run away. Returning to the artist squat where she once lived, she weaves an intimate lie to test her loved ones’ reactions and try to reconnect with them.

title: What We Saw
overview: A boy has died. On the final day of his brief life, the story traces not only his fading memories but also those of Mujin, the teacher who held him dear.

title: Sunflowers in Sorrow
overview: After many years apart, Sue and Paula, two former wrestlers in their seventies, reunite for one last motorcycle road trip to their childhood home. Unspoken words will eventually burst.

title: Numakage Public Pool
overview: For over five decades, a beloved Tokyo suburban pool affectionately called “the ocean” offered health, joy, and belonging to elderly swimmers, families, and the local gay community. But when urban development forces its demolition, a wave of grief sweeps through those who called it home.  Through powerful, intimate moments, this deeply human story explores loss not tied to death, but to place, memory, and identity. Guided by the five stages of grief, director Ota invites us to reflect on what it means to say goodbye not just to a building, but to a vital space of connection, healing, and shared life.

title: I Graduated Film School, But…
overview: Founded 40 years ago amid pressure to open Korea's film market to Hollywood, the Korean Academy of Film Arts (KAFA) became South Korea's first national film school. Without interviews or intervention, the film observes the school today. Moving through rigorous critique sessions, lengthy faculty review meetings, administrative meetings, and a fraught roundtable between the school and its animation alumni, it traces the conditions through which creative work takes shape.

title: The Great Skull
overview: Gu Liyan, on the verge of graduating from university, suddenly faced her father's death and had to assist her sharp-witted mother in navigating the tedious funeral arrangements. Unexpectedly, the 'Funeral Affairs Committee' secretly organized by her father before his death suddenly arrived at their doorstep... With unanticipated guests, absurd situations, and ridiculously dramatic events, the mother-daughter duo urgently needed to gather their strength to confront it all.

title: We'll Keep It Down
overview: A dumb late-night garage hangout fueled by loud music and too much smoking gets interrupted by a noise complaint. Tensions rise, paranoia sets in, and before anyone knows what's happening, the night turns ugly in ways no one saw coming.

title: Nobody Here: The Story of Vaporwave
original_title: Nobody Here: The Story of Vaporwave
overview: ‘Nobody Here’ traces the story of Vaporwave and its evolution into the internet’s most aesthetic and celebrated micro-genre — from its origins in obscure online communities to its emergence in the mainstream consciousness.

title: Intermission
overview: Hyeseon, a middle-aged woman, is preparing for a new chapter in her life by attending a community theater class when she is suddenly confronted by the return of her estranged daughter. As the two begin to live under the same roof, they come face to face with emotions they have long left unspoken.

title: Catching Rat
overview: ₩50,000 per rat. Alone on a night shift, Joohyeong puts his finger on the line.

title: Реконструкция
overview: A short essay on document, myth and reality.

title: Millennial Run
overview: In the year 2078, the Free World has fallen to the Brotherhood, a new world order that forces teenagers to compete in The Tower Run. A gauntlet from which no one has survived. But one woman is special, different from the others...

title: All Our Ghosts
overview: In the early 2000s, two friends reconnect and try to piece together the complex events that drew them far apart.

title: Dark Hollow
overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

title: The Work in Progress
overview: Follows Americans engaging in face-to-face conversations about cultural, political, economic, and generational divisions across seven states.

title: Ангельский чин
overview: Open the door to a world nearly 500 years old! This documentary takes viewers to the Novodevichy Convent—one of Russia's most famous and enigmatic monasteries, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Behind its majestic walls lies not only the country's great history but also the living, poignant stories of women who dedicated themselves to its service.

title: THE BOX
overview: Living alone in an isolated rural cabin, Max’s quiet routine is disturbed when a mysterious wooden box appears on his doorstep containing an old photograph of his home. After throwing it away, the box inexplicably returns  and with it comes a series of increasingly disturbing events. As Max begins to realise he may not be alone, he finds himself caught in a sinister cycle that has haunted the cabin long before he arrived.

title: Our Home Run
overview: Last year, Korea held its first-ever mixed-gender Little League baseball tournament. The Cheonan Junior Girls Baseball Team—the only junior girls' baseball team in the country—took part in the tournament. We captured that historic moment on camera. The girls who love baseball cried and laughed.

title: Comme Ça
overview: Having found a stolen bicycle, a young girl, Aisha, returns it back, not knowing that she is helping her brother for the last time.

title: Girls Against a Tiger
overview: While gathering herbs in a field, Jeong-sun loses sight of her younger brother. Soon after, she meets a mysterious boy who leads her on a journey through the forest to find him.

title: The Last Opportunity
overview: As a family faces mounting personal and financial challenges, they must rely on faith, love, and perseverance to overcome the obstacles threatening their future.

title: They Are Not to Blame
overview: A man who dreams of making a superhero film meets a woman upstairs who practices backward breakfalls every day.

title: Cadenza
overview: While preparing for an upcoming recital, Jimin discovers that the final page of her sheet music is missing.

title: Coincidence and Fate
overview: Unable to live under the sun, Wooyeon attends a night school. Her teacher, Chanjin, pairs her with Sangho to do homework together. As they spend time wandering the village, Sangho begins to recognize his father, Unmyeong, in the child's cough and words. Convinced she is Unmyeong reincarnated, he grows attached to her.

title: Ep.11 Reality Sandwich: No to Discrimination
original_title: Ep.11 Reality Sandwich: No to Discrimination
overview: For Episode 11, Reality Sandwich follows a lecture-performance by third-generation Zainichi Korean rapper Funi at Woori Madang, a community space where elderly Zainichi Korean women gather to sing, learn, and socialize. This episode explores memory, identity, and belonging as Funi reflects on growing up amid racism and discrimination in Japan, transforming personal frustration into music that confronts systemic injustice and fosters solidarity across generations and borders.

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

title: Misja
overview: For over 30 years, Hoshiar Ali has been clearing landmines in the Halabja region of Iraqi Kurdistan. Despite losing both his legs and his loved ones, he has dedicated his life to saving others. This is the documentary story of a man whose personal tragedy transformed into a mission of service to humanity.

title: Кто поедет в Улан-Батор
overview: "Son of Mongolia" was the title of a 1936 film. It was the first feature film, the first Mongolian feature, shot by a Soviet crew from Leningrad. It was almost a Western comedy. But then, suddenly, it disappeared. A documentary filmmaker, the director's granddaughter, travels to Ulaanbaatar to the Mongolkino film studio, which was created with the active participation of the USSR and Lenfilm. Trying to figure out where such an ideologically important film disappeared to, she meets with the descendants of the first film actors and searches for historical clues on the roads of Mongolia, where her grandfather's film was shot.

title: Your Personal Taxi
overview: A one-of-a-kind classic taxi carries passengers with seemingly ordinary lives but extraordinary stories, each journey accompanied by a song of their choosing.

title: Elephants in the Fog
overview: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

title: Phytophonics
overview: Plant matter is used to create finely detailed indexical traces on photochemical film. The traces are not only visible but also audible. Eco-punk against the abyss created by late-capitalism.

title: Ptaki Wędrowne
overview: Ryszard, a retired foreign language teacher, sets out on the final journey of his life. He chooses Kazakhstan as his destination—the place where, for ten years, he taught the native language to the descendants of Polish exiles. Upon arriving in the village of Pervomayka, located in the heart of the steppe, he learns that a delegation from the Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs is due to visit soon. There is no teacher in the village, so Ryszard steps in to prepare a welcoming artistic program with the students for the visiting officials.

title: You Rain Down on Me
overview: In a society where teenagers are required to receive a vaccine against romantic feelings, Ido falls in love with Eunha, a transfer student.

title: Left Hand Pianist
overview: While pursuing his doctoral studies in the United States, promising pianist Lee Hoon suffers a stroke that paralyzes his right hand. Returning to Korea, he discovers the possibility of performing with his left hand alone and begins rebuilding both his life and identity through music. Supported by his mother and inspired by the joy that first drew him to the piano, he overcomes his limitations and embraces a new path.

title: Body and Mind
overview: Unable to accept her lover's suicide, a woman refuses to believe he is gone. She dismembers his body and insists he was murdered. Yet the world remains haunted by his presence. As she forms a strange communion with his scattered body, fragments of their shared past resurface.
