Reality, memory, and dreams gradually dissolve into one another, blurring the boundaries between grief and truth.

title: She Saw Us
overview: When four friends discover a cursed two-headed doll in a remote forest, they unleash a vengeful witch who traps them in a place from which no one has ever escaped.

title: Skrawki
overview: An attempt to tell the story of a family emerges from archives, memory, and silence. Can a coherent story be created from what remains?

title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Sekiro: No Defeat
overview: The war-torn Japan of the Sengoku period is further fractured by conspiracy, betrayal, and bloody boss battles to beggar belief, in the anime adaptation of the award-winning video game.

title: Ephemera
overview: In a strange future, a national security agent with pyrotechnic abilities is horribly burned in battle and develops a fear of fire. She returns to action but cannot shake her fear. She undergoes experimental procedures to gain new powers and sets out to get revenge on those who destroyed her life. This film is reminiscent of such science fiction classics as Blade Runner and Ready Player One.

title: Rent in Peace
overview: When a desperate yet lousy landlord drags one of his tenants to evict another tenant from a long-abandoned house he had acquired as a property, the mission turns into a nightmare neither of them can escape.

title: Infrared
overview: Six young people wake up trapped in a bathroom with no memory of how they got there. As the confinement drags on, their guilt, fears, and latent violence surface, while the light reveals what no one wants to face.

title: Zrywka
overview: A harsh, unforgiving environment—forests covering mountain slopes and the crash of falling trees punctuated by the heavy breathing of horses. In these conditions, the bond between human and animal is put to the test. Where does the line lie between exploitation and humane treatment? How do we define our place in the natural world? This film certainly offers no clear answers.

title: DELIVERY BOY
overview: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

title: Returning to Reality
overview: It’s a double milestone for Bogdan: exactly one year since he entered rehab, and exactly one month since he left. But the long-awaited freedom brings no relief, exposing the fragility of his inner world.

title: Silent Descent
overview: 2011, Broken Anthem is a punk band in decline. Internal tensions, personal struggles, and an increasingly intrusive fanbase, they don’t suspect a thing, but their end is closer than they think.

title: Days in Colors
overview: A-jung, a bedroom artist, finally lands a part-time job as a picture book instructor at a local community center, but her class is put at risk of cancellation as soon as it begins because of a student named Hyun-jun.

title: Spiral
overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

title: The Swan and the Bat
overview: A kind-hearted lawyer is found stabbed to death. One man emerges as the prime suspect. With his confession the case should have been solved. But the suspect's son, Kuraki Kazuma and the victim's daughter, Shiraishi Mirei, both sense that something about their fathers' words and actions doesn't add up. When the suspect's son and the victim's daughter join forces, the very notion of the truth begins to unravel.

title: Chronovisor
overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

title: CHAITANYA
overview: The story of Chaitanya, the mystic saint who transformed devotion into a revolution.  The great king Prataparudra learns that God Himself is secretly present in his kingdom. He tries to meet with Him, but he must pass through insurmountable trials to earn His favor.

title: Barbara Forever
overview: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
overview: Sequel to Julia Loktev's acclaimed documentary, following the Russian independent journalists from Part I ("Last Air in Moscow") as they flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

title: Me and My Condemned Father
overview: In 2002, Cheng's father murdered his mother. He is both the son of the perpetrator and the beloved son of the victim. That afternoon, he met the children of two other death row inmates. The three of them talked about life, about marriage, and about their greatest fear: their fathers, and the death penalty.

title: Celtic Utopia
overview: The story of a new Ireland and its vibrant music scene, but also that of a postcolonial society wrestling with its heritage. A society where folk music carries both the oppression of the past and the dream of a bright future.

title: The Incomer
overview: Set on a remote Scottish island, two siblings survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded ‘Incomers’. Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

title: Operation Cronos
overview: Based on real events, chronicles the relentless pursuit of the terrorists responsible for the horrific Barcelona attacks. With a high-stakes countdown, the film dives into the race against time from the perspective of elite state security forces, as they work tirelessly to capture those behind the tragic events in Las Ramblas on August 17, 2017.

title: Super Nature
overview: We’re invited on a journey across 25 different countries, with people embracing both abundance and loss, to feel a sense of togetherness with our fellow dwellers on earth, human and non-human. Celebrating all we have and reflecting on all we have to lose, Super Nature proposes a new way of seeing.

title: P31
overview: A modern adventure and musical adaption of the book of proverbs with focus on proverbs 31 from holy scriptures.

title: Immortal
overview: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

title: The Girl in the River
overview: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

title: Jessica Frost
overview: Pursued by a ruthless, time-jumping psychopath and his squad of assassins, a young woman plagued by family secrets must journey through the desert and beyond the boundaries of reality to find out who she really is and claim her destiny.

title: The Basics of Philosophy
overview: A repressed philosophy professor grapples with lingering guilt over a decision from his past when the victim suddenly returns to his life.

title: Ernie and Emma
overview: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

title: cocoon - One Summer of Girlhood
original_title: cocoon～ある夏の少女たちより～
overview: San and Mayu are two schoolgirls living in Okinawa during the closing months of the Pacific War. Together with their classmates, the two friends are drafted into the war effort as nurses for wounded soldiers. When ordered to die for their country, the remaining members of the group escape only to face the harsh environment of a tropical paradise that has become a hellish battlefield.

title: Nature: The Call for Reconciliation
overview: Combining poetry, science and emotion, this film traces the history of life, from its cosmic origins to its evolution on our planet, through the wonders of biodiversity and the contemporary challenges it faces. Through spectacular images, Yann Arthus-Bertrand questions the paradoxes of our times and urges a collective transformation to reconcile humanity with nature.

title: Winkle Twinkle
overview: An idealistic political activist returns to a world that has changed beyond recognition, forcing him to confront the clash between his long-held beliefs and modern realities. Torn between family, ideology, and his own sense of identity, he embarks on a deeply personal journey of self-discovery and change.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
overview: The battle for Mirzapur's throne escalates as old enemies resurface and new threats emerge. Blood debts must be paid while power-hungry contenders fight to control the city's violent underworld.

title: The Kidnapping of a President
overview: In October 1930, a group of officers belonging to the Finnish army's top leadership decided, after a night of drinking, to kidnap Finland's retired first president, Ståhlberg. The Finnish people were divided in the aftermath of the civil war, and the political atmosphere was turbulent and tense. However, the kidnapping went wrong right from the start when the incompetent henchmen recruited for the job were forced to take the president's stubborn wife, Ester Ståhlberg, with them.

title: A Sunken Place
overview: A young neurologist discovers a cure for depression, only to be opposed by a giant pharmaceutical corporation determined to destroy her.

title: Hour and Twenty
overview: On Christmas Eve, emotionally distant mother Manuela's six-year-old Iván disappears from a mall. As two Guardia Civil investigators pursue the case, Manuela is driven toward a more unsettling possibility: she may be losing her grip on reality. With no evidence of a kidnapping, the case escalates when authorities uncover her criminal past — and no one claims to remember ever seeing her with a child. As time tightens, Manuela must prove her innocence before it’s too late.

title: Bad Apples
overview: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

title: Oh My Ghost! Oh My God!
original_title: 怎麼可能我家的祖先是你家的鬼
overview: A Japanese pop icon returns to her late mother’s birthplace in a mountain village, joined by a former classmate and her boyfriend. Their trek into the forest turns dark after disturbing ancestral spirits. Trapped in thick fog, fear manifests into inner demons as supernatural events unfold, blurring the line between self-discovery and a descent into madness.

title: Octopus Skin
overview: Iris and Ariel are 17-year-old twins, who live with their mother and older sister in an old house in the middle of a rocky island covered with molluscs and birds. The teenagers have grown up isolated from the mainland, in a sibling relationship that surpasses the limits of normal intimacy. The abrupt absence of their mother deeply wounds the three siblings, and Iris, moved by a strong need of separating herself from her brother, decides to go alone to the city for the first time.

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: Furies
overview: During Lebanon’s corruption-fueled economic collapse, the banks freeze millions of depositors out of their own life savings. Maro, a determined single mom, and her wild-hearted sister Dalia begin to scheme a daring, all-night heist to get their own money back.

title: 33 Steps
overview: Thirteen years after Milan Daniel suffered a serious head injury in a racially motivated attack, his assailant is set to be released. What feelings does this moment awaken in a traumatized man who, though he survived, will forever suffer the consequences of that fateful day? Straddling the line between fiction and documentary, the feature debut by Slovak directors Šimon and Anna Domček is an exceptionally cohesive mosaic of fragmentary pieces of everyday life, memories, dreams, and subjective perceptions. Besides exploring the experience of someone seeking to escape the shadows of the past – shadows that weigh heavily on future generations as well – the film also takes an unusual approach to the subject of racial intolerance.

title: Mim i jego wnuczka
overview: At the age of twenty, Bogdan left Poland following the tragic events surrounding his father's murder by the militia. He ended up in France, where fate led him to the Parisian mime school of the legendary Marcel Marceau. Marceau recognized his talent and appointed him as his assistant. After a successful career abroad, Bogdan returned to his hometown of Bolesławiec for a well-earned retirement. There, he eventually discovered a flair for the stage in his six-year-old granddaughter, Blanka. He decided to pass on his knowledge and experience by teaching her the art of mime.

title: Почтальон победы
overview: Great Patriotic War. 18-year-old field postman Azamat delivers valuable cargo to the front line every day. He knows all the secret paths in the forest and in the swamp, dreams of the feat and love of the field doctor Masha. When a military plane on a secret mission crashes in the forests, Azamat alone knows how to get to the target the fastest and sneak a reconnaissance group there unnoticed.

title: Magey Bituge Wedding
overview: The most chaotic love story ever!

title: Tikus!
overview: A group of people are marooned at an isolated wellness retreat because of floods. One by one each of them gets killed as it's slowly revealed there is a murderer among them.

title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
original_title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
overview: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

title: Time Was No Longer Patient
overview: After his high school play ends, a senior student faces his biggest fear: the realization that no amount of regret can make up for wasted Time.

title: Separada pero nunca sola
overview: It follows the story of Isabel, played by Emilia Drago, a woman who seeks to restart her life in the jungle.

title: Memories of Lightning
overview: Sibilla, a radio reporter, travels to a small town in central Italy to make an audio documentary. There, in 1982, a young woman had been killed, in an act of apparently inexplicable violence. Through voices and sounds, Sibilla evokes the ghosts of a past event, recording the last reverberations of the victim’s memory.

title: Falling House
overview: A modest family on the outskirts of Tehran faces the imminent destruction of their home as a part of a vast redevelopment project. While Rashid, the father and a prison guard, is being accused of corruption, he discovers that his eldest daughter, Ensi, is secretly planning to leave Iran to become a model. As the bulldozers draw ever closer, the tensions within the household start to rise.

title: Too Much Sugar
overview: Ryan "Holli-wood" Holliger is a charismatic, pit bull of a man with six kids by five different women. His best friend AccRite is a rapper and laborer, dealing with an unimaginable loss. They have big dreams of making their own movie about fatherhood in their working class Missouri town. Over the course of one pivotal, madcap year, the film becomes something else entirely: a vehicle for accountability, healing and self discovery for their families.

title: Burgundy
overview: The story of Burgundy’s most extraordinary characters and a celebration of the pleasure that defines their lives.

title: A Quiet Man
overview: 5 years after an outbreak that broke the world, Alan Garrick sets out to visit his wife's grave with the intention of ending his life there. Along the way he meets an unlikely companion in Max, an escaped, mute convict who, unbeknownst to Alan, killed his brother.

title: cecelia
overview: Inspired by the filmography and thought of the filmmaker Cecelia Condit, "cecelia" is an experimental short film that follows the hazy memories that torment the protagonist as an alter ego guides her toward a painful truth.

title: Autopsy: Dead Body Can Talk
overview: The story follows Dr. Sumy Hastry—a sharp, calm, and experienced forensic pathologist who handles high-profile murder cases in Indonesia. In this film, her empirical experience in forensic medicine is intertwined with intuition and supernatural phenomena that are part of her long journey.

title: The Manager
overview: The Manager reveals the hidden, awkward, and sometimes bizarre rituals surrounding performance reviews.

title: F*ck de Familie
overview: When brother Ben suddenly dies, Bo (Yolanthe Cabau) gets with her husband Saïd the care assigned for Ben's teenage daughter Emma. She wants to do this as well as possible, but clashes already quickly with the rest of the family. Everyone - Bo's parents first - thinks to know what is best for Emma. While her demanding job drives her further and further into a corner, Bo's marriage wavers and all good intentions degenerate into a battle full of old pain, new secrets and family dramas that no therapy helps against.

title: Не по-детски
overview: After a major scandal on air, popular TV host Mark Nikolaev tries to restore his reputation and sets out to find Natasha, an orphanage graduate whose victory on a music show sparks a public conflict. However, his attempt to "fix the situation" unexpectedly changes him, forcing him to confront real life for the first time outside the cameras and social media.

title: Queer Edward II
overview: Spring 1991: queer life is under attack in Britain, and Derek Jarman is turning Edward II into a radical protest film. Told through unseen behind-the-scenes footage, this is a story of the power and cost of queer visibility — then and now.

title: Les métamorphoses, au féminin
overview: A schoolteacher reads aloud excerpts from the most poignant scene of violence against women in Ovid's Metamorphoses. As the ancient verses echo through the classroom, her students begin to recognize beneath the poetry  - the myths reveal themselves to be an unsettling mirror of contemporary reality.

title: Where the Waves Took Her
overview: For many, crossing the Mediterranean is their last hope of escaping war, persecution, and hunger. As more and more women are forced to take this deadly route, a midwife is now a permanent member of the crew of a sea rescue ship. While midwife Anne-Katrin takes part in her first mission, survivors recount the horrors of their journey. Their worlds briefly collide before the rescued women step into another uncertain future.

title: Paper Plane
overview: Plot TBA.

title: Lomu
overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

title: Il malloppo
overview: Diego Viani is a former robber, well-known in the 1980s for his "unarmed" heists. His best friend is Michele Ragusa, a shabby private investigator scraping by on cases of marital infidelity. Working alongside him is Alex, an unpaid intern—a clumsy "mama’s boy" who dreams of becoming a detective despite having no talent for it.  Everything spirals out of control when Diego’s past resurfaces in the form of Salamandra, an old accomplice. Salamandra accuses him of stealing the loot from their final job: five billion lire in gold bullion that vanished into thin air.  When Salamandra dies under mysterious circumstances, Diego becomes the prime suspect. Commissioner Castrone, fueled by a long-standing personal vendetta, is convinced of his guilt. The only person who believes in Diego’s innocence is Ragusa, who decides to investigate with the help of the unlikely Alex.

title: Giaffa The Great
overview: Giacomo Falta is a man ignored by everyone, unable to find his place in the world. When he meets the charismatic Giason the Great, the man who embodies everything he has always wanted to be, he makes a dangerous decision, convinced that putting on a different face is all he needs to do to finally be seen. Thus begins a long night, in which the boundary between identity and illusion grows increasingly blurred, to the point where Giacomo's very existence is put at risk.

title: Baby Udon
overview: Inspired by a true story that touched millions of hearts, Baby Udon follows the journey of Fanny Kondoh, a young Indonesian woman who falls in love with Hajime Kondoh, a Japanese man who comes to Indonesia for work.  After getting married, Fanny and Hajime begin building a life together, embracing both its joys and challenges. As they struggle to fulfill their dream of having a child, they are faced with one heartbreaking trial after another, testing the strength of their love, especially when Hajime is diagnosed with cancer.

title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
original_title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
overview: The film SAME SUN tells the story of Wiebke Lühmann's journey from Freiburg to the Cape of Good Hope. Honest, raw, and close to the inner and outer challenges of a 430-day bicycle trip. Her journey takes her through 22 countries, Sahara storms, the rain season, the Congo Basin, and the deserts of Namibia.

title: Against The Skin
overview: In a world driven by inherited beliefs, social noise, and quiet despair, a searching mind wrestles with the question of purpose, challenging whether humanity is truly living or simply surviving until it disappears.

title: Мой папа — медведь 2
overview: A grown-up Masha decides to arrange a personal life for her father, Misha, which leads to a fight with her father, who pries into matters that don't concern her. Masha, upset with her father, runs away into the forest and ends up with a little bear cub whose parents were kidnapped by poachers. Masha's adventures begin, during which she realizes how difficult it is to be a parent, and most importantly, how difficult it is to raise children.

title: Bapakmu Kiper
overview: The story follows an 18-year-old named Ronaldhino Sujatmiko—known as Dino—who harbors anger toward his father, Warto. Warto is a former local soccer star and soccer gambler whom Dino believes is responsible for his mother’s death. Dino’s chance to leave his village comes through the Tarkam Super Cup, a soccer talent search tournament.  The conflict comes to a head when Dino’s main team is taken over by another party just before the final. This situation forces his father, Warto, to step in and form a new team made up of veteran players, despite all the limitations they face.

title: Who Truly Knows What A Life Is?
original_title: Wer weiß schon, was ein Leben ist?
overview: An actress is cast to bring Paula Modersohn-Becker, one of Germany’s most influential painters, to life. As she immerses herself ever deeper into the artist’s world, encountering key figures such as Otto Modersohn, Clara Westhoff-Rilke, and Rainer Maria Rilke, the lines between role and reality, portrayal and identification, begin to dissolve.

title: Silenced
overview: After #MeToo broke the cultural silence on gender violence, international human rights lawyer Jennifer Robinson fights against the weaponization of defamation laws to silence survivors.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Adam, a religious teacher who stopped performing ruqyah after losing his wife, is asked to save Fitri, who is being terrorized by supernatural forces. When he resumes performing ruqyah, he uncovers a dark secret behind Fitri's terror.

title: Das gewisse Etwas
overview: After a jewelry heist, a father and son are on the run from the police. They find refuge in a coach full of people with disabilities who are on their way to a holiday camp in the Alpine foothills with their carer. Without further ado, they pretend to be a missing fellow passenger and his carer.

title: Rock Bottom
overview: Gungo is a scrawny, spoiled young caveman who has lived a life of luxury as the son of the tribal chief. In an age where only the strongest survive, he’d rather perform his “Tik-Rocks” dances than hunt or fight. But when he’s falsely accused and exiled after a plot to overthrow his father, Gungo is forced to prove himself in the brutal Caveman Games—an ancient competition where strength and bravery determine who leads. Banished to a dangerous and wild land, Gungo must now train with a group of misfits he once mocked. Together, they’ll face prehistoric perils, uncover the truth behind the conspiracy, and learn that real strength comes not from muscles, but from unity, acceptance, and the courage to lead with heart.

title: Clash of the Thundermans
overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

title: Mayday
overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

title: Dissident
overview: In 1960s Ukraine, at a time when many in the Soviet Union and Eastern Bloc were re-evaluating the socialist system, Oleg is a former soldier in the Ukrainian Insurgent Army that fought against both Nazi Germany and the communist Soviet Union for Ukrainian independence during World War II. After an amnesty deal is reached, Oleg is released from prison camp and returns to Ukraine, where he tries but fails to find his place in peacetime society.

title: Ghost School
overview: Ten-year-old Rabia wants to know why her school has suddenly closed. Rumours are rife in the village and the authorities are no help. Courageously setting out to find the truth, Rabia navigates rural superstitions, local corruption and a wall of silence.

title: Darkface Files
overview: Following the brutal murder of his friend Kenji by the masked killer "Darkface"—a criminal who leaves a feather on his victims—an anxious and grieving Samuel Rosenberg becomes involved in the investigation led by Detective Vincent Moreau. When a mysterious forgotten note accidentally catches his attention, Samuel decides he cannot simply stand by. His discovery will lead him straight to the cold, damp alleyway where his friend lost his life, plunging him into a lethal face-to-face confrontation with the killer himself.

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

title: Honto ni Atta! Noroi no Video 117
original_title: ほんとにあった! 呪いのビデオ 117
overview: Upcoming 117th entry in the popular "Honto ni Atta! Noroi no Video" film series.

title: UMBRA
overview: Carlos and María Laura investigate and gather information about different femicide cases. While working on a new case, Carlos begins to piece together the story of one of the victims.

title: Back Before 3 P.M.
overview: It's a man and his place, the father in a housing estate. It's after his death. Something has been found. Not a secret, but the underside of days, recorded with obsessive precision. A daily struggle with material life and the passing of time.

title: Unification of Japan 76
overview: Following the death of acting chairman Baba (Akihiko Kuwata), Kyowakai continues its hunt for Adachi (Atsushi Arai), while the Marugami-kai and the Special Investigation Unit closely monitor their movements. As expected by Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya), Adachi contacts the Keihin Alliance's Sakagami (Yoshiki Kanahashi), prompting the Yamazaki Ichimon to stake out the group's key locations. Adachi attempts to strike a deal with Sunaga (Masataka Naruse) but flees when it falls through, escaping Teru (Yutaka Kyan) and Ryuji (Tatsuya Kishida). Himuro and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) then change tactics by kidnapping Sunaga. Meanwhile, reports pour in that Yamazaki faction members are attacking the Keihin Alliance's affiliated groups, leaving everyone to wonder what Himuro's true plan is.

title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour - Live from Paris
original_title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour - Live from Paris
overview: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

title: Eternity One
overview: ETERNITY ONE follows Mary Ella, a young girl growing up on Tangier Island in the Chesapeake Bay, where rising seas have already claimed two-thirds of the land and threaten to erase what remains. Once a thriving fishing community, Tangier now faces the collapse of both home and livelihood.

title: Have you ever thanked God?
overview: Have You Ever Thanked God is a short reflective film that gently reminds us of the blessings we often overlook.  Through calm visuals and heartfelt narration, the film invites the viewer to pause, breathe, and notice the simple miracles hidden in everyday life.

title: Saving Cherry
overview: Determined to take back control, Cherry embarks on a wild road trip with her bridesmaids and wedding planner on a mission to lose her virginity, while a remorseful Jude tries to win her back.

title: My Notes on Mars
overview: Margot, a brilliant young scientist with a troubled marriage, disappears inexplicably while hiking with her husband Sam and a group of friends. A few weeks later, she miraculously reappears the day of her own memorial service. Margot is clearly not the same as before the accident. Nevertheless, Sam sees his wife’s miraculous reappearance as a second chance.

title: The Blow
overview: Nineteen-year-old Enzo and his twenty-year-old sister Carla have been left to fend for themselves for several years. When their father, Anthony, is released from prison, Enzo sees the fragile promise of a family to rebuild, unlike Carla, for whom the idea remains inconceivable. Haunted by his past, Enzo must confront a truth he has kept hidden for far too long.

title: Abysses and Wonders
overview: Christine’s father died when she was still a small child, and she remained in the care of her sadistic mother, who beat her and abused her psychologically. Christine is still convinced that her mother hid a farewell letter from her beloved father. Jean’s father committed suicide several years ago, and left behind a lengthy letter, but Jean never found the courage to read it. Together, Christine and Jean embark on a unique road trip across the French countryside to visit Christine’s mother, and try to confront the past.

title: Sua's Home
overview: 15-year-old Young-sun, abandoned by her adoptive parents and left with nowhere to go, temporarily stays at the home of Sua, whom she met as a tennis training partner. Young-sun, wanting to stay at Sua's house for a long time, tries hard to become part of the family, but Sua and her family find Young-sun burdensome.

title: The Girl with the Leica
overview: The love story of Gerda Taro and Robert Capa.

title: A Portrait of Photography
overview: Japanese photojournalist Kuwabara Shisei boards a flight to Korea. Since his first visit in 1964 as a 27-year-old, Shisei has spent six decades documenting the turbulence of Korea's modern history: Cheonggyecheon, military camp towns, the Vietnam War deployment, and democracy movements. Now elderly, he returns, believing this might be his final journey. He carries a mission: to revisit the places and people that defined his life’s work. The film follows the photographer’s footsteps back into the heart of these historical sites.

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: By Any Means
overview: A young Black FBI agent is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa, he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur.

title: More Beautiful Than Death
overview: And death and life she hated equally, And nothing saw, for her despair, But dreadful time, dreadful eternity, No comfort anywhere

title: Onslaught
overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: The Last Patient
overview: On the eve of her retirement, Judith, a suburban doctor, opens her practice door to Aïda — eight months pregnant and having fallen out of the medical care system. Confronted with a healthcare system pushed to the breaking point, Judith agrees to take the young woman in, embarking on a night that will put all her convictions as a healthcare professional to the test.

title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
original_title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

title: After Rehearsal
overview: Three part series.

title: Jacob McLeod: Leelanau
overview: A longing artist reconnects with nature.  A single off Jacob McLeod's "MICHIGAN-20" (2026) album.

title: Aman
overview: A trans man who discovers he is pregnant on the eve of his gender-affirming surgery.

title: Drain Flies
overview: Just released from prison, Gus is looking for a fresh start; his brother Charlie, however, has other ideas - weaponising Gus's "ex-con" rep for his own ends.

title: Confinement
overview: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

title: Chameleon
overview: Father and son go to the forest - away from the city to remember what it means to be a family. A bonfire, heart-to-heart talks. But in the morning they wake up in an abandoned village, which shouldn't be here.

title: The Lion Does Not Concern Himself
original_title: The Lion Does Not Concern Himself
overview: Follows a gym coach whose toxic online persona is challenged when a new client sparks an unexpected romance.

title: Pleasant: First Look
overview: A stranded man in a hot dog costume continues his strange night in a open-late store. A proof of concept for the upcoming indie feature "Pleasant".

title: Robbed
overview: When a man falls into temptation and joins a robbery that goes terribly wrong, he descends into paranoia and tries to get rid of the money he believes is cursed.

title: Last Reckoning
overview: Despite his best efforts to stay away from crime while he's out on parole, Dan's life takes a turn when a duffel bag full of cash meant for gangsters is mistakenly placed in his trunk. With the help of his eccentric friend, he has to choose whether to return the money to keep his family and friends safe, or to run and save himself.

title: Bite
overview: Bite, directed by Nisma Qureshi, is a short film that focuses on hunger, mental illness, disease and the struggles of anorexia nervosa. It features a young girl, played by Nisma Qureshi, trapped in a room with bare white walls and is only given an air mattress with a pink floral quilt. She is consistently dressed in a floral babydoll dress with light pink ballet flats. The girl is only given an apple to eat, which clearly does not sustain her. She is forcibly wrapped in plastic wrap by The Disease, played by Camryn Halfaker. Eventually  the cycle displayed through the apple starts again, never awarding the young girl peace.

title: Farm of the Father
overview: Dorotea is a young farmer who lives in the family's farm with her father. But, the Father reveals himself to be increasingly obsessive. Stranger and more disturbing events keep happening, and Dorotea just wants to run away.

title: Numbed
overview: Fotis, a young student has to deal with problems with his relationships, work, univercity, his girlfirend, and his brother.

title: Sithilam
overview: A 15 year old lie resurfaces as a YouTuber is suddenly interested in a closed case of serial killings, doubting the testimony of the sole survivor of that murderer.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: still life
overview: This work is based on long-exposure still photographs of everyday scenes taken between 2025 and 2026. While there is no video, the accumulation of light transforms into an intense flicker that seems to break through the retina, compressing the sense of time and inducing hallucinations.

title: Happy Place
overview: A bout of lucid dreaming presents a tired student with the ability to vent his built-up frustrations on his friends in increasingly cartoonish ways.

title: Microcosmos 2
overview: This film created using magic lantern slides from about a century ago.

title: I Miss My Mom
overview: Francis visits home to care for his mother with Alzheimer’s while his father is away on business. As her condition deteriorates, she grows increasingly convinced the man living in her home is not her son.

title: Jezebels
overview: Emma, an ambitious writer joins her new friend Lucy at a secret, all-female literary society. What begins as a night of radical intellectual freedom quickly reveals a ruthless test, where Emma must decide how much of herself she's willing to sacrifice to get ahead.

title: Welcome Home
overview: A promotional film about an adventurous summer at Onteora Scout Reservation

title: Peligro Inminente
overview: When a ruthless terrorist threatens to detonate explosives across Mexico's most strategic military bases, a daring secret agent races against time to stop the attack. As the mission intensifies, he faces relentless enemies, brutal take-downs, and a heart-pounding skydiving sequence that takes the action to new heights.

title: Fugue
overview: An unnamed protagonist is transported inexplicably into a state of purgatory.

title: On the Fence
overview: Stretching more than 5,600 kilometres across the country, the Dingo Fence stands as a symbol of one of Australia’s longest-running and most complex debates. On one side, livelihoods depend on protecting livestock. On the other, a native apex predator plays a vital role in the health of our ecosystems. On The Fence is a feature documentary that brings together graziers, scientists, First Nations voices and conservationists to explore the people, landscapes and ideas at the heart of this conversation. Rather than asking who is right or wrong, On The Fence asks a different question: are we willing to coexist with apex predators and learn from the mistakes of our past?

title: Bloom
overview: When Lily inherits her great aunt's struggling desert nursery, she devotes herself to bringing it back to life. As her garden flourishes, her need to sustain it becomes something she can no longer control.

title: Hy3na
overview: After a brutal breakup, Nicole finds herself drawn into a dangerous world of online sex work where money is the driving force for extreme fantasy. Under the influence of the charismatic Rachel, her life takes a darker turn when she becomes the target of a serial killer. Detectives Dan and Hugh discover Nicole and Rachel at a gruesome car crash scene, with two dead bodies. One being Nicole's lover and the other an unidentified victim. Racing against time, the detectives must protect Nicole and unravel the mystery of the serial killer, while confronting their own demons.

title: Valley View Motel
overview: After a 1977 diamond heist goes sideways, two small-time crooks take refuge at a remote Pennsylvania motel, where a pair of bizarre sibling owners, a ruthless hitman and a night full of bad decisions turn their getaway into a desperate fight to survive the night and make it to their rendezvous before it's too late.

title: Los dos amigos, la venganza musical, creo
original_title: Los dos amigos, la venganza musical, creo

title: Soul Snatchers
overview: A man of unwavering convictions returns with his family to the remote island of his childhood to open a music school for orphaned children, but beneath the island's beauty lies an unseen darkness.

title: LOOP
overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

title: Mother and Me
overview: Casey is a young woman confined to her home, living under the same roof as her mother. Struggling to write what’s poised to be a best-selling horror novel and living in the shadow of her late father, a renowned horror author, Casey grapples with the complexities of her relationship with her mother.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: Brandon & Haider
overview: When the enigmatic allure of two ancient artifacts is unleashed, two students are bestowed with unparalleled powers. Yet, a relentless collector, driven by an insatiable thirst for dominion, will stop at nothing to seize them, igniting a cataclysmic battle that will determine the fate of worlds

title: Full Moon Rising: The Charles Band Story
original_title: Full Moon Rising: The Charles Band Story
overview: A brand new feature documentary about the incredible life and career of prolific film producer and director Charles Band.

title: Diary of an Assassin
overview: An assassin is hired by a mob boss to kill a former assassin who owes money.

title: The Blue Hour
overview: A scientific watches a star mysteriously disappear, along with him.

title: Her Baby Didn't Block Her Jump Shot
original_title: Her Baby Didn't Block Her Jump Shot
overview: In 1969, high school freshman Jane led her basketball team to a state tournament. In 1970, she scored over 40 points a game. In 1971, when she gives birth, state rules make her ineligible to play. In 1972, with the backing of her coach and friends, she continued to play and began a landmark challenge to a rule that allowed boys involved in a pregnancy to continue playing while refusing the same privilege to girls.

title: Draupadi
overview: A story about forgiveness and religion set in the grassroots Hindu culture of the San Francisco Bay Area, an Indian girl must attend a karayalu for an uncle who wronged her.

title: AAA Ola de Calor 2026
overview: Ola de Calor (Spanish for "Heat Wave") is an upcoming professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event will take place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States. The event will take place right before NXT Heatwave in the same venue.

title: NXT Heatwave 2026
overview: The 2026 Heatwave is an upcoming professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It will be the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event will take place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States. The event will take place right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

title: Frame by Frame: Back to Where Cinema Began
original_title: 프레임 바이 프레임 : 다시, 영화의 시작으로

title: Guyon Chung’s Muju Project: Muju Deungnamu Stadium
Do You Want to Play
overview: When American high school student Emily plays with an Ouija board at a party, she becomes the unwilling host for a sadistic killer’s soul who held Westlake in a grip of gruesome terror. Its cause is an Ouija app programmed by the charismatic Owen, a rich kid obsessed with the supernatural. Now Emily’s boyfriend Tommy must team up with Owen, his rival for her affections and ex-best friend - and a defrocked Jesuit priest turned occult expert - to perform a dangerous, ad-hoc exorcism before Emily is consumed by evil and the demonic infection spreads through the school.

title: Kira's Dream
overview: Twenty-five-year-old librarian Kira, who cannot realize herself in the profession, is fighting for the right to get any official job in a megalopolis in order to get an official length of service for immigrating to Australia, while trying to bring up her younger sister, with whom she keeps a «dreadful» secret.

title: The gentleman dreams
overview: A teenage boy is terrorised by grief in a series of nightmares containing a mysterious figure

title: The Morning After Text
overview: The Film reflects on our negative dependence on AI in an ever-growing, disconnected world where communication falls by the wayside and impulses lead to disastrous consequences.

title: Reel Birmingham
overview: What does it mean to pursue a filmmaking career outside of Hollywood? A portrait of the burgeoning indie film community in Birmingham.

title: From the Mountain
overview: Moving between Bongraesan Mountain in Busan and the forests of Lodz, Poland, this work explores the sacredness of nature that has commonly existed across different cultures, mediated by the Korean Mountain Spirit (Sanshin) and Leshy, the forest spirit of Slavic mythology. The camera, gazing intently at empty landscapes, quietly reveals the invisible bond that still remains between humans and nature.

title: The Day Is Not Lost
overview: As the call to prayer echoes throughout a village in Bulgaria's Rhodope mountains, a cold January day becomes a meditation on tradition and transformation high in this quiet observational documentary.

title: The Chimney
overview: "The Chimney" asks what lengths one might go to to meet Santa again.

title: A Night In
overview: When an upscale rental is accidentally double booked, two strangers discover unexpected connection during an evening of forced hospitality, psychological games, and emotional vulnerability.

title: Instant
overview: For teenage photographer Bennett, memories are made to be captured; for free-spirited Grace, they're meant to be lived.

title: Dawn
overview: In the depths of the Kenyan savannah, Malaïka, a young Masai warrior, comes face to face with himself and learns the true meaning of courage.

title: What's My Name?
overview: Do you keep your name or change your name when immigrating to another country? In this playful exploration of pronunciation, cross-cultural identity, and the nuances of language, learn the real importance of a name and its declaration of ethnicity.

title: Freedom of the Press
overview: A college professor turns to the printing press to process the weight of political turmoil as he creates prints that invite others to slow down, reflect, and reconnect in an overstimulated digital age.

title: Chip
overview: From the summit of the rock god mountain, through the iconic pop culture milestones of the 70s, there have been two constants: time and Chip Monck. But time waits for no rock god.

title: Loco
overview: At his first therapy session, Rafael Reyes relives the anxious thoughts and overbearing family that boiled over on the night of his 25th birthday. Based on a true story of false thoughts.

title: The Sisters of Scott County
overview: All Cherry Mary wants is to pass her Commercial Driver's License test and become a trucker, but after her family's criminal enterprise makes the wrong enemies. When the test starts, the trouble begins.

title: The Method
overview: To get out of the doghouse, a desperate husband hires a washed-up actor-turned-con artist to pose as a couples therapist.

title: Big Little Love
overview: Sometimes a little Love can make a big difference.

title: Dirt
overview: Composed of 300 hand-crafted ceramic tiles, this analogue stop-motion video for "Dirt" by Emory constructs a fragile universe from dirt itself.

title: Final Press
overview: Workers at The Minnesota Star Tribune complete the last run of the newspaper's Heritage printing plant bringing an end to 150 years of printing the paper in Minnesota.

title: Mime
overview: Sixteen-year-old Bri is on the verge of a significant soccer opportunity when the COVID-19 pandemic forces her into isolation. Trapped in a silent, monochrome world, Bri faces the overwhelming presence of these mimes.

title: The Prime Candidate
overview: A young job candidate participates in an interview where the questions become increasingly concerning. Unemployment may be preferable to what this company has in store.

title: Monograph: David Brower
overview: Artist David Brower reflects on his career from photographer to award-winning filmmaker and the transition from commercial work to multi-disciplinary art that feeds the soul.

title: Ādi
overview: "Ādi" (Sanskrit for "beginning" or "origin) captures the origin of the cross-cultural musical group Vishnu, Davis, & Haleigh as they discover new friendships and new sounds together.

title: Love You
overview: An exploration of teenage female friendship and all the emotional ups and downs that can sometimes lead to fights that include dresses, boys, knives, and flamethrowers.

title: Rocket
overview: A boy attempts to build a model rocket without being discovered by his father.

title: Dualists
overview: When two friends are given the lead parts in their school's play about an academy for dualists, they follow their instructor's tradition of "embodying characters" and find their friendship tested and the line between reality and fantasy blurring.

title: Grow Up
overview: When 12-year-old Kai is forced to recognize that his older brother has outgrown their childhood fantasy games, he decides it's time to grow up. But is he ready?

title: Magnacamp
overview: A look at a successful camp months after a zombie apocalypse.

title: CHAD
overview: In the current world where AI is taking precedence over thinking and relationships, Izzy finds herself on a self-journey through intense realities.

title: Hyperscaled
overview: Focused on Alabama's "Project Marvel," this documentary unearths the real world cost of AI as residents fight to get answers about the costly impacts of proposed datacenters.

title: Time Will Tell
overview: When two high school classmates are assigned to debate whether love is fate or chance, their partnership quickly blossoms from friendship into romance.

title: Sunshine on the Road
overview: Unable to continue caring for their mother, who is suffering from dementia, a family embarks on one final trip together. During the journey, a long-buried family secret quietly surfaces, forever changing their understanding of one another.

title: Same As It Ever Was
overview: When two gunmen come for Justin Johnson, he needs to choose between casual Fridays or the things that are once in a lifetime.

title: Are You Listening? Poetry in the Magic City
original_title: Are You Listening? Poetry in the Magic City
overview: Poets Ashley M. Jones and Halley Cotton spark a poetry renaissance in Birmingham, Alabama. Now, poets of all ages and levels of experience are writing, reciting, and inspiring with their artful use of language.

title: A Mess of Memories
overview: Siblings who’ve drifted apart are brought together in an effort to prevent the eviction of their mother from their family home due to her obsessive hoarding. As they deal with the physical mess, they are forced to confront their own issues on a journey of reconciliation and healing.

title: The Robot Chicken [adult swim] 25th Anniversary Special
original_title: The Robot Chicken [adult swim] 25th Anniversary Special
overview: Follows iconic Adult Swim characters on a cruise ship celebrating the network's 25th anniversary. The cruise turns into a disaster, potentially spelling a watery doom for all aboard.

title: Dwell
overview: Dwell Mobile works to resettle refugees in Mobile, Alabama. This documentary sheds light on the experiences of those whom Dwell assists.

title: Rolling Film, Rocking History: Al Maysles Captures the Beatles
original_title: Rolling Film, Rocking History: Al Maysles Captures the Beatles
overview: Remembering Al Maysles role in videotaping the Beatles, Rolling Stones, and the history of Rock History.

title: Alien Heart
overview: Miles and Ravi house sit a NASA exobiologist mansion, while running astronomy club sign ups, they discover a runaway alien on a ticking cosmic clock, bullies, and crushes that turn their summer into chaos and adventure.

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When she was 13 years old, Amy Watson watched her mother die from an incurable disease. Determined to find a cure, Amy becomes a dedicated researcher at a high-security pharmaceutical company. She struggles with OCD and a fear of heights. When her groundbreaking discovery is stolen and her partner murdered, she’s thrust into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse high in the Dolomite mountains. With no escape except across a treacherous zip wire, Amy must outsmart the attackers, face her debilitating fears, and summon every ounce of courage to protect the research – and herself – before it’s too late.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: AEW All In 2026: London
overview: All In 2026, also promoted as All In London, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on August 30, 2026, at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The event featured AEW Men's and Women's World Championship matches earned by the winners of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament.

title: Monograph: Ajene Williams
overview: Ajene Williams is a resident artist at Sloss Metal Arts (Sloss Furnaces) in Birmingham, Alabama. He sculpts and welds cold scrap metal into warm, life-like sculptures.

title: Where the River Flows
overview: For nearly 30 years, Hana Berres has walked alongside the Cahaba River, teaching, protecting, and fighting for one of Alabama’s most biodiverse waterways.

title: The Death of Us
overview: Explore the complexity of grief through a loving couple in a healthy relationship, shattered by the loss of their child during a violent home invasion at the hands of a cult. As they struggle to come to terms with their loss and its devastating impact, Casey, haunted by visions of a supernatural entity connected to their tragedy, and her partner, Danny, become entangled in the actions of the cult responsible for their devastating nightmare. Can their bond endure such unimaginable trauma? Or will their overwhelming agonised sorrow and otherworldly forces destroy them completely?

title: Reflections
overview: While rebuilding a vintage car with his young daughter, Jack begins experiencing unsettling distortions within the familiar walls of his garage. As reality quietly unravels around him, an emotional portrait of family and connection emerges.

title: The Repetition for Love
overview: Iseul is tormented by her inability to finish her latest poem when a mysterious woman appears and asks Iseul to hear and rewrite her story. Slowly, Iseul realizes her guest's story completes her poem.

title: Invasive Florida
overview: Follow wildlife educator and social media star Christian Cave into the wild ecosystems of South Florida to explore the growing threat of invasive species on one of America's most unique natural environments.

title: Gary
overview: Gary Sinise stars as the title character in this video of a man who has spent his life fixing things for others. When he discovers his own heart is beyond repair, he embarks on a daring final act of defiance against a world that has forgotten him to ensure a future for those he leaves behind.

title: The Bone Grinder
overview: Whitman and Jacob, straight and gay best friends, learn about the Bone Grinder, a masked killer who seduces men, blows their minds with amazing love making, and then murders them seven days later. Whitman wants to stop this killer. Jacob, however, knows he can fix him.

title: The Hoarder
overview: Medical student Melissa Knowles and her reluctant colleague Eric are making routine house calls to administer flu vaccines. When they step into Fred Hunt’s decaying, junk-crammed home, something immediately feels wrong. Fred seems like a harmless old recluse, but when Eric vanishes, Melissa’s search pulls her deeper into the house’s chaotic mess, revealing a labyrinth of tunnels carved through the piles of junk, twisting into suffocating darkness. And beneath it all, below the creaking floorboards, something stirs. Watching. Waiting.

title: Undermined
overview: A small Alabama town known as Belle Mina fights back against quarry blasting right next door that threaten their air, water, and overall quality of life.

title: Discarded
overview: An unsettling glimpse at what we cast aside, this quasi-experimental documentary reminds us that every discarded item had a life or moment abruptly left behind, never explained, and never reclaimed.

title: Roots & Relics
overview: Roots & Relics is a documentary series hosted by JD Hart that uncovers extraordinary stories behind everyday heirlooms. In this episode, uncover the mystery behind a man whose last words are recorded in a roughly hewn stone.

title: The Humbug
overview: Two elderly women in a care home grapple with magical mint humbugs, setting off an absurd journey through pleasure and peril.

title: "What's Up with Mick McLachlan?"
overview: Mick meets Ryan, and the two have a strong connection......or so they think. The third entry of the Mick series.

title: One Too Many Slices
overview: Krish is throwing the perfect birthday party for his girlfriend, Tanya. But while preparations begin and friends arrive, something is about to go terribly wrong.

title: Heraldry Paranormal
overview: Four paranormal investigators want to find definitive proof of ghosts within Yorkshire, but find themselves at odds with conmen, internet backlash, and terror beyond their expectations.

title: Scrambled in Space
overview: The seemingly innocent act of fixing an egg for breakfast launches into an unexpected space journey. Assisted by Professor John Hill and completed over a 48 hour period.

title: Leica
overview: When camera pioneer Ernst Leitz's defiance of the Nazi regime is discovered by the Gestapo, his daughter Elsie must navigate a high-stakes battle of the wits with a Gestapo detective to save her father's life.

title: The Burial of the Black Cat
overview: An 11-year-old girl meets her sister, who has transitioned and is now her brother. Struggling to accept this, she makes him reenact scenes from their childhood to mend their bond.

title: Pinball, Brooklyn
overview: On the eve of his wedding, Esteban returns to a Brooklyn bar that houses an unlikely old friend: a softly glowing spaceship-themed pinball machine, quietly outfitted with a long-forgotten civic AI memory system.

title: Cause of Death
overview: When technology allows coroners to relive the last moments of a person's life rather than following physical evidence, what crimes might be covered up?

title: Sweet Violence (aka Dulce Violencia)
overview: A family plans to murder their daughter’s killer after he is released from a twenty-year prison sentence. Still pleading innocence, the ex-convict tries to rebuild his life until the ghosts of the past return to haunt him

title: The Other Roe
overview: Learn the untold story of attorney Margie Pitts Hames whose Supreme Court victory in Doe v. Bolton - the companion case to Roe v. Wade - reshaped reproductive rights in America.

title: 60 Years of Selma
overview: Sixty years after the 1965 Voting Rights Act was signed into law, civil rights activists and historians gather to reflect on the movement in Selma, Alabama, that led to revolutionary change.

title: Honor Song
overview: Celebrating the long history and service of Native Americans in the United States military, veterans of the Southwest share personal stories and perspectives of their military service and their cultural experience.

title: Bleeds Through
overview: Music by Noah Praise God.

title: The Complete Howard French Course
overview: A strange encounter at a used book store leads four young seekers to a Video Course from the 1980s where they are introduced to Howard French and his twisted lessons on enlightenment: The Framework to Truly See. Over the course of a single night, the hypnotic, malevolent Howard moves them steadily along a nightmarish path of ever more gruesome choices. Do You Want to Truly See?

title: Church Hat
overview: When his traditional Jamaican mother catches him playing dress-up with her prized church hats (crowns), a young boy expects trouble. Instead, he discovers that love means being seen, accepted, and celebrated exactly as he is.

title: Capriccio
overview: Two strangers meet in a cozy bookstore where music and dance form a non-verbal language of expression and ignite an unexpected romance.

title: Submitting Tigers
overview: After surviving horrific childhood trauma and rising as a professional MMA fighter, Julija Pajic finds unexpected healing, connection, and purpose among the street fighters and orphanages of Tanzania.

title: Hwy 101 Yard Sale
overview: Every first weekend in October, along a quiet stretch of highway from Northwest Alabama to Tennessee, one woman exercises Southern hospitality through mouth-wateringly delicious pies as she participates in a 40-mile long open-air market.

title: Houdini II: A Beautiful Day to Die
original_title: Houdini II: A Beautiful Day to Die
overview: Reframing the Houdini myth, an African American magician and escape artist claims the name of Harry Houdini and builds a legacy of his own.

title: Creep
overview: In a library where nothing happens, a kid gets a creepy feeling he's being hunted by a creature of the night.

title: Jamie's Cosmic Chase
overview: Shortly after a rookie zookeeper's shift begins, a baby creature escapes its enclosure and begins to wander around an intergalactic zoo resulting in chaos and comedy.

title: Symphony in the Skies
overview: Amid the urban landscape of Birmingham, a 12-year-old filmmaker and birder discovers a different kind of world through his binoculars.

title: Chasing Dreams
overview: Raeann "Rooster" Gibbs is a rising racecar driver from Weaver, Alabama with big dreams. At the age of 12, she is currently competing against adults in 602 and 604 late models.

title: The Brook
overview: Moving to the village of his mother’s youth, art student Jacob discovers his grandad’s old video camera shows one hour into the past. In Elmbrook, a place steeped in strange folklore and whispered legends, the community believe their village is protected by a puma that watches over the “good.” But when one of the good locals mysteriously vanishes, Jacob and his friends, armed with the video camera, uncover clues that pull them deeper into Elmbrook’s bizarre secrets. Soon the search for answers spirals into a dangerous mystery as they uncover a vengeful serial killer with a connection to the past.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: The Copycat Killer
overview: A traumatized criminal profiler is lured in to investigate a copycat killer mimicking her most infamous case while being framed as the prime suspect, or risk losing her freedom and becoming the next victim of a twisted game of revenge.

title: LEATHERBACK
overview: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

title: Moonchild: The Life and Music of Yusuf Salim
original_title: Moonchild: The Life and Music of Yusuf Salim
overview: Moonchild follows jazz pianist, composer, and mentor Yusuf Salim, from his early years playing on Baltimore’s famed Pennsylvania Avenue to his celebrated contributions to the emerging jazz and Black Muslim communities in his adopted hometown in Durham, North Carolina. Salim’s deep faith and embrace of human connection transformed the world around him, even through a lifelong battle with personal demons. During Yusuf’s 60-year musical journey, he inspired and propelled the careers of award-winning musicians and vocalists with his Black Atlantic cool and mastery of the songbook. Guided by his legacy, acclaimed jazz artists reunite in Durham to honor an unsung mentor and perform Salim’s music at historic concerts.

title: Call My Agent! The Movie
overview: Five years after the series finale, Andréa Martel is now a director on her first film. Things, however, are not running smoothly. When her lead actor drops days before cameras are set to roll, she must get the team back together, rekindling all the old friendships and rivalries.

title: Doggozord
overview: The Moon has risen early to threaten dog utopia, and Major Walnut has called his team of guard dogs to pilot Doggozord, a giant canine mecha, to fight it off.

title: Tell 'Em
overview: Down in a gorge where time bends, ancestors meet beneath ancient trees. Their shared rite rises like resistance, built from soil, voice, and bloodline, proof that life holds shape even when broken. Music by Terry Blade.

title: Much About Love
overview: A TV director returns to her theater roots for a Shakespeare festival and runs into an old flame, rekindling a merry war of wits in this modern retelling of "Much Ado About Nothing."

title: Job Search
overview: A new job candidate becomes unnerved when an interview becomes too personal. Sidewalk 48-hour film Scramble winner.

title: Picklish
overview: Upon the rapid rise of Pickleball in their community, three Alabama teens decide to fight back.

title: April 6th
overview: Argentina, 1994. Ito, a farmhand, turns 18 and receives a bicycle as a gift. He dreams of winning a race to buy a guitar for his younger sister, but mandatory military service threatens to change everything.

title: Birmingham's Front Lawn
overview: “Birmingham’s Front Lawn” tells the extraordinary story of a 19-acre park that transformed the city of Birmingham, Alabama. Railroad Park is a green oasis in the middle of downtown and, from the perspective of someone living, working or playing in 2026 Birmingham, Railroad Park’s existence must seem inevitable. But that is far, far from the case. The transformation of the former Railroad Reservation into a vibrant park is a story about the power of urban planning, community collaboration, and landscape design to jumpstart civic life.

title: Growing Up in the 4th Dimension
overview: A recent college graduate reflects on the passage of time and the existential crisis it leads to.

title: Constellations of the Sea
overview: A 17-year-old filmmaker joins a Maldives-based research team to document the conservation of endangered whale sharks and the growing challenge of protecting a species at the center of a global tourism industry.

title: Binding Eva
overview: Deep in an English forest, a man on the run returns again and again to the same moment of judgement, and the same impossible choice.

title: Now and Then
overview: A college student, along with her peers in Japan, rally to change the country’s hostile immigration laws that have incarcerated asylum-seekers in deadly detention centers. Meanwhile, over a century since the 1923 massacre of Korean people during a massive earthquake in Imperial Japan, young activists today take on the torch to seek justice under a government that continues to deny this history. A filmmaker documenting these young activists on the ground begins to excavate the underlying history of discrimination that connects the massacre of a hundred years ago and the draconian refugee system in Japan. Through the process of listening to voices from the past and present, the landscapes in Tokyo begin to echo the unfinished business of the nation’s reckoning with its colonial history.

title: Lemon
overview: When her agoraphobic mother dies suddenly, six-year-old Lemon must overcome her conditioned fear and venture outside for the first time. Her journey from fear to bravery becomes a tender exploration of courage, imagination, and human connection.

title: Little High
overview: A heartbreak comedy about female friendship, accidental kidnapping, and a TikToking police officer set across one bright, terrible Nairobi afternoon.

title: Murder in the afternoon
overview: Set in 2005, Murder in the Afternoon follows friends Roman, Victor, Ethan, and Mark as they unpack their lives in a bizarrely desolate apartment complex in Eden Heights. What begins as typical roommate bickering and movie nights quickly turns into a living nightmare when they find a mysterious package containing their old home movie script alongside an ominous message. When Mark is brutally attacked in the building's forbidden basement, the remaining friends realize a real-life psycho is hunting them. Paranoia tears the group apart as they try to survive an unseen killer who considers their terror nothing more than a game.

title: Distance to Independance
overview: It's the late 1980s and the once seemingly undying Soviet Union is beginning to show signs of collapse, leaving thousands of members of the Ukrainian diaspora in the US and Canada with a chance of returning to the home they have always dreamed of living in. Afraid for their lives, but fueled by patriotism, thousands of them venture to Europe in order to provide the support to their friends relatives and their countrymen through times of crisis and violent protests, culminating in the last 99 days of the USSR and the birth of an independant Ukrainian nation.

title: Look for the Lights
overview: After a funeral, Mile's finds himself having a conversation with a blissfully ignorant girl and a man who has a healthy outlook on life, the two of them try and help him fix his pessimistic ways.

title: Willie and His Pigs
overview: Every 9 months, rural Kentucky-based regenerative farmer Willie Houston brings home a small group of piglets. He raises them, names them, cares for them, and has to say goodbye. This subtle portrait challenges assumptions of masculinity in farming and explores who bears the emotional weight of ethically raising animals.

title: Take Me to Your Leader
overview: Music by My Mom Is Here.

title: Okay? Alright.
overview: A reclusive Filipino-Korean man travels back in time to kill his pregnant mother in hopes of ceasing to exist. But in doing so, he obtains a certain hope that his life will turn out okay.

title: RevPro 14 Year Anniversary Show
overview: Fourteen years of world-class action from Europe’s number one wrestling producers have led to this. On Saturday 29th August 2026, RevPro takes over the iconic OVO ARENA WEMBLEY for its biggest celebration yet—uniting the finest British and international talent for one unforgettable night. Expect championship clashes, dream matches, and the unmatched energy only RevPro fans bring.

title: Rapid Eye Movement
overview: A beast with unspoken affection for its tamer, magician who turns birdhouses into people and people into walruses, juggler without a belt, and beast tamer recounting his fight with a mermaid.

title: Post-Shart Clarity
overview: A digitally-addicted twentysomething experiences a literal moment of release in the middle of sex, realizing that the messiest moments in life might actually be the most revealing.

title: Run From It
overview: Two unsuspecting friends tempt fate when they explore a derelict mansion that harbors a dark secret within its depths.

title: To Have and To Hold
overview: Two characters must grapple with the complexities of their relationship and decide whether or not to part ways.

title: Sites of Memory
overview: As U.S. history becomes controversial to teach in some states, one group of people comes to terms with our past and present in Sumner, Mississippi and Montgomery, Alabama.

title: Unwanted
overview: A police officer arrives on what seems like a routine call, only to discover a furry friend has been let behind without its owner.

title: Heaven Above Rowen
overview: The mental unraveling of Rowen, a religious leader faced with questions of identity and meaning as a prophesied revelation approaches.

title: La petite mort
overview: La petite mort is a personal experiment balancing between film, theater and documentary. Inspired by the character of Ophelia, this story of friendship, memory, and coming of age navigates the archives of childhood and the experiences of girls growing up in a small Polish town in the early 21st century.

title: Ithaqua
overview: During the decline of the fur trade, a mercenary struggles to unite the survivors of a famine-stricken outpost plagued by a dark force that leaves its victims with an insatiable hunger.

title: Guerrilla Filmmaker
overview: A documentary about ultra-low budget guerrilla filmmaking, deep in the heart of Texas.

title: A Mystical Ornithology
overview: Immersed in the songs of blue jays, yellow-throated warblers, and red-shouldered hawks on his forty-six-acre farm in rural South Carolina, acclaimed poet and ornithologist J. Drew Lanham exchanges calls with the birds that stop over at his home during their seasonal migrations. For Drew, these creatures are gods, transcendent beings who summon a response of reverence. Reverberating with sound, music, light, and ethereal cinematic expression, A Mystical Ornithology weaves a kinetic texture for the senses and invites you into a poetic evocation of the paradox of love and grief within the changing nature of the seasons.

title: Sundays
overview: In this intimate memoir, a daughter navigates the aftermath of loss as she reflects on the weekly rituals she once shared with her father.

title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
original_title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
overview: Echoes of Forks of Cypress explores the lives of the enslaved and enslavers at the Forks of Cypress plantation in Florence, AL. The documentary highlights their struggles, resilience, and the plantation’s historical significance. It then shifts to the present, where descendants from both sides come together to confront and heal from their shared past.

title: Electric Meat
overview: A photographer spirals into madness when a murdered model he's adopted as his new muse decides she doesn't want to stay dead.

title: Parbati
overview: Autism is not a weakness or a flaw, it is simply a different way of experiencing the world. Every person learns, thinks, feels, communicates, and understands life in their own unique way. This story follows the emotional journey of a brother and sister whose deep bond becomes the heart of the film. Amid society’s misunderstandings and everyday struggles, their relationship reflects love, acceptance, sacrifice, and the strength of family, creating a touching and inspiring tale about embracing individuality.

title: The Essentials 2
overview: After traveling to the past and interrupting the plans of the villains Pals, Kanjuan and Walten finally live their well-deserved vacation but this is interrupted after revealing a new villain: Hyday the god of time, who will try to interrupt their plans, so Elisa, April, Elias, Julef join together to challenge Hyday.

title: Gaskins: The Hitchhiker Killer
overview: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

title: Gaja's World 3
