The five guys have to rise to the occasion - and in doing so, they suddenly find themselves in a completely different decade.

title: Cold Shower
overview: Anya is a 43-year-old single mother living in Moscow. By day, she scans barcodes at the warehouse of an online retailer to make a living, and the rest of her time is devoted to her two young sons. Every summer, the city shuts off hot water for several days to test the pipes and prepare for the harsh winter ahead. During one of these periods, love and the warmth of a long-forgotten youth suddenly return to Anya’s life like an unexpected rush of hot water after a long wait. However, this awakening soon gives way to a new coldness and bitterness.

title: I'll Fix It
overview: One of the gang members, Lyosha, beats Andrei because he lost a large consignment of goods. This event again brings Lyosha together with his ex-girlfriend Katya, Andrei’s sister. Old feelings flare up with renewed vigor and Lesha is forced to lie, protect Katya from accomplices, and look for money, balancing between duty to the gang and love for the girl.

title: Kadhal Aura
overview: Two men with opposite beliefs about love and God are cursed to swap souls, forcing them to live each other's lives and face the women they love.

title: Zero Meets Hero
overview: War veteran Mr Thoi and his Gen Z grandson Tri Binh embark on a comedic journey to reunite with old war comrades, weaving together Vietnamese spiritual beliefs and generational bonds.

title: Facing El Chapo
overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

title: Grip
overview: In a remote Russian village, young paramedic Alisa has just married and dreams of the life ahead. But everything changes when her husband Anton is suddenly called up

title: My Armor
overview: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

title: Hot Spot
overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: Judaa
overview: Directed by Simerjit SIngh

title: & Sons
overview: A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, believing he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he tells them a wild and unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past.

title: Learning to Fly
overview: Aisha McAdams, a former competitive runner turned photographer, embarks on a journey to document the triumphs and struggles of famed ultra trailrunners, including Jim Walmsley and Eszter Csillag. Traveling to mythical races—the Western States Endurance Run in the mountains of eastern California, the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc in the French Alps—the film marvels at athletes who maintain their intensity as they run 100 miles of mountain trails while climbing thousands of vertical feet.

title: Dreams in Nightmares
overview: After an abrupt layoff, Z embarks on a trip across the Midwestern United States in search of a friend who has seemingly disappeared off the grid. Traveling with her two closest friends, these three queer black femmes find their priorities tested as shapeshifting threats in each city expose (inter)personal and ideological fractures.

title: Сын
overview: The characters from Agnia Barto's poems, gathered for tea, tell her funny stories.

title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
overview: Influencer Pavi refuses to leave her family home after marriage, so husband Elan moves in instead. Culture clashes and family chaos ensue as the newlyweds navigate their unconventional setup and challenge who defines their happiness.

title: CRAYON SHIN-CHAN THE MOVIE: SPOOKY! MY YOKAI VACATION
original_title: CRAYON SHIN-CHAN THE MOVIE: SPOOKY! MY YOKAI VACATION

title: Will You Care If I Die?
original_title: Blir du ledsen om jag dör?
overview: When youth worker Nic crosses paths with Elijah, a troubled teenager with undeniable basketball talent, he sees more than just a boy in need of help. Determined to steer him away from a destructive path, Nic takes Elijah under his wing, risking personal and professional boundaries to help him realize his potential both on and off the court. Against all rules and without anyone else's knowledge, Nic offers Elijah to move in with him. This marks the beginning of a close relationship, and the encounter with Elijah also helps Nic gain a deeper understanding of himself.

title: Inte Ett Riktigt Jobb
overview: How can an entire career in the cultural sector not count? The Minister of Education has announced that one-third of the funding for adult education associations is to be cut, with the money instead being invested in educational programs that lead to “real jobs.” What happens to the next generation of creators? And what do we lose as a society when the pathways into the cultural sector become increasingly scarce?

title: Atlas King
overview: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob bos

title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

title: The King of Horror
overview: A young director is obsessed with casting a long-lost coursemate in a horror film — the one who vanished after a disturbing incident they both swore to forget.

title: It Ends
overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

title: El Búnker
overview: After several years of silence of the LGBTIQ+ community because of a national decree, a group of friends organized a big attack to be free and have the right to speak in public again.

title: Soul Trader
overview: A despondent soul arrives in a strange place where he must confront his (mostly) inner demons.

title: If I Tell You
overview: IF I TELL YOU uncovers a family’s pressing secret while the 12-year-old son finds his voice and the courage to stand up for what is right.

title: Штраф
overview: Young traffic police officer Artyom, trying to hide his relationship with his boss's daughter, runs away from the girl's apartment and gets into a freak accident. After fleeing the scene, he confronts the owner of the Volga he dented, a principled retiree, in his office. His futile attempts to evade justice deprive Artyom of everything, but they lead him to the most important thing: the ability to take responsibility for his actions.

title: DJ Мулька
overview: Kir builds his own rotary DJ mixer. Grandfather Grigo is exalted by the surge of ambition from his past. The knot of insecurity clenching inside him loosens as his comrades allow themselves to simply live, mixing Tchaikovsky and rap.

title: Listen to them, the children of the night. What music they make!
original_title: Listen to them, the children of the night. What music they make!
overview: 3 x super 8mm (digital), color, silent.

title: Записки прошедших дней
overview: Four friends are forced to move out of the apartment they shared. Each has a clear plan for the future, but Natasha is the only one unsure what to do next. Will she be able to start a new chapter by flipping through the notes of days gone by? A dramedy with a "Moscow Does Not Believe in Tears" vibe.

title: Ты ещё придёшь?
overview: Arina works as a children's entertainer, but is forced to combine this with the rigorous work of debt collection. Faced with unfair and cruel treatment of a child, Arina hopes to make things right with her ability to bring joy, but her illusion is shattered by harsh reality.

title: Тело не врёт
overview: A typical wedding morning. The groom wakes from a restless sleep, looks around, and calms down. The bride wakes with him, and they chat and kiss. The groom admires his bride, strokes her shoulder, and suddenly realizes that his right hand has frozen in an inappropriate gesture. He hides this from his bride so as not to upset her, and tries to resolve it during the wedding day, discreetly, without his beloved's knowledge. But no matter what he does, nothing helps until he runs to the park, where he accidentally knocks coffee out of the hand of a passerby. In desperation, he's ready to tell her his shameful secret, and lo and behold! Her hand unclenches. He joyfully rushes to the registry office. In the wedding hall, everything goes according to plan until the moment arrives to say "I do!" and the hand treacherously clenches again.

title: The Clinic
overview: The Clinic is a documentary exploring the emotional realities of veterinary work through the perspectives of vets, vet nurses and vet techs. Following the care of Katy, a cat brought to the clinic by a rescue agency, the film looks at the compassion, connection and emotional strain that comes with caring for animals, while highlighting the often-overlooked impact of compassion fatigue on veterinary professionals.

title: Night of the Black Swans
overview: One night that could change the future. He will either stop the catastrophe or lose everything. Give up… or be reborn — the choice belongs to one man.

title: Хочу на рыбалку
overview: Valera, a family man plagued by deadlines and sleepless nights, dreams of escaping corporate slavery and competing in a legendary rudd fishing tournament. But saying a firm "no" to his toxic boss proves more difficult than landing a whale on a jig, so the journey to the coveted body of water turns into a frantic quest to survive endless tasks and the absurd hustle and bustle of the office.

title: Arcade Five Part Three
overview: The third installment in the Arcade Five sequel trilogy. Plot TBA

title: Celebrity Crime Scene: Princess Diana
overview: Follows investigators examining theories surrounding Princess Diana's death, including mysterious vehicles in the tunnel and allegations of powerful forces determined to silence her.

title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
original_title: คดีชมพู่:​ เด็กหายที่ถูกลืม
overview: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

title: Best Served Cold
overview: Micheal Mayaholt is enjoying the beautiful scenery of Scarborough, leaving his wife and son behind, little did he know, this would become the worse decision he ever made.

title: Хороший отец
overview: Teenager Sasha witnesses a kidnapping, setting off a chain of events that could destroy his family.

title: Зеркальная звезда
overview: An aspiring director arrives in the Moscow region to film a documentary about a legendary Counter-Strike coach. However, instead of an esports legend, she's met by a forty-year-old security guard who doesn't own a computer, and whose training methods only fit on a couple of notebook pages. To save the project, the director decides to turn the charlatan coach into a youth icon, uncovering who's really deceiving whom.

title: Плохой сон
overview: Vitya had a nightmare. Again. Masha reassures him—it was just a dream, nothing bad will happen. But for some reason, Vitya feels like the bad dream hasn't gone away.

title: Собачья будка
overview: After the death of his guardian, ten-year-old Adil remains an orphan for the second time. On the day of the funeral, the adult children of the deceased come to the house, and the boy hopes that one of them will take him. But it soon becomes clear: the inheritance may not mean at all what he expected.

title: Twix
overview: Close friends decide to make fun of a "rich" schoolboy, taking advantage of his advances, but begin competing for his attention, even to the point of smearing chocolate on his face.

title: Тихий свет
overview: Sister and brother meet at their parents' old dacha after many years of mutual silence.

title: Sunrise
overview: A young stage actress who is striving hard for her career, Güneş, is taking a look at some items from her memory box as she remembers how each of them caused her feelings of failure.

title: Счастье любит тишину
overview: A family on the brink of crisis tries to save their marriage with a trip to the forest together, but one of them has other plans.

title: Этого не должно было происходить
overview: On the eve of moving in with her fiancé, Lenochka throws a swap party with her friends, trying to shed unnecessary things and doubts. An evening full of conversations, memories, and casual confessions reveals cracks in her "perfect" future: betrayal, omissions, and a lack of true intimacy. The arrival of a stranger, Lyova, forces Lenochka to take a hard look at her relationship. What was supposed to be a step into a new life turns into a breaking point—and a chance to choose herself for the first time.

title: MACDUFF'D
overview: By the pricking of thy thumbs.

title: The Fairies
overview: A young girl struggles with the inevitability of adulthood and an unknown illness as malevolent spirits  attempt to prey on her.

title: Red Rue Express
overview: A romantic comedy that modernizes and reimagines one of the most famous and vivid Ukrainian national symbols, Chervona Ruta, and turns it into a new cultural phenomenon.

title: Amnesty 1979
overview: In Rome, in June 1979, the International Conference for Amnesty in Brazil is filmed, a major gathering of the Brazilian left in exile. Viewed in the present day, this archive revisits with rare vitality the question of political strategies in the face of state repressive apparatuses.

title: The Lights, They Fall
overview: Sixteen-year-old Ilay drifts through the summer on the outskirts of Berlin while a palliative nurse accompanies his ailing mother during her last days.

title: Kuncen
overview: Darus (62) is a river guardian. He practices rituals and adheres to beliefs as a form of reciprocity with nature. One day, Darus hears news of a child missing in the river and is asked by the community to help with the search. However, his advancing age and an increasingly toxic relationship with the river have left him unable to go near it, to the point of causing him distress. Darus is trapped in a dilemma: saving the missing child or protecting himself.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: Explore the extraordinary journey of tennis GOAT Novak Djokovic, who began playing on the hardscrabble courts of Serbia and rose to become the most accomplished champion in the history of men's tennis.

title: Distant lover
overview: The story of a boy yearning for a girl he knows he can never be with how ever hard he tries he knows it will never work and yet he doesn’t give up

title: Elisa and the letter
overview: Elisa leads her friend Leonora into an art studio. While her friend acts like an ill-at-ease guest, Elisa navigates the chaotic space with ease and, amid the paintings and the hidden corners, uncovers a stack of love letters with no addressee. Fascinated, the two friends begin to recite them, unaware that those words hide a secret involving one of them.

title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

title: We Are All Strangers
overview: A life-altering event forces 21-year-old Junyang and his girlfriend to face reality. At the same time, while Junyang’s father is struggling to hold their modest life together, a woman enters his life and both generations are forced to redefine their family.

title: Hiddensee
overview: Hiddensee in the Baltic Sea has always been a place where people have sought freedom. This film takes us on a journey through an entire century, starting in the golden 1920s, as it assembles the island’s scenery, history, and personal stories into a fascinating portrait. Then as now, the political upheavals that have swept across Germany have left their mark.

title: Tape 001
overview: A man is sent into a virtual world, looking for a beneficiant AI that disappeared a few days ago.

title: Il n'y aura jamais assez d'images
original_title: Il n'y aura jamais assez d'images

title: Don't Politicize
overview: In the northern region of Hungary, the populist propaganda of Orbán’s regime dictates the lives of military high school student Luca and her friends. But how do you distinguish between the opinions imposed on you and your own intrinsic beliefs in the most forming period of your life?

title: Dan Bandung
overview: Basil, a working-studying Fine Arts student, falls in love with Elma after meeting her at a Persib soccer match. He creates a t-shirt featuring her image that goes viral, leading to their acquaintance and eventual dating. However, their relationship faces opposition from Elma's father, forcing Basil to fight for his love amidst various obstacles.

title: Spa Weekend
overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves—and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

title: Над Голубыми озёрами
overview: A young woman, Aliya, plans to fulfill her deceased grandmother's last wish and scatter her ashes over the Blue Lakes. The famous actor, Matvey, unexpectedly volunteers to help her.

title: The Legend of the Scythian Gold
overview: The plot centers on an investigation conducted by the curious and resourceful Petya, despite the entreaties of his friends, family, and local law enforcement agencies, and throughout the entire journey he is "assisted" by his younger brothers, Sasha and Kostya. After a series of failures and setbacks, Petya still does not give up, collects all the evidence together, and learns the truth about who is to blame for the disappearance of the artifacts and helps return these exhibits to the museum.

title: Idiots
overview: When two unqualified bozos are hired to transfer a rich teen to rehab, their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

title: Совок
overview: Vyacheslav Ermakov, a phony businessman and life-waster, owes a large sum to a crime boss and, to pay off his debt, is forced to agree to carry out his errand. But a fateful encounter occurs along the way. To survive, Slava must play a survival game. The film is unusual in the ambiguity of its antagonist and his motives, all set against the backdrop of class conflict and reflection on the collapse of the USSR.

title: Born in the Jungle
overview: During late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth’s summer break takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo vanishes into the jungle. She must swap her books for bravery not only to find her brother but also to rescue a mystical furry animal from captivity and bring him back up to the legendary Tepui mountain.

title: Harusnya Horror
overview: For the sake of being able to watch the last episode of his favorite anime that appeared exactly before his sudden death, a shy anime-obsessed ghost is forced to accept a task from the afterlife to haunt 100 thousand humans. The problem? He's more terrified of people than they are of him. So, to achieve his goal, he reluctantly becomes the "star talent" for a crew of broke, fraudulent horror creators, which in the end forces him to choose between his personal ambition or saving the only 'family' he has ever found.

title: Дружи со мной нет
overview: Mashinka, a model student, has a best friend named Nika; while Nika had romantic adventures over the summer, Mashinka did not. On the way to the school assembly on September 1st, one makes the other swear an oath of eternal friendship, but on the tram tracks, they encounter a strange new boy who has never attended a regular school.

title: Если я уеду
overview: It's early September. Nine-year-old Anya doesn't want to move from her native village to the city. Her parents are packing: the school year is starting. Anya's dad, the local priest, is celebrating his final services before leaving. Anya confesses to him and complains about her mother. Anya also complains to her friend Zhenya. After spying on a church wedding, Zhenya and Anya sneak off and hold a wedding ceremony among the haystacks, promising never to forget each other. While playing, Anya asks Zhenya to always stay put when she's not looking, so that when she returns, he'll still be there. They fall asleep in the field, and their parents find them in the morning. Their things are packed, and they get into the car. Anya says goodbye to Zhenya. As they say goodbye, Zhenya asks her to go and not to look back. Anya gets in the car and drives away.

title: The Fighter
overview: He fights fighters who use their signature move, but refuses to use it first. She doesn't engage in combat at all—until he's defeated. And then one day she'll have to defend herself.

title: Я всё реже слышу твой голос
original_title: Я всё реже слышу твой голос
overview: The last days of summer. Between friendship, love, and impending changes, Lera becomes increasingly lost in her own feelings. As time passes, only fragments of memories remain of this summer.

title: Будь другом
overview: Pasha, who has trouble making decisions, comes to his couple of friends to share important career news, but instead of support, he faces the worst possible choice: deciding which of them he will stay with after they break up.

title: Khalifa Part 1
overview: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

title: Девочки танцуют
overview: Yulia, a young go-go dancer, loses her job after suffering a seizure during a performance, and her mother, Irina, becomes the victim of a scam. Yulia doesn't despair and quickly finds a job at a new nightclub.

title: Тоже мне любовь
overview: Anya (33) organizes a bachelorette party for her younger sister Lina (25), who is about to marry her fiancé Omkar. While trying to make the evening special, Anya finds herself quietly unsettled by the upcoming wedding and the dynamics of Lina’s relationship. As the night unfolds and the celebration grows increasingly chaotic, Anya’s attempts to control the situation begin to spiral, forcing both sisters to confront difficult questions about love, expectations, and the choices they make.

title: Mundurukuyü – The Forest of the Fish Women
original_title: Mundurukuyü - A Floresta das Mulheres Peixe
overview: Using the camera as a weapon to defend their ancestral land in Brazil, three women of the Daje Kapap Eypi audiovisual collective lovingly record their Munduruku traditions and their mythology of humans transforming into forest plants and animals.

title: Ice Skater
overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

title: A Stroll to Syracuse
overview: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

title: Czech Girl
overview: Widowed Zdena lives a quiet life as a postwoman in a small Czech village. When her beloved son Lukas returns home from France to say goodbye to his dying grandmother, his determination to make her seemingly impossible wish come true leads him to reveal a secret that challenges the values of the village: his queer life in Paris and his drag queen alter ego, Chica Checa.

title: Rinrada the Influencer
overview: When a female influencer is destroyed by social media backlash to the point of taking her own life, she gets a second chance as a spirit with only 28 days before she is forgotten forever.

title: Estrelando Marta
overview: Marta dreams of starting her acting career.

title: Coyote vs. Acme
overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

title: Don't Let Me Down
overview: When estranged friends Michael and Elizabeth reunite, Michael finds himself struggling to leave the past behind.

title: Darkroom
overview: Darkroom is a city symphony and filmed diary that captures the invisible pulse of Buenos Aires through a visual, introspective journey. The film opens on the vastness of the Río de la Plata before venturing deep into the heart of the city, culminating in an intimate portrait of local neighbours in a Buenos Aires quarter. Eschewing traditional narrative, the work observes the tension between the river landscape and everyday life, transforming the ordinary into a poetic visual essay on porteño identity and the memory of its streets.

title: Vado in America

overview: A reporter arrives in Rijeka and is placed in a hotel room numbered 23 where he also meets a mysterious roommate with a shady past. His arrival in the city coincides with the dissappearence of a famous local musical artist. His interest sufficiently piqued, he starts an amateur investigation of his own, which traps him in the inescapable clutches of the city's criminal underworld, putting the life and safety of both him and his family at risk.

title: Angels Near Death
overview: In the City of Angels, six eccentric strangers cross paths after near-death experiences, interweaving the journey of love, death, and the human spirit.

title: Rondout Meshing
overview: A woman suffering from central sleep apnea searches her dreams for a missing sister.

title: Summer Days
overview: Summer is promising for Juan and Gabriela, who plan to have a beach house. However, their plans are disrupted when Juan's father arrives with his new, younger girlfriend, Mónica, causing tension and a challenging coexistence.

title: Pretty Babies
overview: Two teenage girls run away to Hollywood, chasing stardom, but their dreams lead them into prostitution, trapping them in the dark underbelly of the sex work industry as they travel from Texas to California.

title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
original_title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

title: Awarapan 2
overview: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

title: Don't Let Them Out
overview: A struggling woman journeys to a property she's inherited in hopes of selling it to pay off her mounting debts.  But once there, she uncovers sinister family secrets and is lured into a desperate and terrifying scavenger hunt where every find pulls her deeper into an inescapable nightmare.

title: Lift me up
overview: On the eve of her husband’s birthday, Esther struggles to come to terms with an impending event.

title: All Night Wrong
overview: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: I Blew Out the Candles Before Making a Wish
overview: Young Jojo suddenly comes into a stack of casino chips worth a million and decides to pay off her runaway father’s debt, asking the down-on-his-luck debt collector Hua to gamble on her behalf. In Macau’s chaotic casinos, they form an unlikely alliance, navigating wins, losses, and life’s challenges together. When the final bet arrives, fate cruelly tests them, stripping them of everything, yet revealing the true gift life has been offering. I Blew Out the Candle Before Making a Wish explores money, family, and responsibility, capturing the shadows and resilience of human nature.

title: Vishwanath & Sons
overview: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
original_title: কেউ বলে বিপ্লবী, কেউ বলে ডাকাত
overview: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

title: Lady
overview: A lonely, narcissistic aristocrat dupes a struggling, opportunistic director into filming her every move. Her obsession with the spotlight takes a surreal turn when she starts becoming... invisible.

title: Union County
overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
original_title: Mein bester Freund, seine Freundin und ich
overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

title: Keep the Meter Running Ep. 10
overview: TAKE ME TO YOUR FAVORITE SPOT AND KEEP THE METER RUNNING!  Kareem lands in Damascus, Syria and meets Bashar, a cab driver and tour guide whose love for his city runs deep. What begins as a simple ride for coffee quickly turns into two days exploring Damascus through Bashar’s eyes, from the winding streets of the Old City to the places, people, and memories that have shaped his life.

title: Did you hear about the bastard who bought Portview?
original_title: Did you hear about the bastard who bought Portview?
overview: Dody Shaw, son of a prominent Ulster businessman, hires a video crew to ease tensions with the local community after buying a historic linen mill in East Belfast.

title: Auckland Law Revue Presents: Pretty Little Lawyers
original_title: Auckland Law Revue Presents: Pretty Little Lawyers
overview: Hit comedy stage show Auckland Law Revue is back for 2026 with Pretty Little Lawyers! A show full of skits, dancing, singing, and everything in between!!  Professors and students are being picked off one by one 😱⚰️. The OBITERROR is here. A ragtag group of students must solve the mystery 🔍 before they become the next victims 🪦. Will they outsmart the masked menace, or get caught in their twisted games? 🩸🤫

title: Kalpana
overview: A romance film exploring the profound nature of human affection and emotional boundaries. Formulated as a deeply moving love story, the narrative delves into the reality that not all romantic journeys culminate in conventional happiness. It examines how deep affection operates beyond social limitations, capturing the poignant sacrifices made by individuals navigating the unpredictable paths of love.

title: Casa de Formol
overview: A group of youths arrives to a mysterious house, where things start to get weird.

title: An Empty Seat
overview: A renowned former actor returns to the stage alongside a young, inexperienced actress. But the lines they have to rehearse in the play have a strange connection to the man's tragic past.

title: To Flourish
overview: After losing his best friend, Josh faces Thalia in a dream, and receives closure

title: Tuna on Rye
overview: Amy and Arthur deal with the everyday complications of Arthur’s dementia.

title: I'm getting married tomorrow
overview: Vale, Mia and Tamara, inseparable friends since childhood, reunite for Vale's wedding. If you thought weddings were chaotic, just wait until you see this one: the boyfriend turns out to be none other than a drug cartel boss!

title: The Order
overview: A phantasmagorical audio-visual overload of vampiric Philaspychogeography and pure psychic energy made manifest via filmmaker Nathaniel C. Shannon (Saint Vitus Bar: The First Ten Years Book, Deadguy: Killing Music), with score and sound-design by Don Devore, founding member of legendary Philadelphia hardcore band Ink & Dagger.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 17
overview: The seventeenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 13, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between HENARE and Callum Newman.

title: Jebediah: Are We OK?
overview: This is the story of a band that grew up but never grew apart. Jebediah's thirty-year journey is a celebration of friendship, creativity, and staying connected against the odds.

title: Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
overview: With her brother, Sang-hee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother's restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a "grass tomb". His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice, and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sang-hee’s films.

title: Aks seir
overview: Two young men struggling with financial pressure take jobs at a cash-in-transit company and devise a plan to rob it from the inside. But when their scheme spirals out of control, they find themselves caught in a chaotic chase where nothing goes according to plan.

title: CATRASCA XVI
overview: When God chooses him for a mission of great importance, Zamu embarks on a journey across multiple dimensions, populated by ninja fathers, cockroaches, and corrupt politicians, in order to find the mythic Emerald Baby.

title: A Sweet Day
overview: When a young woman gets the chance to have a conjugal meeting with her imprisoned husband after a long time,  ​she decides to re-experience a romantic time in the apathetic and harsh atmosphere of the prison.

title: Already Happened
overview: Hao Zhou confronts their younger self's compromised imagination, inviting the ghost of their youth to reconsider what lies ahead.

title: I'm Not You
overview: Eighteen-year-old Joe is caught in an emotional storm of identity, sexuality, and expectation. This crisis rips the heart out of a world that once seemed simply, now torn between the pressures imposed by a traditional working-class family and labels imposed by friendships groups and individuals. Joe embarks on a journey of discovery and introspection that threatens to destroy a family, a community, and ultimately a life.

title: J.K. The End
overview: With 5 Months of J.K. Being gone, Braxton’s family and friends are dealing with struggles of people not believing in the stories. Loosing, jobs, houses, and even Elizabeth.

title: Rongin Shurma
overview: A lie, countless letters, and the unbreakable love of a married couple.

title: Take Care
overview: Women find themselves in a stage of life where loneliness blows them up like a balloon, tiredness lets them dance in the wind like a leaf, and they even lose control over their own bodies.

title: To Flourish
overview: After the loss of his best friend, Josh faces an encounter with Thalia in a dream

title: Laddaland Housing Estate
overview: To provide a better life for his wife and children, Tomy takes out a mortgage to buy his dream home. This happiness doesn't last long. Since moving into the new housing complex, his family has been terrorized by various unnatural occurrences. Mysterious whispers, terrifying apparitions, and dark secrets lurking within the complex threaten their safety.

title: Satuko
overview: Porfirio Quispe Huillca embarks on a journey in search of the memory of his grandfather, Saturnino Huillca (Satuko), a Quechua-speaking peasant leader who fought for decades for the right to land and for the dignity of Andean communities in times of hacienda, exploitation and abuses.

title: Far From the Trees
overview: Adela, a Mexican sound artist, travels from the jungle to the Peruvian Andes alongside Lucho, a guide and translator. Following the legacy of her grandfather, a Republican exiled in Mexico, she weaves a sound map of endangered languages. When the fear of death breaks in, reality fractures. The journey turns into an intimate passage that confronts her with memory, grief, uprooting and identity.

title: Laundry
overview: Johannesburg, 1968. Khuthala hates his father's laundry and doesn't want to take over the family business. But the apartheid government is cracking down on black business ownership. Khuthala is torn between pursuing his own dreams of becoming a musician and fighting against the injustice that threatens the business.

title: The Crystal Planet
overview: 11-year-old Rea has recently moved to a distant planet in an outer-space colony where she discovers a mysterious animal cub while her father works in a factory that builds robotic creatures. With the help of her new friend Andy, she must protect the real cub from the factory’s ruthless owner, who intends to turn it into a robotic prototype.

title: User Not Found
overview: Two men and women with unknown identities, a live online trial in a confined space, and an extreme escape between death and truth

title: Don't Say Good Luck
overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

title: Camp Rock 3
overview: When Connect 3 loses their opening act for a major reunion tour, they return to their beloved Camp Rock to discover the next big thing. As campers vie for the chance to open for their favorite band, tensions rise and friendships are tested - leading to unexpected alliances, revelations, and romances.

title: Noga
overview: Fearless alternative pop singer Noga Erez is on the brink of superstardom with a unique, captivating sound and a major studio album on the way. But when war erupts and cracks appear in her relationship, Noga must redefine her role as an artist on a global stage.

title: Still Here, Still There
overview: A Chinese woman in her fifties moves alone to the U.S., chasing an American Dream postponed for three decades. As she struggles between freedom and obligation, her pursuit reveals the quiet contradictions of migration—where sacrifice and obsession blur, and one woman’s journey reshapes the filmmaker’s own.

title: This, That and Everything in Between
overview: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

title: Concrete Land
overview: An intimate story of three generations of a Palestinian Bedouin family in Jordan.

title: Mariinka
overview: In Eastern Ukraine, childhood neighbors find their lives violently derailed by a shifting frontline. Natasha, a promising boxing talent, becomes a military paramedic. Angela, who lost her parents at a young age, survives by moving goods to both sides of the front. Caught in a modern Greek tragedy, brothers Mark and Ruslan now fight on opposite sides – against each other. In the safety of his adoptive family in the United States, their youngest brother Daniil follows the war from afar.

title: RECORDING #27 - Short Film
overview: A young man records video diaries for therapy, trying to make sense of a past he can’t fully remember. But as he reviews the footage, he begins to notice something unsettling..  What starts as a quiet attempt at healing turns into a slow unraveling, as he realizes a presence has been with him far longer than he thought… and may have never left.

title: Coconut
overview: Nineteen-year-old bedroom rapper Dev has always been called a 'coconut': brown on the outside, white on the inside. Ashamed of his Australian accent and mocked by community members whenever he speaks Fiji Hindi, he has given up on his family's language. His cultural displacement comes to a head when he accidentally ruins his grandpa's Hindu funeral ceremony, knocking the urn containing his ashes into the nearby creek. Everything changes when his sharp-tongued, non-English-speaking grandma hears Dev swear at a stranger and responds in kind. Their new secret language becomes a bridge across grief and a way back into culture and language.

title: Ketok Mejik
overview: Ben, a grandson who is 'forced' to inherit his grandfather's "Ketok Magic" workshop. However, this inheritance comes with a series of problems that will confuse the entire village!

title: The Desert of the Real
overview: Who am I? What is real? How to live in the madness of the world? These are questions posed by six people who have had psychosis and speak openly about their experience. They have in common that they think deeply, and that at particular moments in their lives, they were under intense personal and social pressure.

title: Magic Atlas
overview: A magician arrives in the reclusive coal empire of Luocha, triggering widespread panic in a society already simmering beneath a fragile peace.

title: Honestino
overview: Arrested five times for his activism, student leader Honestino Guimarães was kidnapped in 1973 at the age of 26 and is one of the hundreds of people who disappeared during the Brazilian military dictatorship.

title: Finding Connection
overview: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure. Finding Connection follows those yearning for trust and emotional intimacy, only to discover an unexpected anchor in the algorithms of AI. The deeply personal exchanges between humans and machines give rise to questions that echo long after the credits roll. The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.

title: Funeral Casino Blues
overview: Jen lives in Bangkok – between the reception desk of an apartment building and the hotel rooms of strange men. What she sells is time, intimacy, sometimes just a moment. When a meeting escalates, Wason intervenes – a bartender who has lost more than he lets on.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
overview: Amziah King, beekeeper, musician, and anchor of his community, reunites with former foster daughter Kateri after many years apart, and fends off threats to his honey business.

title: Ever After
overview: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

title: Batwara 1947
overview: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

title: Rage Against the Archive
overview: This experimental browser-based film investigates the networked afterlives of ethnographic photographs from the 19th-century colonial publication 'The People of India' as they circulate through the New York Public Library’s digital archive. Through performative interventions and acts of Electronic Civil Disobedience that corrupt the archive’s HTML code, the artist transforms the website itself into a site of protest.

title: I Wanna Be With You Everywhere
original_title: I Wanna Be With You Everywhere
overview: Recognizing that, due to a lack of access, disability communities are often barred from cultural institutions and social resources, an artist collective produces uniquely accessible events for an ever-expanding vision of a cross-disability community. Capturing them at work and at play, this film embraces the collective’s commitment to an aesthetics that incorporates collectively made creative access while highlighting integrated audio description, open captioning, descriptive audio narration, and ASL interpretation integrated into the film itself.

title: Out of Eden
overview: In search of deliverance in a post-apocalyptic Philippines, a distraught mother takes her reluctant daughter on a secret pilgrimage to partake in their god-king's divine ascension.

title: 100 Years of Route 66
overview: Many people have Route 66 on their bucket list: To ride it once, from Chicago to Los Angeles, on a Harley. Or in an old American road cruiser. And experience what we know from the movies: the endless expanse of the plains, the endless deserts with their shimmering red mesas, the small-town USA. Even after 100 years, Route 66 stands for freedom and adventure, the promise of happiness in the USA. But it also stands for the many people who live along Route 66 but are not part of its history. And thus for the USA itself and its contradictions.

title: Feel Flows
overview: A beautiful memory is erased by the gushing water; place and people long gone, swept up by the tide.

title: Power Trip
overview: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

title: All the Hubbub
overview: An innocuous pair of headphones disturbs the life of an aimless audio engineer.

title: Supernatural Stories
overview: Anthology of six horror stories that explore the dark side of relationships. Each tale uses a supernatural to reveal inner conflicts, fears, desires and repressed emotions, forcing the characters to confront their worst fears.

title: Sisyphus
overview: A couple lives an orderly life whilst a third party is dead set on altering their lives for his own gratification.

title: Good Sport
overview: Pat is having a bad, bad day. His ex-wife’s about to get remarried, he’s hung over, and now he’s got to coach his 12-year-old son’s basketball team. There, he must face off against helicopter parents, an insane opposing coach, and his own sense of failure.

title: In My Mother's Mirror
overview: When successful archaeologist Ursula Scheuer makes a sensational discovery of a body during a bog excavation, her demented mother suddenly dies. Unexpectedly, a childhood trauma breaks out for Ursula. The appearance of her new assistant Mel is also puzzling: she seems to know Ursula’s past very well. Ursula is increasingly drawn into a mysterious web of fantasies and deceptions and must finally free herself from it.

title: Hero's Handbook
overview: On his way home from work, Agnus's life is turned upside down when the bus he's on is robbed. In the midst of the chaos, a mysterious masked heroine appears and hands him a book: The Hero's Handbook. With this strange guide in hand, Agnus is thrown into a hidden underworld, fragmented between heroes, villains and The Omitteds. The villains are about to join forces with The Omitteds in a rarely seen deal, as, equipped with dangerous bubble technology, they are now able to drain the virtue from almost anyone, even the heroes. With the villains' power growing, the world is on the brink of collapse. Now, Agnus will need to use the skills he acquired from the Hero's Handbook and discover that being a hero is not about power, but about wanting to.

title: On a String
overview: A young, Juilliard-trained violist is still living at home with her parents in the heart of NYC, while trying to make a living playing gigs with her friends in the homes of strangers.

title: Yugly
overview: Yugly, an irresistibly ugly dog, is determined to compete in the World's Best Dog Show, rallied by a bunch of flamboyant strays.

title: Rio de Clarice
overview: Film based on five short stories by Clarice Lispector (“A Bela e a Fera”, “Amor”, “Feliz Aniversário”, “Preciosidade” e “Mal-estar de um Anjo”).

title: Buddies and the Heir
overview: Following the death of a hotelier in Punta del Este, Uruguay, an unexpected inheritance dispute begins. Stallone, an actor with Down syndrome, believes he is the rightful heir to the hotel. On the other side is Magrelo, a young autistic man who was raised as an adopted son by the deceased. Without waiting for the reading of the will, Stallone decides to reunite his old friends with Down syndrome from the institute where they lived in Brazil to spend a week's vacation at the hotel.

title: Underground
overview: Seung-hyeon, a construction team leader with PTSD, is ordered to inspect Dohak Station, where a fatal accident halted work years ago. Inside the eerie, abandoned tunnels, he and Joo-young encounter two mysterious workers and become lost while trying to escape. Meanwhile, a CEO and a shaman perform a ritual to resume construction, but enraged spirits retaliate, plunging everyone into chaos.

title: Drift
overview: Over the course of a single night, a convoy of cars carries intimate conversations on the representation of Black bodies in France.

title: The Art of Seducing God
overview: Hikmah might be considered a disobedient child to her late mother, but her mother wasn't always kind to Hikmah either. Yet now, her late mother appears in his dream, pleading with Hikmah to save her from the torment of the grave. Caught in the turmoil of his faith, Hikmah embarks on a journey to uncover the true wisdom in his life—seeking ways to persuade God to save her mother and himself.

title: It Takes Two
overview: When an insecure young man encounters a confident doppelganger being the version of himself he wishes he could be, his desperate attempt to reclaim his identity sends his relationship-and his grip on reality-into a surreal descent.

title: The Ultimate Spider-Man: United In Grief
original_title: The Ultimate Spider-Man: United In Grief
overview: "The Ultimate Spider-Man: United In Grief" is a Spider-Man fan film by Speedsters Entertainment.

title: Couples Preferred
overview: Two friends pretend to be a couple in order to get a deal on an apartment listing with a preference for couples.

title: A Waymo™ Blocks My Neighbours Door For Around 39 Minutes
original_title: A Waymo™ Blocks My Neighbours Door For Around 39 Minutes
overview: A Waymo is stranded in front of someone's door, preventing them from getting inside their home.

title: All We Have Is Us
overview: Over five years, Juárez and Donoso followed people at the heart of this struggle: Chilean journalist and activist Leyla Noriega; Ramón Balcázar, a photographer and socio-environmental researcher documenting the economic impact of lithium mining in the Atacama; Serbian actor Bojana Novaković; and Vladan Jakovljević, a beekeeper from the Jadar Valley. Their personal stories intertwine to present the picture of a global process in which energy transition, economic development, and environmental protection directly impact the rights of local communities. The people in this film are not passive victims; rather, they are active participants who resist through civil initiatives, local media discourse, international solidarity, and art.

title: Finding Godot
overview: Lucas Finnigan, a college senior who has dedicated his studies to finding the physical dwelling of Godot, the entity that has removed evil’s influence from mankind. But when Lucas sets out to prove his theory true, his journey gives him more to ponder than he anticipated.

title: Narrative Divine: Eternal Destiny
overview: Keysie, the final Divinity to the leaders list has finally joined in on the Infinity Cloud. Facing some struggle trying to fit in, without being aware that this new home wasn’t so… home like at all. Will she and her companions be able to bond together, or will they fail and remain in utter isolation?

title: Back to the Drawing Board
overview: In search of inspiration, a handsome young artist who is struggling to animate their cute dog decides to watch a VHS copy of the cherished animated series Fred and Frank. When the VCR blows up, something crazy happens, but you'll have to watch the movie to find out, you cheeky sod.

title: Sublet
overview: When her housemate sublets their room for the week, Jess suddenly finds herself sharing a hallway with a complete stranger.

title: Silent Waltz
overview: Silent Waltz follows Yasmin and Darcy, two strangers who cross paths at a train station. Too shy to speak, their unspoken connection comes alive through their shadows, which begin to dance, expressing what they cannot, until their train arrives and the moment quietly slips away.

title: Simon and the Harp
overview: Inside a network of glass terraria is a blue dragonfly named Simon, who struggles with loneliness as he spends his days performing monotonous office work. Collapsing from exhaustion one afternoon, Simon discovers an old, abandoned harp by the river. He finds joy in playing the mysterious instrument, its harmonious tunes unknowingly becoming the key to transforming his formerly-isolated life through music.

title: How the Sausage Was Made
overview: A making-of doc for “Fuck My Son.”

title: Ang Nanlalamong Siyudad
overview: An experimental short film.

title: Recto Mania
overview: Recto Mania is an experimental documentary film about the voices of the underseen and underbelly of Recto. The film revolves around phantom characters such as a counterfeiter, a prostitute, embroiderer, and a devotee culminating in a kaleidoscope of imagery and soundscape.

title: Sa'n Elmo: A Musical Short Film
original_title: Sa'n Elmo: A Musical Short Film
overview: A narrative short film.

title: Senior Moments
overview: These three characters’ stories mirror the real-life struggles faced by many senior citizens, reminding us that, despite differences in background or circumstances, the challenges of aging are universal. Through these emotional narratives, Senior Moments aims to foster empathy and a deeper understanding of the elderly, whose needs and experiences are often overlooked in today’s fast-paced world.

title: A Dança do Universo com Marcelo Gleiser
original_title: A Dança do Universo com Marcelo Gleiser

title: Psycho
overview: A girl moved away from her best friend and home town, struggling to adapt to her new life she results to extreme measures instead of facing reality.

title: An Eye for an Eye
overview: Convicted of murdering her husband, Tahereh served her sentence and now faces a ticking clock to negotiate with her in-laws who, under Sharia law, have the legal right to either execute her or forgive her- for a price.

title: Three House
overview: First, never leave the house. Second, take your medicine and sleep once it gets dark. Third, never touch the locked doors. Having spent his entire life trapped inside under his father's strict rules, Jae-jun begins to question everything. Myung-sook, who cares alone for her father suffering from dementia, encounters an unidentified woman in the mountains on the anniversary of her daughter's death. And on the day of a move-in cleaning, Jung-hye finds herself alone with the cleaners when her husband suddenly stops answering her calls…

title: Fast
overview: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

title: Traveling With You
overview: Three friends going out to the city of Jakarta before graduating high school and go their separate ways. But something is off with one of them.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 16
overview: The sixteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 12, 2026, at Act City Hamamatsu in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Konosuke Takeshita and Ryohei Oiwa.

title: The Architect Who Built His Own Collapse
overview: When a former activist-turned-architect joins a redevelopment project led by his old comrade, now the city mayor, he finds himself wandering through a landscape of demolition, as memory, reality, and the ideals they once shared begin to collapse.

title: Last Chance to Evacuate Earth
overview: A casual kidnapping takes Crystal to rural Victoria with her estranged best friend. Though Chester promises a pleasant getaway, the mystery of his unexplained two-year absence - and a looming cosmic event threaten to overshadow their journey.

title: Somewhere in a Free Country
original_title: Quelque part dans un pays libre
overview: One missile means war. A second missile still means war. But between the two missiles… And if the second missile never arrives, what is it?

title: D'ici là
overview: High up in a valley in the Vosges, Lucien seeks peace in utter solitude. Aline, tracking a wolf, confronts her deepest fears. And young Jade grapples with her true nature.

title: O Jacaré
overview: Reboleira, a suburb of Lisbon. After a robbery gone wrong, a car ends up crashed right in the middle of the neighborhood. The driver is arrested, but the €180,000 that were stolen have vanished. Within the area sealed off by the police, rumors spread and speculations run wild. Among the residents, a whole cast of colorful characters dream of getting their hands on the loot. Who will the first to get their hands on it?

title: Fire Flower
overview: Yoko Hayasuke's journal is set in the wake of the tsunami and nuclear disaster after the Tōhoku earthquake. Something happened yet life goes on: Tokyo continues to expand, new soil replaces irradiated land.

title: Inside Out
overview: With a visual background containing images of an abandoned building in his hometown, Albin, the only child in a family of three, shares his feelings on having his extended family abroad through a mixture of narration and conversation with his parents.

title: NADUPA
overview: In the wake of her father's passing, Nadupa resists the cultural practice of widow inheritance and stands up for her and her mother's rights to their land and their independence.

title: The Calendar of Nechrubel
overview: The Priestess’s growing exaltation heralds the advent of the Seventh Psalm, said to finally breathe undeath into those whose souls have not yet passed onto the Shimmering Fields.

title: The Thai Interpreter
overview: Following a difficult divorce, Ladawan, a Thai interpreter in California, finds the strength to continue her career with the help of her vibrant colleague Stefani and a supportive new acquaintance, Nicholas. The film follows her through high-stakes legal and medical cases, weaving together the lives of four Thai individuals: Ananya, facing an attempted murder trial; Noot, caught in a trafficking case; Daranee, battling cancer; and Sommai, a Muay Thai coach surviving a tragic crash. It is an intense, heartfelt look at the vital role of communication in life’s most critical moments.

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: Mama
overview: In a quest to terminate the pregnancy, a young woman faces her first grown-up experience.

title: Tina Arena: Unravel Me

title: North Melbourne Cheer Squad

title: KURA: An African AFL Story

title: The Peace
overview: On a disorienting soundstage, underscores is swarmed by a thrashing crowd. The set gradually begins to fill with smoke as the party progresses. This video contains flashing lights and fast cuts.

title: Kaugsankamalla: mientras vivamos
overview: “If I can no longer fight, will you?” Filmed and co-directed by Soraida, this intimate portrait spans the everyday life and activism of Soraida Chindoy, following her journey as an Inga leader defending her community’s sacred mountains from a Canadian mining company in Colombia. Balancing motherhood with community organizing, Soraida's daily life as an Inga woman and land defender is shaped by resilience, responsibility, and an unwavering commitment to her people and territory. As environmental threats intensify, her demands become more urgent — and her disappointment with the international community more profound.  ‘Kaugsankamalla: As long as we live’ offers a deeply personal and politically resonant portrait of Indigenous resistance in the face of ecological and cultural loss. Through Soraida’s voice, her images, and her embodied wisdom, we are offered a window into the lived experience of fighting for a future — not just for one community, but for the planet we all share.

title: The Burglars
overview: An elderly woman, Eunja, who lives in the countryside, teams up with Palbok, a burglar, to embark on a spree of robbing empty houses.

title: Leave This Room Buried
overview: A poetic personal journey through the director's memories of the past and present, presented through unconventional combinations of images and sounds and the haunting presence of silence that threatens to whisk them away into the oblivion.

title: AlieNation
overview: Mario, a barber in Turin, Ming, a small businessman in Russia, and Shahe, recently released from prison in Beijing, live vastly different lives yet share one identity: livestream hosts. Over five years, the film assembles their broadcasts to examine alienation in online-mediated existence through an entirely screen-captured form.

title: The First Flower

overview: Franz Eberhofer and Rudi Birkenberger's next case takes them to Niederkaltenkirchen's new golf course. The two detectives promptly get caught up in a full-blown family feud between two folk festival clans.

title: MOOSAP (Memories of Old Sapang Palay)

Displaced from Manila under the false promise of a better life, settlers faced severe neglect, eventually marching to Malacañang to demand basic necessities. This experimental film juxtaposes historical struggles with contemporary cycles of displacement, questioning how long a community must walk before their voices are truly heard and the cycle of empty promises finally ends.

title: The Bus Wheels Go Round And Round
Wetsitales: Agyu from Ayuman
overview: Agyu from Ayuman is one of Pamulaw’s 3 sons. He heads the household and his family's livelihood of trading beeswax and honey. One day, they had a misunderstanding with the leader of Moros— sparking wars between them even when they travelled to the kingdom of Nalandangan. Each encounter, Agyu wins with his strategic leadership. In the end, they find peace in Nalandangan where his family and his people finally stayed.

title: The Drop-off

title: Tommy John of Tomorrow
overview: A short film blending grounded sci-fi and tragicomedy. In a future where lab-grown organs are routine and anti-aging breakthroughs have redefined youth, an injured college baseball player faces tension with his girlfriend after choosing an experimental treatment that could make him better than ever.

title: Hot Peasant Summer

title: Inferno

Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

The arrival of Lisa, who has been sent to help her with the animals, forces her out of her solitude and invites her to reconnect with her own story.

title: The Ones We Couldn't Save
overview: As the Israeli military launches attacks across southern Lebanon,  first responders remain vigilant, answering emergency calls, evacuating the wounded and searching for survivors, despite facing the same dangers as the communities they serve. Team leader Ali Safiuddin has dedicated his life to Civil Defense. The station is his home, and his team has become his family. But years spent as a first responder to wars, disasters and destruction have led to losses that even an experienced rescuer can find difficult to overcome.

title: I Have Laughed Again
overview: Lan, a stoic counselor, masks her soul's fractures with professional restraint until she meets Zhen-Zhen. What begins as therapy spirals into a dangerous obsession.

Her father, Sherif, has a different plan for her future and insists that she pursue academic studies instead. As their opposing wills collide, hidden emotional wounds, fear, and unspoken trauma rise to the surface, pushing the family to a breaking point.

One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

When an accident brings the enigmatic Gaia into their lives, unexpected desires begin to take shape, unsettling the careful balance that has long defined their relationship.

As students and teachers continue their work amid uncertainty, the film observes a public arts school confronting the quiet loss of the very program it was built to offer.

title: Dance

title: Language of The Diaspora

They wander through places of remembrance where identity is forged, and give voice to Albanian culture in places where it is suppressed. Gjuha e diasporës straddles the line between documentary and experiment, serving as an investigation into what happens to the Albanian language as a result of oppression and migration.

title: Dementium
overview: Wyatt Bailey settles into a secluded and unknown to him cabin on a small Christmas tree farm with one driving goal; to solve his mother's murder. Unfortunately, the one person who might hold the answer is dead and wrapped in plastic in the back of his trunk... It's Wyatt's father. In a final and desperate attempt, Wyatt takes DMT, determined to ask his father the truth -- If he killed his own wife. What follows is both horror and hope in the cosmic arrival of Wyatt's charming ex-girlfriend, Cora, who continually begs him to revisit their first date together, as well as a haunting and terrifying witch hell-bent on Wyatt hurting himself. As Wyatt's drug-fueled nightmare unfolds, both entities will fight for Wyatt's soul as he works on coming to terms with his own complicated past.

title: Dragon
overview: When the nine stars align, the sea tomb of Shen Wanjiu emerges along with an island, attracting attention from all forces. Tianya, a chivalrous martial thief, sneaks into the granary to investigate the relief grain adulteration case, but is framed and forced into the dispute. He allies with Zheng Qianqian, head of Tianhai Ship Gang who has been searching for her missing father for years, and Shen Zhaowen, descendant of the Shen family.

original_title: Bye-Bye Bellevue - Der Bundespräsident zieht um

title: The Ordinary Television TV Movie
overview: Late one night, teenage twins Leo and Lucy tune into a chaotic marathon of television broadcasts, rapidly spiraling through a absurd, high-velocity stream of pop culture parodies and media satire. Guided by the series' eccentric mastermind, Peanut, the duo navigates a relentless barrage of short-form sketches, unexpected cameos, and dry cynicism. Ordinary Television presents the complete, uninterrupted feature-length experience of the internet comedy phenomenon—delivering non-stop sketch comedy right up to the final credits.

title: The Paper Doll
overview: When a mysterious creature escapes to the Alps, the witch who created it must seek the help of two hunters before its too late.

title: Toy Story Back-To-School Lunchbox Disaster!

overview: 19th-century Colombia. Karl and Petronella, a young Swedish couple, sail in search of fortune. The river carries them through desolate lands ravaged by the independence war. Their adventure loses its course, slowly swallowed by a strange and distorted time in which nothing but the reflection of their nostalgia and the ghost of the alienating unknown remains.

title: Lost In The Water
overview: Fragments of recreated archival footage depicts daily life along the Mekong River in the countryside of Cambodia. Cooking, planting rice, children at school and crossing the river is captured on Super 8, yet the fictional time period is unknown. An imagined flash flood submerges everything. “Where is the old house? Do you go through here?” A voice repeats over and over again. All is not lost as water drops ripple open portals of memories that reemerge from the depths of the river.

title: Her Silence
overview: An international student hosts her visiting parents in her Sydney flat, and spends two fraught days wrestling with her mother’s unspoken social expectations and apprehensions about the life her daughter has chosen to build in Australia. This finely wrought, elegantly shot family drama expresses the complex emotions of intergenerational diaspora through closely observed everyday moments.

title: Tomb of Dreams
overview: Louis and Lénore have sought refuge in a lonely house by the sea. As in a dream, zombies appear, wandering at nightfall. Do they really exist?

title: Live Crickets
overview: Cass throws an impromptu funeral for her oldest friend, two weeks after her boyfriend dumped her and moved out. As Cass walks through the sea of people she thought might be her friends, we watch her realize just how alone she truly is.

title: Twosome
overview: Dining out for their anniversary, Andy and Scarlett get blanked by a woman they had a threesome with months earlier, prompting them to relitigate the encounter’s consent politics in excruciating detail.

title: Class Clown
overview: At a quiet high school, Chester is the janitor that everyone trusts and is always watching out, always there when no one else is. But, a single humiliating secret caught on camera at a birthday party, turns him into a joke overnight. As whispers turn cruel and laughter turns violent, an accident silences Chester for good. Or so it seems. Because something wearing a familiar smile refuses to stay gone... the ones that laughed first, just might be the last to stop screaming.

title: Despite the Night
overview: Months after a distant volcanic eruption, a cloud of ash continues to loom over northern Australia. With the region plunged into an eternal night, its inhabitants flee south. Trapped inside an apartment, two brothers care for their ailing grandmother – one longing to flee, the other clinging to what remains.

title: The Wanderers
overview: 1957. As a farewell for her lover Teresa, Zurda and her friends go on one of their usual weekend camp-outs in the middle of the woods. A time stolen for rest, playfulness and illicit pleasures, away from the watchful eye of Franco’s dictatorship.

title: Ruinas circulares
overview: In the sacred valley of Túcume, where time seems to stand still, sounds awaken hidden memories. The echo of drums and the vibration of the air envelop us in a sonic ritual: a bridge between the visible and the invisible, between the ancestral and the eternal.

title: The Class: Online
overview: A group of college students reunite for a late-night online class after the events of The Class. What starts as a normal session begins to feel off when strange glitches and eerie occurrences appear on their screens.

title: Hearing
overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships. Wishing for his parents, who live apart and do not speak to each other, to reconcile, his fear of losing connection to his loved ones forces Ninh to face life’s unpredictable rhythms.

title: The Birth of Venus
overview: Aphrodite is a vibrant young advertising professional, surrounded by the love of family and friends, whose routine changes after she begins a relationship with Mateus—an apparently charming man who gradually turns love into control, care into surveillance, and affection into violence.

title: Nine on the Line
overview: When a new player appears on the horizon, the old order in the pool club begins to fall apart and the real game is played far beyond the table.

title: Soft Gaze
overview: Lonely police officer Georgie becomes fascinated by a queer couple she observes at the beach, recognising their soft intimacy as something missing from her own emotionally arid heterosexual relationship. Time slows eerily and soothing touches and sounds grow sinister as her fixation becomes charged with hungry sensuality.

title: September Afternoon
overview: A couple refuses to accept that summer is over. For a last time, they head to the coast with the intention of spending two afternoons together between sand dunes and sea water. The temperatures have long been too cold for sandals and shorts; the blustery autumn wind is no substitute for cosy rays of summer sun. On the way to the beach, they cross paths with a woman they know loosely. Upon arrival, they look in vain for a dune to take shelter from the wind; a small dam is built and defended hard against the tide, an attempt to erect a windbreak is made. These desperate struggles against the encroaching elements are merely a brief interlude before the situation unravels into a disaster of an entirely different magnitude. A contemporary cosmic catastrophe.

title: Man Wearing a Helmet
overview: As Aboriginal boys are stolen from their families and brought to a rural mission, astonishingly visceral and discomforting truths about our collective past emerge.

title: The Troll Gang
overview: After their leader, Pierce, gets knocked out in a fist fight, causing him to form a new, friendlier personality, a gang of delinquent teens have to figure out how to continue their life of crime with or without him.

title: Farewell until a free Kosova
overview: Found footage recorded on March 12, 1998, in Germany, documenting Agron and Fitnete as they receive their marriage papers. Surrounded by family, they record heartfelt congratulations and greetings intended for loved ones back in Kosovo. What begins as a celebratory message, slowly shifts into a moment marked by uncertainty and concern about Kosovo.

title: Born In a Place of Memory
original_title: Born In a Place of Memory
overview: A documentary focusing on the small market town of Ludlow. Made using archive footage collected from the internet.

title: Wandering Trees

The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

title: Miso Soup
overview: College student Reiko enrolls in a Japanese-language class to learn her heritage language. However, she begins to fall behind and feels like she is not Japanese enough. In turn, Reiko has to navigate her own feelings about having a dual identity.

title: La Tranquera
overview: A man gets stuck in a rural gate in the middle of nowhere. The sun is high, the fields are endless, and there is no one around.

title: LAGUM Ao Vivo na Amazônia

The band brings its music to the heart of the Amazon for a special live performance surrounded by the beauty of the rainforest. The project celebrates music, nature, and Brazilian culture, while supporting the conservation of the Amazon. All CO₂ emissions from the production were compensated through the REDD+ Jutaítuba Project.

title: Bully
overview: Malvin, a quiet eight-grader living life in his own head, is suddenly caught between two bullies, Dillon and Clarissa. Whilst, Michael tries to help him, and Fellycia tries to save himself from his mind and attempt to restore his faith in humanity, not knowing that will only wreak more havoc and challenges Malvin has to go through, even if he has already enough chasms in his daily life.

title: Spindle Tales (Dhurikatha)
overview: An old wool spinner shares three stories about storytelling, exploitation and a system that only knows how to take from people like him

title: rebloom
overview: An experimental film about the transience of hardship and the hope of a new beginning. The film addresses the challenges encountered on the human journey, as well as the story of Armenia—a country that has endured much yet yearns for a new reblooming.

title: Over & Over
overview: Trapped in the quiet repetition of her days, a young woman moves through the same room, the same thoughts, and the same emptiness. As time passes without anything changing, the line between routine and reality begins to disappear.

title: Trace Project
overview: In the late 2030s, as Earth's ecosystem continues to collapse, humanity launches the Mars Footprints Program, sending astronauts from every nation to establish a new civilization on Mars. Lin Jia Jun, an ordinary young man raised in Singapore's public housing, becomes the country's first astronaut to set foot on Mars. Through a cognitive brain-link, he shares every emotion in real time with his companion, Chen Hui Min, who remains on Earth. As the mission unfolds, Lin discovers that Mars is far from the promised land—it is a brutal test of resources, survival, and human nature. Meanwhile, Hui Min quietly watches over him from Earth. As ideals collide with reality and national duty conflicts with the longing to return home, Lin must confront one ultimate question: Is humanity's future found in escaping Earth, or in learning to protect the home we already have?

title: 67 Days Later

overview: A daughter returns with her camera to face her family's troubled history, capturing three generations of women bound by silence, resilience, and love, as they confront the men who have shaped their existences.

title: Forgotten Spaceman

title: The Summer That Ended Twice

title: Brave New Love

As a role model to her daughter, she struggles to navigate her existential quest - a journey filled with body fluids, intimacy, Greek mythology, laughter, madness, and clumsiness. We follow Kate through darkness and sunshine in this erotic, existential modern love story, as she battles society’s norms and dares to redefine the rules of love.

title: Elise's Dream

original_title: Tierra roja: Ecopoética audiovisual de la Amazonía peruana

This summer, her parents will have to grow up too.

At some point, they notice each other, and a romantic connection develops between them, which may be their last attempt to escape their loneliness and feel needed.

title: Street of Resistance

title: Phillip Philadelphia

title: The Blessing

original_title: The Secret Lives of Suburban Housewives

title: Ending Things

title: The Great Punjab Robbery

title: Olmo

title: A.ni.mál

title: Beast
overview: After a final harvest forced upon him by the landlord, an old farmer and his loyal carabao embark on a magical road trip to Manila, chasing the ghost of a niece the years stole from him.

title: Mono No Aware
