title: Hand of God
overview: In a remote village scarred by years of conflict, a young army lieutenant introduces football to children. As the game begins to heal wounds and rebuild trust, he forms a fragile bond with a child soldier — forcing both to choose between the innocence they’ve lost and the violent realities of war.

title: Harbinger
overview: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

title: To Set Upright

title: Status: Rejected

title: Otter

title: end of beginning
overview: After waking up with no memory of his past, a man pieces together his life through archival photos and footage of the places he’s been, uncovering fragments of the identities he once lived as he confronts the relentless passage of time.

title: I Is Another
overview: Autumn 1952: Committed journalist Hedda and her husband Winfried ambush Felix Kersten, former massage therapist to SS Reich Leader Himmler, on a train to Oslo. Kersten is said to have helped thousands of concentration camp prisoners to freedom during the Nazi era—at least according to his own account. But Hedda has her doubts. She considers Kersten a mythmaker who is using fabricated heroic deeds to put himself in the running for the Nobel Peace Prize. What begins as an interview develops into a tense, psychological cat-and-mouse game: Kersten, rhetorically brilliant and armed with alleged evidence, encounters a stubborn opponent who relentlessly confronts him with contradictions. As the conversation comes to a head, the announcement of the Nobel Peace Prize winner draws ever closer....

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Our Time Will Come
overview: Two orphans, Owusu and Adobea, brave the Ghanaian countryside, with one quest in mind: to find their last legitimate parent who would be able to bring back their identities.

title: Lads Being Lads: Screen Time
overview: In this episode, the lads are challenged by James to ditch their phones and begin to connect with life like they never have before. All which leads to the group splitting and ending up facing the unfair reality of their separate paths. All in the hopes of trying something new.

title: The Day You Begin
overview: On their first day of school, four imaginative kids feel like they don’t belong, until they learn that everyone has a unique story to share. The Day You Begin is a journey of self-acceptance, courage, and the magic that comes when we connect with others. Bursting with color, laughs, and compassion, this animated adaptation brings Jacqueline Woodson’s beloved book to life, reminding kids that every voice matters and every difference is a strength.

title: Detective Teekshanaa

title: The Big Cheese

As the moon seems to eclipse the animals and people around her, she meets REN__, an online friend, who introduces her to “shifting” – a practice where teens believe they can enter other realities through lucid dreaming.

title: Aligned Apart
overview: Two Strangers. Two Stories. A painful breakup and loss of his job leave Neel searching for purpose, while Tara finds herself struggling to cope with her parents' separation and the uncertainty surrounding her family. As the two unknowingly mirror each other's journeys through loss and healing, their lives repeatedly cross in unexpected ways. Can two lives moving in parallel ever become one?

title: The Legend of Dewey Winslow
overview: During a thunderstorm, a timid, reclusive young woman haunted by her past recounts the tragic tale of Dewey Winslow, a mysterious boy whose extraordinary abilities once blew the town of Honeydew Pines into the night sky…

Fate reunites them tonight in the heart of Taipei, but they only have a few hours to uncover the secrets hidden in each other’s hearts.

title: Deathwoods

title: Из глубин

It takes Nadya to the Upside Down—a world where people who have failed to cope with their pain are transformed into soulless driftwood. The Apple Tree takes Nadya's heart. To get it back and avoid being turned to stone forever, Nadya must endure despair, confront the weeping driftwood, and make a choice: continue to fight or accept her fate. The film is a metaphorical parable about how hatred destroys the soul, while forgiveness and acceptance restore it to life.

title: Dragonfly
overview: Nohemí and Mary are two women resisting structural violence in Ciudad Juárez. United by pain and hope, both mothers find inspiration to move their families forward. The dragonfly, a symbol they share, embodies their resilience and capacity for change.

title: You Want a Mint?

Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

title: Brothers by the River
overview: A coming-of-age story of two friends in Mindoro – Niko, a Manila boy, and Ayan, a Mangyan. Their unique bond spans a whole summer of being introduced to each other’s culture and lifestyle, with Niko teaching Ayan how to read, who in turn teaches Niko how to swim.

title: Thudakkam

title: Wei Baba
overview: A woman introduces her Chinese dad to her American Jewish boyfriend and manipulates their language barrier to keep everyone happy.

title: Becoming
overview: In Almaty, Kazakhstan, 17-year-old Mila escapes her unstable home life by joining an elite swimming team led by Vlad. Amid intense training and suspicions of doping, Mila faces a complex attraction to Vlad, while traumatic memories and moral dilemmas threaten to undermine her new-found independence.

title: The Absent
overview: The first work written and directed by Xinjiang female director Lu Dan uses a delicate technique to tell the story of a Russian photographer who has been away from his hometown for a long time, a Han girl who wanders around looking for her father, and a lonely Tatar accordionist in a northern town in winter. A story of unexpected encounters.

title: For Sale By Exorcist
overview: Susan Price is a savvy realtor and certified exorcist who’s spent years flipping haunted houses across the country. From bleeding walls to glowing eyes, every listing is to die for! But as Susan hunts for her own forever home, the ghosts she’s evicted return for revenge. Will Susan settle with these vengeful spirits…or could she lose her life along with her down payment?

title: Dark Thoughts
overview: A young family moves to the countryside to escape creditors. But in the village home of their deceased aunt, an evil more dangerous than any debt collector awaits them.

title: DC
overview: Rebel Devadas joins forces with Chandra in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance demands bloodshed and tests loyalties as survival becomes the ultimate stake in their fight.

title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
original_title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
overview: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

title: Ganggang
overview: At the first clash of their fighting spiders, Ilay and Ten-ten knew they would go home as losers. Anton, the winner of the fight, will once again lord over their school. At the sideline is Mel, a newcomer and a city boy, watching the rowdy play in awe, unaware that soon he will become an ally of Ilay and Ten-ten against the real neighborhood bully.

title: Paint on Dry Leaf
overview: In a surreal future where trees exist only as memories, a young woman's journey to protect the last living sapling becomes a story of love, hope, and humanity's resilience in the face of extinction.

title: The City of Youth
overview: A short film about young adults and their complicated relationship to Hongdae — a busy clubbing area filled to the brim with Seoul's youth.

title: Storm Bird
overview: A celebrated composer facing death, his working-class neighbour facing jail, and a sharp New York writer form an unlikely alliance over one charged weekend in Far North Queensland.

title: She Is Back

overview: Ridho keeping a secret of their married with Ratna, his wife. When the secret revealed, Ridho impulsively drinking his horse’s, Rambo, urine. But things don't go according to plan.

overview: A band defined by fame and excess reunites for a landmark concert. As old wounds resurface, Ravi, Ícaro, Anastasia, Theo, and Eva are forced to confront the consequences of their choices, the weight of guilt, and the boundaries between affection, dependency, and redemption. Amidst the chaos, music remains the only place where it is still possible to exist.

title: NEVER
overview: Two friends exchange about life, love and memories of a common past. A simple conversation that hides much more than it allows to appear.

title: Zaza mainty
overview: In the dust-choked gem mines of Andohan'Ilakaka, ruthless bosses Bell and Bona desperately need a dark-skinned child for a dark, sacrificial ritual to secure their fortune. Unaware of the looming danger, young Nivo and Miora arrive on holiday to tour the sapphire quarries. With his deep complexion, innocent Nivo quickly becomes the prime target for a sinister plot.

overview: In a future where cows have nearly vanished, Phop, a rich farmer, owns Southeast Asia's last bull.

title: sKINs_Addis Abeba
overview: A cyclical journey through four political eras that have shaped Ethiopia's capital.

title: Dry Wood
overview: 96-year-old clarinet master Grigoris Kapsalis, the last living musician of a generation that shaped the music of Epirus, has long been an integral part of the local village feast. In this final encounter at his home, he offers glimpses into a lifetime devoted to music; meanwhile, preparations for the annual feast begin in the village square.

title: Ohh My Dog
overview: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

title: Manhunt

Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

title: Vamos a perder la cabeza
overview: A transmedia project that merges music, film, and digital storytelling. The entire concept revolves around a musical enigma: "Pisces, the Singer," a legendary 1970s sensual music artist with a fish head, who vanished from history almost overnight, a victim of what appears to be an inexplicable collective amnesia.

title: The Minusio Tapes
overview: Decades after burying a series of recordings he believed lost forever, a respected architect dies. When the tapes are discovered beneath his home, a stranger appears at his daughter's door claiming to know the man better than she ever did.  The Minusio Tapes is a study in what survives concealment: how the past insists on being found, one recording at a time.  Produced under the creative supervision of Ramon Zürcher and Silvan Zürcher during the Locarno Film Festival 2026 Spring Academy.

title: Small Talk
overview: Hoping to launch a career in the luxury world, Charlie enrolls at the last finishing school in Switzerland. Over the course of a summer, women from around the world learn the codes of elegance, etiquette and conversation meant to prepare them for elite social circles. As they refine their gestures and manners, a world of aspiration, discipline and self-transformation gradually unfolds.

title: Geometrious
overview: Two geometric figures play a puzzle game shaped by the toll of making things fit.

title: Armony
overview: Armony, a 55-year-old solitary truck driver, finds himself taking responsibility for his six-year-old niece Carlotta after the disappearance of his sister. By his side are Pamela, an elderly transgender woman, and Jenny, a neighbor who is expecting a baby. When social services threaten to take the child away, Armony is forced to fight with all his strength to obtain legal guardianship.

title: Maids of Petroleum
overview: In a California oil town, teenage girls compete to become “Maids of Petroleum,” asked to carry an inherited civic ritual into an uncertain future.

title: Agua, ¿dónde vas?
overview: The video draws inspiration from the evocative imagery of Federico García Lorca’s *Agua, ¿dónde vas?*, in which water becomes a metaphor for existence. From the spring to the sea, it is a circular journey in which the beginning and the end merge. The sea flows back towards its source, symbolising the eternal cycle of life. It is a journey of transformation and discovery, reminding us that nothing truly disappears: everything changes form and continues to live on in the world.

title: The Angel Maker
overview: Tells the story of the Swiss religious community of Methernitha, which still exists today, its founder Paul Baumann – the inventor of a mysterious energy machine – and the young women who brought him down on charges of child abuse.

title: Happiness Is So Close!
original_title: Ah que le bonheur est proche !
overview: 80-year-old Jean-Luc is set to play Don Quixote. It's the role he's been waiting for to bid farewell to the stage. Given his health concerns, the production team hires an understudy. Jean-Luc becomes convinced that the understudy is trying to take his place.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 12
overview: The twelfth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 6, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Yota Tsuji and Boltin Oleg.

title: David Beaucage: Super Normal
overview: Colorful, dazzling, and unpredictable, David Beaucage presents SUPER NORMAL, where music fuels comedy in a setting that’s both original and accessible. With an energy that’s both extravagant and controlled, he strings together surprises: grandmother, Hooters, and the family group chat? In his mind, it all goes together, and it’s totally normal.

title: Toko Perlengkapan Mayat
overview: Daeng Sarro, the owner of a mortuary supplies business, asks his children and grandchildren to come and stay at his house in a remote village after his wife dies, until the mourning period is over. However, due to urgent matters, Rahma must return to the city, while her children remain at home. Day by day, various mysterious events begin to haunt Daeng Sarro's grandchildren.

title: Cuerpos en tránsito
overview: In a women's prison in Montevideo, the inmates participate in an art class where they bond and find new ways to express themselves.

title: The Tinderbox Against the Magic Well
overview: Based on a story by H.C. Andersen, with new magical heroes, terrifying “woodpunk” robot dogs, real puppet theater, songs & dance numbers. Little Hans, a kind itinerant storyteller, opens his magic box, takes out his puppets, and, together with his spectators, creates a new fairytale. But not every character obeys the puppet master’s strings. The truth of the fairytale breaks everyday rules: here loyalty and friendship make miracles; love destroys the strongest magic spells; and a song wins a war!

title: KikoRiki: Through the Universes
overview: Krosh and the Hedgehog find an unusual device in Chamomile Valley that takes them into a game about the future, where they are ordinary children on a spaceship flying to Mars. Adventures begin when the characters realize that this is not a game at all.

title: Playback
overview: PLAYBACK is not just a biopic about Carlos Paião. It's a journey into the creative universe of one of the greatest geniuses of Portuguese music. Carlos studies Medicine, lives among books, exams, and expectations, but it is in the secret of melodies, words, and imagination that he finds the place where he truly breathes. In a country still discovering new sounds, he risks exchanging the security of a white coat for the uncertainty of stages, songs, and a dream bigger than himself. Between duty and desire, reason and intuition, fear and courage, Carlos builds a unique path, made of talent, humor, creative obsession, and an almost luminous urgency to leave his mark. PLAYBACK reveals not only the songs that made Carlos Paião an unforgettable figure in Portuguese music, but also the intimate universe from which they were born.

title: Korean Kanakaraju
overview: Follows a Rayalaseema youth named Kanakaraju whose life upends when a vessel from Korea brings a spirit that possesses him, transforming him into Korean Kanakaraju.

title: Robbie's Gonna Die
overview: When Robbie gets a mysterious message prophesying his soon-to-be demise, he and his friends try to get to the bottom of who's behind the ominous call, in all of the wrong ways.

title: White Musk
overview: Loosely based on the filmmaker’s own experiences, White Musk explores the tension that arises when a child is forced to parent their own parent. When her mother, Suraya, falls gravely ill, 19-year-old Hiba becomes her primary caregiver, while her older brother Hisham moves through the household largely unburdened. We watch Hiba and Suraya love each other and wound each other in equal measure, locked in a push and pull that neither knows how to break. As Suraya’s condition worsens, Hiba must navigate what it means to care for someone who cannot easily receive care, and what it costs her to keep showing up anyway.

title: Blue Lock
overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

title: Watch Out for the Ghosts
overview: A personal meditation on loss, family, home and reclamation through the artistic process of Adebunmi Gbadebo. Gbadebo creates works out of organic materials from the South Carolina plantation cemeteries where her formerly enslaved ancestors and their descendants are buried.

title: Potato Salad
overview: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

title: National Seating
overview: Pleas Everson Sr. waxes poetically about his history of employment.

title: Adaraneeya Tharuwak
overview: A singer’s journey to fame becomes a journey of love, loss, and a final promise to the woman he could never forget.

title: A Pint of Ink
overview: Through photographs, home videos, letters and personal recollections, Ester Geislerová composes a portrait of Japanologist, translator, journalist, educator, calligrapher—and her father—Petr Geisler, a charismatic charmer who remained mysteriously elusive even to his closest family.
A university student faces an important decision, whilst organizing his wardrobe.

title: Tiket Sehala
overview: Alif, Putri and Taqy, three Malaysians trapped in a human trafficking syndicate in South Korea, show the dark reality of labor exploitation and the struggle to return home.

title: Under The Impression You Are Flying
original_title: Under The Impression You Are Flying
overview: A girl traverses landscapes that change without logic, following an inner voice that accompanies, seduces, and confuses her. Between empty beaches, off-axis skies, and faceless presences, reality slowly dissolves into a hypnotic flow of temporal voids, euphoria, and anxiety.

title: DCI 2026: Big, Loud and Live
overview: Experience the thunderous power and precision of the world’s finest marching music ensembles. “Big, Loud & Live” brings the 2026 Drum Corps International World Championship Prelims to the big screen, broadcast live from Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. Beyond your average halftime show, the talented ensembles of Marching Music’s Major League blend world-class musicianship with breathtaking choreography and spellbinding visual formations. You’ll have the best seat in the house to witness the top 15 drum corps go head-to-head competing for their shot at the 2026 DCI World Championship title. From the earth-shaking roar of the brass to the lightning-fast precision of the percussion and color guard, see and hear every detail in stunning high definition. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or looking for a one-of-a-kind, live musical event, this is the ultimate way to experience the pinnacle of the marching arts.

title: How to Survive a Marriage
overview: Maryana is a successful divorce lawyer, but her own marriage to Dima is far from ideal. On her birthday, her mother, the eccentric provincial actress Margarita, unexpectedly arrives. In an attempt to stay and bond with her daughter, Margarita claims Dima has an affair.

title: 6 grams
overview: Four fathers meet in the secondary school gym, where the headmistress has summoned them after a bag containing a suspicious white powder was found amongst their sons’ belongings during a skiing trip. Each of them arrives with different excuses and the conviction that it is their child who is innocent. What’s more, the headmistress knows that a local councillor is trying to secure her job for his mistress, and she suspects that the whole situation is part of a campaign against her. The meeting thus quickly descends into a series of misunderstandings, accusations and increasingly absurd situations. One afternoon that spirals completely out of control for everyone involved.

title: Milk
overview: After Charel kills his mother's favorite fish, he runs away from home.

title: Everytime
overview: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife  for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun,  past and present quietly start to overlap.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Hill 338
overview: New comedy film inspired by the Israeli classic "Halfon Hill Doesn't Answer", released to celebrate its 50th anniversary. Somewhere in the Great Rift Valley stands a small, forgotten, and seemingly useless military base. When the Chinese government offers the state of Israel an enormous sum of cash to lay the path of their new Silk Road through it, all that seems to be done is to shut this base down. Ran Shem Tov, a "disassembly officer" who was deployed to command due to "military streamlining needs", is recruited for this mission. But the thing Ran and the heads of the IDF don't know is that an old bunker was built beneath the base, for which no one remembers the cause of construction. Lately, strange things have been happening in it, which delay the base's shutdown. These events bring all soldiers together against internal and external forces.

title: To Run Is To Return
overview: A young Black British man drives his car through a London landscape with skill as his music blares. His old lanyard that exposes his profession as a pharmacist dangles on the rearview mirror, bouncing to the beat of his music. He is willing it to be a good day. But as he approaches his destination, the cracks begin to show.

title: Rehmat
overview: Three interconnected stories in present-day Punjab. A woman secretly shelters a wounded stranger within her home, while his family endures the weight of grief and impossible choices. Meanwhile, a mysterious elderly man arrives in a village, calling himself God.

title: Super Troopers 3
overview: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

title: Der Griff nach den Sternen. Wie Europa lernte, zum Mond zu fliegen
original_title: Der Griff nach den Sternen. Wie Europa lernte, zum Mond zu fliegen

title: Red Lady With Two Guns
overview: On her wedding day in 1938, Gao Shengnan saw her husband brutally murdered by the Japanese army and her elders slaughtered. Taking up arms to rally a resistance force, she struck repeatedly at the invaders, earning widespread renown; later, guided by the Eighth Route Army, she resolved to join the revolution. When the Japanese attempted to lure her into a trap, she faced the enemy alone, risking her life to ensure the safety of her fellow villagers. At the critical moment, the Eighth Route Army launched a surprise attack and wiped out the enemy, but Gao Shengnan lay bloodied on the battlefield—her fate hanging in the balance...

title: Missing delivery
overview: A boy looks for his missing brother after he disappeared

title: Cannelloni
overview: Inspired by true events, this is a nocturnal thriller that follows the 2015 kidnapping of Chichita—mother of writer Hernán Casciari—by Daniel Olesnik. Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

title: Aotearoa Savior
overview: A teenage boy is confronted by a demon that forces him to steal children’s blood being secretly stored by the government.

title: Greta e le favole vere
overview: Nine-year-old Greta loves making Christmas decorations with her babysitter, Katy. She believes so strongly in Santa Claus that she decides to deliver a letter to her neighbor, Nicola, who leads her to believe he is Santa's personal assistant. Of course, Nicola has been lying; when Greta exposes the truth, he confesses that he has no connection to Santa Claus. To make amends, Nicola—a talented illustrator—draws an animated fairy tale for her that will change her life.

title: Ish Meets a Mermaid
overview: An Ojibwe artist named Ish finds that his paintings aren’t selling anymore, he is in debt to his gallery rep, and a local goon is lurking around his studio. When he decides to take an artist’s getaway, he meets trouble with a mysterious woman, Ziibi, who claims to be part of an underwater society that tribal mythology refers to as the people of the water, or Nibiinaabe. Ziibi brings Ish on a wild ride that ultimately leads to him finding success in the last place he ever expected — death.

title: Derborence The Age of Animals
overview: High on the Diablerets massif, the cable car unloads skiers. On the other side of the mountain, in a kind of mirror image, silence prevails, along with the quiet, hidden life of Derborence's wildlife.

title: When They're Gone
overview: After an abrupt encounter at a graveyard, two elderly men form an unexpected bond over the grief and love of their late wives.

title: MAJU (Jejak Pahit si Kembang Gula)
overview: Mr. Wira is a teacher and scout leader for a group of his students. They plan to survey the location of the Scout Jamboree in Segosari village. Bagas, a big fan of the popular candy variety at that time, did not join his teacher and friends to visit the Village Head's house. Bagas was feeling unwell and just waited in the car. Upon returning from the Village Head's house, Bagas disappeared. The presence of Adit, a village boy who often gets bullied by other children, becomes an important key to finding Bagas.

title: Hotel Falcon's Glow
overview: After losing her heroic husband, Oksana, the owner of a small hotel, strives to preserve his memory and her own dream. She is supported by Roman, a war veteran who finds a new calling in peaceful life. Together, they stand up to a powerful competitor who is trying to destroy their business.

title: The Last Warrior: Kolobok
overview: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: Nimrods
overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: Flieg steil
overview: Konnie, a respected musician in the right-wing scene, loses her reputation when she incorporates feminist and queer content into her music. In order to rehabilitate herself, she uses the outsider punk Rudi, who wants to attack a Nazi pub. But both end up fighting a battle for belonging - who will be left standing?

title: Rage of Stars
overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

title: The Last House
overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
original_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

title: The Belt
overview: A young woman's night unravels into chaos after she accidentally locks herself into a chastity belt during a house party and loses the key.

original_title: Soccer Tips & Tricks Vol. 1 With Björn Florg
overview: Since the Cold War, American's have come to love the European game known as "Fütbol", or as we American's call it, Soccer. But no American's can touch the European flavor that comes from being Björn and raised in the region. That's why 3 time World Cup Nominee Björn Florg started this video series; to share the tips and tricks he's learned over his many years in the game for your to enjoy from the comfort of your living room! From scoring to ball-handling, Björn leaves no stone un-turned, and no ball un-handled! Follow  Björn as he takes you from the couch to the pitch in this first installement of a proposed 2 part video series.

title: Talk To A Stranger
overview: Two people meet in an elevator.

title: No Contact
overview: Nostalgia, Black Eyed Peas, and the unwritten rules of New York City dating. When two strangers meet on a bench, a 21-day "break" turns into a masterclass on romance, airport running tropes, West Side Highway running etiquette, and what it actually takes to win someone back.

title: Europe101
overview: Europe101 is a video project resulting from videos videos A. Harun filmed in 34 European countries between 2016-2026.

title: hovers
overview: hovers reconstructs a fleeting goal celebration from a football video game into a hypnotic stop-motion loop of nearly three-meter-high paintings. Centered on the logic of leapfrog, in which subject and object continually reverse, the gesture is stripped of its momentary festivity and becomes a hollow ritual. Refusing the game’s resumption, this “active hovering” sustains perpetual liminality against the system’s demand for resolution.

title: Entrepreneurship BootCamp – The Documentary
overview: More than 100 people gather to take part in a BootCamp organized by TRAMA, a student group from the Instituto Tecnológico de Buenos Aires.  The documentary goes behind the scenes to showcase the TRAMEROS’ ongoing work, as they face challenges and overcome difficulties in pursuit of their goal: to create the best BootCamp in history.

title: Lay's da Probabilidade
overview: Just like Tony Carreira, we all have a “boy’s dream”. Nuno’s and Vasco’s dream? See in-person the Portuguese National Team play at the World Cup.  But, travelling to the USA isn’t cheap. Specially for two dudes who spend half of their pay check in pints of beer. What if they put everything on the line for a giveaway? Would the odds be in their favour? Genius move or joke of the year?

title: In between hills
overview: A story of domestic violence is passed down orally across three generations. Blending family photo archive with fiction, the narrative reconstructs the night the director's female ancestors survived against all odds.

title: Lady in Yellow
overview: There is a local tale in Burma about the Lady in Yellow, the bringer of death. She is well known by the name 'Ma Phei Wah'. The story unfolds after a group of teenagers talks about her in the middle of the night, leading to strange events.

title: Rocket USA Experiments #1
overview: The first of many short experiments for the upcoming feature length film 'Rocket USA'.

title: Somos Rōnin
overview: Ibai and the Ronin FC team share the challenges and intensity they experienced during their inaugural year in Catalan football. The documentary shows the club's formation process, the management of the demanding preseason, and their ambition to professionalize every aspect of the team as they compete in the regional leagues.

title: L.A. Bars & Cigarettes
overview: Drunk and in desperate need of a cigarette, a high-strung nicotine fiend strikes up a conversation with a fellow smoker— but his quest for a quick fix soon devolves into an existential nightmare.

title: Heretical Girls
overview: A montage of unconnected scenes and vignettes showcasing all kinds of folk depravity and foul ecstasy.

title: When A Soul Fades
overview: A young girl stands before the mirror day after day, believing she is simply getting ready. Yet, with every glance, every outfit, and every passing moment, something within her quietly disappears. When a Soul Fades is a silent portrait of the slow, almost invisible loss of one’s inner light.

title: More Than A Saint
overview: More Than a Saint is an hour-long documentary about quarterback Drew Brees, highlighting his profound impact on the New Orleans community and his historic football career ahead of his Pro Football Hall of Fame induction.

title: Stanze per una giostra
overview: "Stanze per una giostra" is an experimental short film that traverses bucolic childhood memories and adolescent traumas using low resolution and grainy imagery.

title: SP433 - The Record Breaker
overview: 7NEWS will bring viewers into the inner sanctum with unrivalled access to Collingwood great Scott Pendlebury as he prepares to mark his incredible milestone of 433

title: That's Not Me
overview: While filming a crime drama, an actress struggles to get into character as the director’s increasingly inept direction turns the scene into a psychological power struggle.

title: The Chair
overview: On Halloween evening, a live in couple settle into their new 1BHK with one ordinary chair, and slowly nothing about the night stays ordinary.

title: The Jeweler
overview: After being caught one too many times, Amr El Barouqy, a famous jeweler with a weakness for women, is forced to put aside his traditional male pride. When his strong-willed wife Yasmine insists on building a healthier and more balanced life together, the couple turn to relationship counselor Dr Kareem and embark on an unconventional therapy program to save their marriage. However, instead of bringing them closer, each step unleashes a new wave of chaos, turning their attempt to fix their relationship into a series of escalating disasters.

title: The Odyssey of N
overview: an experimental film about a trip to Italy made by the director, filmed with a camcorder

title: LILITH
overview: SHE LEFT ONE MORNING AND NEVER ARRIVED—NOW SOMETHING’S HOME, AND IT ISN’T ALIVE.

title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

title: Last Summer
overview: Min-woo, a young man who works at a local office in a rural village, lives with his father and grandmother and often hangs out with his close friend Seong-hoon. The weather is not exactly what the farmers want, and Min-woo continues to lead a quiet life.

title: Sorry, Charlie
overview: A remote helpline volunteer is targeted by "The Gentleman," a stranger who lures women from their homes with a recording of a crying baby.

title: AEW Grand Slam Mexico
overview: All Elite Wrestling is heading back to Mexico City this August with another special edition of AEW Grand Slam: Mexico. This highly anticipated event will emanate LIVE from Arena Mexico on Wednesday, August 5th :  -Kyle Fletcher (c) vs. Mike Bailey for the AEW International Championship  -Willow Nightingale & The Brawling Birds vs. Mercedes Moné & Divine Dominion  -The Demand (c) vs. Hangman Adam Page & Brodido for the AEW World Trios Championship  -Persephone vs. Kris Statlander  -Cage & Cope & The Young Bucks vs. Death Riders  -Mistico & Jericho & Darby Allin vs. Don Callis Family  -Tommaso Ciampa vs. Andrade El Idolo vs. Komander for the #1 spot in the casino gauntlet at All-In  -Mark Davis vs. Will Ospreay in a Mexico City Street Fight

title: Hi Kai
overview: A young man struggles to find the courage to send a voice note to a friend of his, turning a simple message into a quiet battle with hesitation, vulnerability, and fear of rejection.

title: Forever, Obviously
overview: A late 90's based short film about friendship and growing up.

title: Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone
overview: Romi and Heartsping embark on their first major adventure across the ocean. Joining them are several new characters, including Kite, a sea boy who serves as a guide on Romi's journey, as well as new Teenieping characters.

title: Honto ni Atta! Noroi no Video 116
original_title: ほんとにあった! 呪いのビデオ 116
overview: 116th entry in the popular "Honto ni Atta! Noroi no Video" film series.

title: Rodeo
overview: Two men meet one night to engage in a radical and mysterious act of intimacy.

title: Niu Lai
overview: Animation about a young cow named Niu Lai growing up to be a warrior.

title: Tailypo
overview: Deep in the Appalachian Mountains, a starving old man discovers a strange creature lurking inside his cabin. In a desperate act of survival, he cuts off a piece of the creature and takes it for himself. But as night falls, his desperation turns into terror when the ancient creature returns to reclaim what was stolen.

title: Something Good Going On
overview: A Chinese-Indonesian teen confronts a stolen restaurant paycheck, a strained father-son bond, and the cost of his Ivy League future.

title: Girl Downstairs Top Upstairs
overview: The official music video for Girl Downstairs Top Upstairs by Hot House. Also known as GDTU. Special thanks to Annie Wren and Emily Louise for helping to make all the objects fly!

title: Falsely So-Called
overview: FALSELY SO-CALLED is an existential story of a mother’s life that documents her descent to her inevitable death as reality literally begins to rip apart around her. As she loses her grip on her own mind, she begins to believe her own child is the cause of the world’s dematerialisation, whilst also discovering the true horror of her relationship with her fiance and past.

title: Viola Bacana
overview: A band with no shows scheduled. An Airbnb weekend they couldn't afford. Just a camera and the dream of leaving the Umuarama neighborhood.

title: Perspective
overview: A college student, after provoked, recounts a time with his old friend. But his vision is a little hazy, and sometimes he cannot tell what's real from what's not

title: Bullseye
overview: An argument between a couple escalates

title: Love is Stronger – Von Loveparade zu Rave The Planet
original_title: Love is Stronger – Von Loveparade zu Rave The Planet

title: RAGEBAIT
overview: On Halloween night, a socially parasitic live streamer becomes the target of a malevolent entity after a mysterious viewer curses his stream and forces him to watch a collection of cursed videos from missing content creators.

title: Roxana - A climate story
overview: In the Peruvian Amazon, many indigenous communities still live without reliable access to electricity or the internet. At the same time, large-scale fossil fuel projects are encroaching on the region. In Alto Mishagua, this contradiction forms the backdrop to Roxana’s story.  When Roxana returns home during the pandemic, her village feels more isolated than ever, and the warnings from the elders grow ever more urgent: their forest is changing, the rains are shifting, and life is becoming increasingly uncertain.  Together with other young people, she begins to imagine a different future, based on clean, independent energy.

title: Marinella
overview: In the Milan of the economic boom, Maria Boccuzzi –aka Marinella –is a young Calabrian in search of redemption. At just 16 years old, she runs away from home for love, but that choice leads her down a path of solitude, marginalization and broken dreams. Abandoned and without ties, she ends up in prostitution, continuing to pursue her desire to become a dancer. It is precisely that hope, never extinguished, that leads her to death at the hands of a mysterious man. Marinella will not have justice, but telling her story is an act of rebellion: a way to give her the dignity that life has denied her.

title: See and Observe
overview: A man starts watching a mysterious VHS tape. What follows is a succession of strange and disturbing images and sounds.

title: Evil Follows
overview: A husband's fight to save his wife from a demonic possession that began the moment the dybbuk box chose her as its next host.

title: Can’t Sleep at Silent Night
original_title: นอนไม่หลับ ในคืนที่เงียบสนิท
overview: One night, inside a small bedroom, a young woman sleeps peacefully on her bed. Outside, a large scale protest fills the streets with thousands of people. The distant roar of the crowd slowly intensifies, growing into chaos before the unrest finally erupts into violence.

title: No address found
overview: Building on the discourse around the infamous area of molenbeek in Brussels, the filmmakers invite you on a walk in a patchwork of places held together as a floating concrete jungle where logic is substituted by interwoven spaces held in absurd rooms. The journey tries to follow the logic of those who designate an area as a bad one, detaching it from a broader context, as no man is an island.

title: Oh Boy - A Will To Change
original_title: Oh Boy - A Will To Change
overview: Bas invites his friend Flor on a boys’ weekend in the French Ardennes to explore vulnerability. To facilitate this experiment, they adopt ‘Cowboy’ alter egos, in the hope that this role-play will help them get closer to themselves and to each other.

title: Gwen Everest
overview: “The song’s title is an obscure reference to a character in a short story by Frank Herbert. It was written from the perspective of someone watching a loved one set out on a path that was not recommended to them, able only to watch passively as events unfold.” – Panchiko

title: Our Town
overview: Grover's Corners is a quiet little town, full of ordinary folk, living everyday lives. They work, they laugh, they sing, they fall in love and raise their children and grow old. But within those moments of ordinary, everyday life, there are truths that reach out to us all. And a passionate demand to cherish every moment, right now, while we still can. (A joint Welsh National Theatre and Rose Theatre production, filmed at the Rose Theatre in Kingston, London on 19 March 2026.)

title: Trigger Happy
overview: A neon action-thriller about influencers fighting to the death at a live-streamed, lethal laser-tag match, exploring competition, revenge, and weaponized performance.

title: a spring glow
overview: A young woman is taken along to celebrate the arrival of spring.

title: Doctor in Duty
overview: A woman's health specialist is unwillingly required to be on full day and night duty aA woman's health specialist is unwillingly required to be on full day and night duty at hospital, a teenage girl asks the Dr for abortion to be performed for her. The film deals with the subject of abortion — a sensitive and universal issue. In many countries, restrictive laws cause deep harm to women or to children born into difficult circumstances. The film was completed three years ago, just one month before the “Woman, Life, Freedom” movement in Iran, during a time of strict regulations regarding women’s presence and dress. Post-production was paused for a year, and it was finally released in 2024. Through a blend of realism and surreal imagery, the film seeks to challenge social perceptions of women’s choices — whether to keep a child or to consider abortion If I wanted to make this film now under the current conditions, it would definitely have a different structure!

title: slushynoobzcanadatour2026thedocumentary
overview: This documentary showcases the creative thought process, back-of-the-van planning, and absolute chaos behind the cross-country journey of creators Hamzah Al-Emad and Martin Andrijasevic (Slushy Noobz). Spanning eight dates from June 23 to July 18, 2026, the film tracks their live streaming route across Canada—from Quebec City to Toronto—captured entirely by videographer Liam Bursey.

overview: A boy, a pill, a knife

title: I'm Going Full Frontal for My NYU Student Short Film
original_title: I'm Going Full Frontal for My NYU Student Short Film
overview: A man has second thoughts about the nudity in his film.

title: The Ghost Killer
overview: Old Wu, once a top assassin, lived a peaceful life under an assumed name at the Renxintang Pharmacy. However, this tranquility was shattered when single mother Song Xiaoqian was kidnapped by a gang. To rescue Xiaoqian, Old Wu returned to the underworld, engaging in a life-or-death struggle against a criminal gang led by Third Master and Zuo Lun. In the process, Old Wu uncovered the truth behind the murder of his wife and daughter ten years prior, discovering that the mastermind behind it all was none other than Master Xiang, whom he once respected. Ultimately, with his superb martial arts skills and unwavering conviction, Old Wu avenged his family and the innocent by killing his enemies and delivering justice.

title: The Doorman
overview: A freshman pledge guarding the biggest dorm party of the year faces a test of his commitment to the fraternity.

title: Supernova

title: A Way Out
overview: One call for help ignites a nationwide fight to end human trafficking.  A Way Out follows Safe House Project as they confront the reality of human trafficking in the United States and build a clear path to safety for survivors. The documentary centers on a simple turning point: a survivor makes a call for help. From there, the film tracks what happens behind the scenes as Safe House Project coordinates a rapid response, connects with survivor advocates, and works alongside law enforcement and trusted partners to move someone from immediate danger toward safety and justice. As the story unfolds, viewers see how a single call can set a nationwide network in motion, and how clarity, coordination, and courage can change the outcome for someone who feels trapped. The film balances the gravity of the issue with a strong sense of hope, showing ordinary people stepping into an extraordinary mission to make a way out.  —Clay Vaughan

original_title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

title: Death Note - The Musical

Death Note: The Musical is set to be the theatrical event of the summer.  When brilliant student Light Yagami discovers a notebook with the power to determine who lives and who dies, his mission to reshape society quickly spirals out of control and attracts the attention of the elusive and ruthless detective L. What begins as justice descends into obsession and forces both Light and L to confront the limits of morality itself.

title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
original_title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
overview: When the fairytale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

title: The Elder Eagle

The family members get a chance to reconnect with their roots, see each other in a new light, and become a close, loving family.

title: The Friendly Raccoon

Milan has a soft spot for the Czech countryside and is thrilled at the prospect of sleeping under the stars, whilst Týna would much rather be by the sea. Instead of relaxation, the tension between them only intensifies. After an unexpected incident at Trosky Castle, they decide to try something completely different – spending some time apart. Perhaps this way they’ll finally discover what’s really important in life…

By inventing a time machine, they revisit the pasts of their mothers and grandmothers and imagine a future in which they can be free, fulfilled, and in control of their own choices.

title: Screen of the Dead
overview: In a quiet backyard, Gaby finds her friends frozen over their phones. When they finally look up, an ordinary afternoon spirals into a bloody, absurd fight for survival.

But when the message ends, there is suddenly another one.

Lost in Territories explodes across the screen in five connected, chaotic, and bizarre stories that delve into the daily lunacy of the region.

Tiger balm ointment is used to create handmade chemigram sequences alongside inkjet-printed frames. Phantom spirits of tigers endlessly chase and are chased by the artists, veering between moments of both hope and futility of mass-manufactured relief to ever growing pains endured in our world.

As time slips by, his efforts to understand or escape the situation drive him deeper into despair, pushing him to the brink of collapse.

title: Four Films about Music (Silent Jazz / Orchestra / Pause / Interior Music)

overview: Many of my films evolve from a single shot, and quite often that shot is an immediate response to a situation unfolding in front of me. This is about the closest I get to improvising, a musical form I sometimes aspire to, but is difficult to attain as a filmmaker. That was how I shot the majority of films in this programme, using the convenience of the mobile phone in my pocket. I often sense immediately that something might be made from the situation I find myself in, but only after studying the shots on my computer do I discover the direction they might take. The third film Pause clearly involved some planning, but again, after the initial recording, I had to work with the fragments of sound and image to see where they might lead, in a lengthy process of trial and error. In Interior Music I am using the camera in direct response to music emanating from the Trinity Conservatoire in Greenwich. (EXiS — Experimental Film and Video Festival in Seoul, 2026)
