overview: Set in the early 1980s along the India-Pakistan border in Punjab, the story follows Nimma, a young Sikh student and poet from Indian Punjab, who falls deeply in love with Nasima, a Muslim girl from Pakistani Punjab.

title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
overview: Sanju moves from Nagpur to Mumbai for work and stays with his late mother's friend Viswanath. He falls for Viswanath's daughter Anu, but her marriage is arranged with another man, leaving Viswanath caught between friendship and fatherhood.

title: The Truthers
overview: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

title: שלושה ארגזים כחולים; חלל וגעגוע
overview: A child leaves home and returns in three IDF boxes, that became my biggest secret. My brother is dead. What if these objects are the only proof he was here? I look for him in a 60liter plastic box, objectifying my brother, humanizing the box.

title: Sana: Play with Me
original_title: だぁれかさんとアソぼ？
overview: Right before summer vacation, a "forbidden game" is secretly played at a high school. After some students take part in it, their ordinary days begin to change, and before long, a "certain incident" occurs. Taking the situation seriously, the school brings in a counselor, Koharu, to provide mental care for the students who witnessed the incident. However, one of the students who played the "game" turns out to be Koharu's sister, Nanami. One by one, the students are drawn into bizarre phenomena.

title: Perception
overview: Students in an art class are asked to draw the same nude model, but each interprets the subject in their own way. As their works reveal contrasting perspectives, the session becomes an exploration of perception, art, and the ways individuals project meaning onto what they observe.

title: Flicker
overview: In a future where gifted children are turned into weapons, Ava escapes the Blackwell Institute, desperate for freedom. Hunted by Bo, Ava must find freedom before the forces that created her destroy everything she's fighting for.

title: Insectasy
overview: Sadie struggles to find balance as she juggles work, her social life and her erotic fascination with insects.

title: Faithless
overview: After a personal loss, Savannah’s grief begins to distort her perception of reality. As she tries to understand what she is experiencing, her sense of faith, memory, and truth begins to break down.

title: Tenants of Lenapehocking in the Age of Magnets
original_title: Tenants of Lenapehocking in the Age of Magnets
overview: Tenants of Lenapehocking in the Age of Magnets is a collection of stories about the inhabitants of a land, specifically the Black community of North Philadelphia in the 20th century, an epicenter of African American social, cultural and political life both locally and nationally. The place of the documentary is a portion of the original homeland of the Lenape between the Delaware and Schuylkill rivers and the stories told cover an age of industry shaped by developing electromagnetic technology.  Featured oral history narrators include Chief Robert Redhawk Ruth, Dr. Rae Alexander-Minter, Rev. Joseph Williams, Cecily Moore Banks, Elaine Brown, David Litofsky, Dr. John Churchville, Rev. Frank Tyson, Jamaaladeen Tacuma and Karen Warrington. Their life stories are animated by photos from the archive of photographer John W. Mosely.

title: Uttar Da Puttar
overview: Vastu, destiny and daily life, where unexpected events challenge beliefs about luck, direction and the power to shape your own future.

title: The Woman Who Cannot Feel
overview: Tasha is a woman diagnosed with Congenital Insensitivity to Pain. This condition makes her incapable of feeling pain – be it physical or emotional pain. And because of her condition, she also has no idea how love works. Until she meets Ngongo, a man with cleft palate. Ngongo becomes an instrument who made Tasha feel again, especially the joys of love and pains of heartache. And together, they experience an adventure that they will never forget.

title: Luces de Colores
overview: Jaime, a master pyrotechnician from Valle de Santiago, Mexico, tells us how he decided to dedicate his life to pyrotechnics and how this tradition is kept alive throughout generations, despite the risks, adversities and accidents he and his family had suffered.

title: Rising Embers
overview: Two thousand years. One truth. Carried by ordinary people who refused to let their faith be silenced.

title: LAKESVILLE MOVIE
overview: Ruby and Silver travel to Liverpool to discover an old friend has been released from prison to assist them in uncovering a new murder plot.

title: The India Story
overview: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

title: Eiga Kamen Raidā Zettsu Sayonara no Misshon
original_title: 仮面ライダーゼッツ さよならのミッション
overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. Convinced of his innocence, Kensei Odaka/Kamen Rider NOX pursues the true culprit, and finally tracks down the mastermind behind it all, National Public Safety Commission Chairman, Shuma Kumon/Kamen Rider Mugen.

title: A Hora da Estrela
overview: The Hour of the Star

title: Chobiwala
overview: Vishwakarma is a photographer whose art is misunderstood by everyone around him. While the world calls him a failure, he finds beauty in capturing life's final moments. As poverty, love, and sacrifice test his marriage with Mala, they are forced to make an impossible choice that changes everything.

title: SORTIE
overview: A private detective investigating a missing person case becomes trapped in a hypnotic noir labyrinth, where he discovers that every exit leads back inside.

title: Chasing Dragonflies
overview: After running his grocery store for over 40 years, Chuck reflects on his childhood in South Korea and his lifelong commitment to serving the unique needs of Philadelphia’s Caribbean community. Now at 72 years old, his observations and pursuit of peace have brought him full circle.

title: Chō Uchū Keiji Gyaban Infiniti Taiyō ga Naita Hi
original_title: 超宇宙刑事ギャバン インフィニティ 太陽が泣いた日
overview: Negative Emorgy emanating from MultiEarth A0073 coalesced into a massive void that swallowed the sun. The world lost its light and was engulfed in deep darkness. The most formidable enemy, Gavan Killer, who aims to annihilate all Gavans, pushes Reiji and his friends into an unprecedented life or death situation.

title: La rabia
overview: First film directed by Daniela López Moreno. World Premiere at 30th Fantasia Film Festival.

title: Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi
overview: Navya, the only daughter of powerful businessman Devi Prasad, is set for a grand wedding that soon goes off track due to unexpected twists. As secrets unfold and egos clash, the celebration turns into a modern-day swayamvar.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: la fille aux talons d'argile
overview: Essay film based on the homonymous book  by Juliet Berto.

title: Max, Min and Meowzaki
overview: Max and Min are about to break up. They argue endlessly about dividing their possessions, including their cat, Meowzaki, whom they have named after their favorite artist Miyazaki Hayao. Max’s father Ramesh, who lost his wife and has since been suffering from insomnia, meets charming therapist Dhaara. Max’s grandfather Sridhar, secretly enjoys drinking with his new friend Jennifer at the nursing home.

title: Triple Decker
overview: Over the course of one bizarre day, a couple with a dangerous plan and a stranger with her own agenda find their lives colliding in the most unexpected ways. As secrets simmer beneath the surface, everything quickly spirals into a wild mix of chaos, dark humor, and perfectly timed misfortune—where every move only makes things worse.

title: The Proposal Project
overview: A special story where Abby gets engaged, and the whole process surrounding it.

title: Sound Across the Ocean
overview: The film recreates the situation as the struggle against French colonialism from 1945 to 1954. Tam is a young woman who plays Vietnamese traditional one-string zither and sings Xam folk songs. After helping a revolutionary soldier, her grandfather is shot dead by the enemy. Tam follows the revolutionary path, taking on the mission to Con Dao Island as a doctor to treat prisoners and work with the revolutionary organization.

title: At Wilberts End
overview: At Wilberts End is an lego animated shortfilm created by NickCraftNL, it’s a parody of “The Worlds End” What’s a better way to celebrate your birthday with your friends then doing The Golden Mile around your town?

title: Pura Vida
overview: 8 delegates set off for an all-expenses-paid Eco convention, in one of the worlds most exotic locations. But fantasies of sun, sea and salsa come crashing down when dreams turn to nightmares full of crocodiles and murder.

title: 俺の血はピンクの血 映画俳優久保新二
original_title: 俺の血はピンクの血 映画俳優久保新二
overview: A documentary about pink actor Shinji Kubo, "the King of Pink", that explores his fifty-year career spent racing through the fringes of the Japanese film industry.

title: Outback Dale
overview: After a social media meltdown, a middle aged man embarks on a wild journey to restore his reputation.

title: Return to My Blue
overview: A documentary about some disabled children go on a trip to a deserted island in Okinawa.

title: When you were here
overview: After her husband passed away, Elvia finds herself feeling lonely for the first time in nearly 60 years of marriage. At first, she struggles with grief, but eventually discovers a haven in the early light of sunrise, when she feels most inspired to write poetry.

title: La signora del male
overview: Born out of a stream of consciousness, "La signora del male" seeks to evoke the sensation of a caress – what precedes it and what follows it.

title: Living Corpse
overview: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.

title: Trouxe o Doce?
overview: A nervous courier delivers a mysterious package to a rich drug boss on a remote road, but when their deal reveals an unexpected twist, a sudden police chase turns a simple exchange into a high-stakes fight to escape.

title: The Taro Donatella Story
overview: From Underdog to legend - From silence to legend. The Taro Donatella Story is the true rise of a man who built an empire alone. A journey of ambition, obsession, and belief in the impossible. - "Mark Zuckerberg & Taro Donatella. One code. One invention. Who actually created the real-time algorithm? The truth behind the biggest lie in social media history - Coming Summer 2026."

title: Chum
overview: Randy and Filthy are two lowlife roadies who land a new gig and hit the streets on foot, crossing paths with a bizarre cast of characters. Along the way, they're gifted a strange, powerful fish-while being relentlessly stalked by their old rival, Texas.

title: Karavali
overview: Karavali is a film that explores the struggles between man and nature, set against the raw, untamed beauty of coastal Karnataka. The story revolves around the world of Kambala, a traditional annual buffalo race, showcasing the unique culture and challenges of the region.

title: Lost Chapters
overview: When Ena returns to Venezuela, after spending several years abroad, she discovers a postcard in her father's bookshop and sets off in search of a forgotten writer.

title: Slay the She-Wolves
overview: In Lower Canada, around 1850, sisters Augustine and Josephine Wilson suffer from a rare genetic disease that sets them apart from other women. They are secluded by their father, who is suffering from tuberculosis. After his death, they must confront a village dominated by religious superstition and fear of the devil. Hunted and perceived as she-wolves, they become the embodiment of rejection and emancipation, until a mysterious destiny leads them to their liberation.

title: Katukutu Buro
overview: Hunting for hope in a city ridden by immorality, young Kedar Barua is tickled into madness by ghosts of the past. Paro's love brightens his path to liberation, but a nefarious, superhuman vigilante emerges from the dark.

title: Haunted Heist
overview: Four estranged friends reunite at what appears to be a typical house, But one friend has ulterior motives; he plans to rob the place and needs their help to find an antique worth a fortune. But the house is straight up haunted, and the group must squash their differences to survive the night and an insane pack of ghosts.

title: The Stranger at the Door
overview: A grief-stricken recluse living in isolation after the death of his lover takes in a stranded traveler during a violent storm, unaware that the stranger is an ancient entity that feeds on the very trauma he has spent years trying to bury.

title: Bushe
overview: Marta, a lovesick 15 year old, pines for a local boy named Karlo. As the traditional local carnival approaches, its mystical atmosphere and mask making tradition will take her on a personal journey where she will discover the true meaning of her identity.

title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
original_title: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

title: Immersion
overview: An attempt at slow cinema.

title: The Nail
original_title: ធ្វើ ក្រចក
overview: Khmer horror film.

title: In Transit: Part II
overview: The Strokes continue their behind-the-scenes journey, capturing the collaborative process of refining musical ideas and experimenting with new sounds in a remote studio setting. The band navigates creative challenges and evaluates various song structures as they work toward crafting their next record.

title: SURPRISE
overview: A bathroom mishap at a surprise party sets off a chain of disastrous events that spiral wildly out of control.

title: Camila
overview: Camila (2026) is a Brazilian psychological drama short film written and directed by Anthony Candido. The film explores the aftermath of trauma and the transformative nature of the creative process through an intimate, psychologically driven narrative.  The story follows Clarice, a writer struggling with a debilitating creative block who moves into an isolated apartment in search of a fresh start. Cut off from the outside world, she is left with no choice but to confront emotions and memories she cannot fully understand herself. As the boundaries between reality, memory, and imagination begin to dissolve, the enigmatic figure of Camila (?) emerges as a guide through Clarice’s inner descent, while the unsettling presence of a supposed neighbor slowly turns the apartment into a space of growing unease.

title: EQUILIBRIVM II
overview: Anitta returns once again for the definitive look of "EQUILIBRIVM", her seventh studio album. On a healing journey through music and religion, we see the singer return to her roots once again.

title: Ethan Green's Nightmare
overview: On the morning of his history exam, a promising student oversleeps, finding himself trapped in a nightmare of his school — empty halls, locked doors, and choices that blur the line between failure and oblivion.

title: Wait!
overview: Inspired by a true-ish story, this tale dives into the quietly epic, absurdly mundane test of human patience: waiting at a crosswalk.
Four college students get into a car crash on the way to their graduation ceremony and the aftermath forces them to finally be honest with each other about what comes next.

title: XXXXX Livestream
overview: A 2hr album film shot over multiple sets; shooting on drones, infrared, cctv, steadicam, camcorders... with moving sets, lighting rigs, on-the-fly vision-mixing; a raw, instinctual, live performance. Shot without a full rehearsal, with the most incredible, creatively ambitious crew.

title: Passing Portrait
overview: A grieving artist gives everything she has into a memorial piece for her grandmother, alienating her friends and destroying a delicate new romance as she struggles to capture the light of a loved one she hasn't properly mourned.

title: N!PS
overview: A journey of a woman who braves public scrutiny to finally set her nipples free.

title: Floored
overview: An aging actress and a motley crew of Lorazapammed women summon a Westside pelvic floor guru to uncover the source of their pain. Enlightenment leads to a very bold decision.

title: Small Triumph
overview: A painter struggles with the toughest model she's ever had: her daughter.

title: Quando abandonamos a humanidade, o que resta de nós?
original_title: Quando abandonamos a humanidade, o que resta de nós?

title: Goodbye Lipaaaaaade
overview: As his internship comes to an end, a masked young man delivers a heartfelt farewell to the people and moments that shaped his journey. Through humor, gratitude, and quiet reflection, his final message celebrates an unforgettable chapter before he steps into the next one.

title: Polis
overview: Two Dutch-Turkish cops are forced to team up for a thankless assignment; escort computer nerd Jordy, who's posing as the world's most dangerous hacker.

title: Can I Sell My Soul?
overview: Andrew Sanford is an actor, writer, director, and family man. He’s decided to sell his soul to land a big audition, but things start to go south when it becomes clear that his intentions aren’t as noble as he claims.

title: Upstairs
overview: After a marathon of alien films in his basement, Tom notices some strange sounds and lights coming from upstairs.

title: Come to Brasil
overview: Look in the comment section of any celebrity and you'll see one comment more than any other: “Come to Brasil.” In the west, the phrase is brushed off as a meme, but for Brazilian fans, it's a rallying cry, a plea that unites fandoms in a country that even the biggest stars pass over on their so-called "world" tours. Through the eyes of four Rio de Janeiro pop music superfans, the most popular comment on the internet is explored as a vessel to highlight the uniting forces of music and the resilience of music lovers.

title: Pillars of Power: The Hidden Secret Behind Achieving Greatness
original_title: Pillars of Power: The Hidden Secret Behind Achieving Greatness
overview: Seven legendary co-stars of The Secret, alongside thought leaders Ken Honda, Sharon Lechter, and other visionaries, expose five hidden pillars of true greatness: Money, Relationships, Health, Mental Wellness, and Spirituality. Uniting leadership, science, and spirituality, Pillars of Power redefines success for a modern audience, revealing that greatness is built on inner harmony and purpose as much as outward achievement, inspiring a new generation of leaders and changemakers.

title: That We May See
overview: An intimate documentary on the lives and artistic journeys of Renato Habulan, Egai Fernandez, Pablo Baens-Santos, Jess Abrera, and Antipas Delotavo - pioneers of the Philippine Social Realist movement. Centered on the founding of KAISAHAN in 1976, the film examines how the realities of Martial Law under the Marcos dictatorship shaped a generation of artists committed to social engagement through their work. It also highlights the crucial role of CAYA (Center for the Advancement of Young Artists) in nurturing the movement's early development. Through personal reflections and historical and contemporary perspectives, the documentary traces the artists' shared ideals and divergent paths, revealing the challenges, convictions, and creative resilience that affirm their enduring vision of art as a force that shapes Filipino identity—as witness, critic, and visionary. Created in part through a grant of the National Commission on Culture and the Arts.

title: Leave No One Behind
overview: Suwardi (Suwardi Becak Lawu), a police officer with the rank of Assistant Commissioner, is transferred from Jakarta to his hometown in Garut to carry out a mission for the government’s Task Force on Human Trafficking (Satgas TPPO) to combat kidnapping and human trafficking. The joy of his return home turns into a nightmare when his own niece, Lilis (Cinta Kharisma), is kidnapped by a human trafficking ringleader. Overcome by deep guilt and in conflict with Asep (Iyang Darmawan), Lilis’s father, Suwardi forms a special task force to dismantle the largest human trafficking network in West Java, led by Rando (Macho Hungan). One ambush after another drags Suwardi into an escalating vortex of fistfights and shootouts until a shocking truth about Rando’s true identity is revealed.

title: See You Next Year, Maybe
original_title: Até o ano que vem, talvez
overview: In 2002, a group of teenagers broke into their hometown cinema to make a film. What began as an ambitious idea became the testament of a generation.

title: Blue Marks
overview: A young Israeli women moves to Paris to study fashion. after a chance encounter turns into rape, she faces an unwanted child and seeks revenge against the man who killed her dreams.

title: The Sex Worker's Guide to Parenting
original_title: The Sex Worker's Guide to Parenting
overview: The Sex Worker’s Guide to Parenting is a feature documentary rooted in the Los Angeles sex worker community. The film centers six parents working in the sex industry, including filmmaker Kimberly Ye, as they reflect on the overlapping demands of erotic labor, caregiving, secrecy, survival, and mutual support. Through intimate interviews, small group conversations, observational material, and animated reenactments, the project examines how parents in stigmatized and criminalized lines of work create family life on their own terms.

title: Mystery Inc. II: Curse of the 13th Spirit
original_title: Mystery Inc. II: Curse of the 13th Spirit
overview: With Mystery Inc. breaking up, Shaggy sets out to create a new team but when the gang uncovers an ancient chest that once opened, will unleash an ancient evil upon the world, they will need the help of a new mysterious friend who can send this creature back to where he came from, before the world is plunged into eternal darkness.

title: Sangkal
overview: Luna, a final-year university student, begins her thesis under the supervision of her lecturer, Mr. Garda, who initially seems kind and supportive. Behind his friendly facade, however, Mr. Garda abuses his position of power by sexually harassing Luna and threatening to delay her graduation if she refuses his advances. Deeply traumatized, Luna disappears without a trace. Her best friend, Laras, grows suspicious, only to find herself becoming the next victim of the same abuse.

title: Compliment Sandwich
overview: A couple, over the hump of the honeymoon period, moves into a more serious state of communication in their sexual relationship.

title: What Was She Thinking
overview: Four close friends, all proudly childfree women, take on every question the world throws at them with honesty, humor, and zero apologies.

title: PopoBawa
overview: When a curse is thrust onto him, a timid radio show writer is forced to decide between cursing his audience or facing death himself.

title: De Trut: 10 portretten
overview: De Trut is a household name in Amsterdam; a queer party that has been organized here every Sunday evening for 40 years, 100% by volunteers. The profits are used to subsidize LGBTQ+ projects worldwide. On the occasion of the anniversary, filmmaker P!m Mookhoek was allowed to make recordings within the walls of De Trut for the first time and delved into the lives of ten people who work or have worked at De Trut, dance or are supported by the fund. This documentary reviews a varied collection of portraits and demonstrates what De Trut means to everyone.

title: On The Line
overview: Allie, a young teenage girl finally gets her own landline. She decides to call random numbers and ends up meeting a lot of different interesting people! But she decides to meet up with one, which was a huge mistake.

title: A Malevolent World
overview: A full improv feature film that explores the awful realism of a zombie apocalypse in Northern England.

title: Sia: Nostalgic for the Present
overview: A bold experience that challenges the genre that trades pop poetry for pure art. Impressive voices, impressive choreography and iconic performances, captured cinematically and sounded by an unparalleled catalog of hits.

title: Dream High
overview: A cinematic rock opera and an homage to teen films, adapted from the stage musical with the same name by Amit Ulman, scripted completely in Hebrew rhymes. Yoav, a teenage boy who lives with his single mother, who struggles to finance them, moves to a new city. He joins Magshimim High, where words hit harder than punches, and your rhyming skills determine the food chain. After the "class king" demolishes him in a rap battle, Yoav is determined to prove himself and win the heart of the "class queen", Maya. He encounters Hamorabi, a legendary former rapper who hides under the image of the school's kiosk cashier. With his help, Yoav turns from an outcast to the Star of the Battles. But as he climbs high, he draws apart from the friends who stood by his side, the girl who really saw him when no one else had, and the authenticity taught to him by Hamorabi. In the National Rap Championship, Yoav will have to choose between chasing the shining lights of fame or staying true to himself.

title: Mones
overview: Cici, a trans woman, confronts her gender dysphoria at her younger brother Teddy’s fraternity during a historic Pride party/drag show she put together with her best friends. As the drag performers, frat boys, and queers mingle, Cici has a romantic encounter with a familiar young man that leads to her overcoming her mental hurdles around being a woman. Ultimately, she learns the universal truth of womanhood… sometimes your titties just hurt! A high energy comedy that explores questions of identity.

title: Hasta el fin del mundo
overview: Manuel's life is upended when Esmeralda, his lost love from 15 years ago, calls unexpectedly. Despite being set to marry another, he rediscovers Esmeralda, and they realize their love transcends time.

title: My Wild Friend: Returning Home
overview: When Sasha meets his wild friend, Red the fox, again, he learns that the fox's family has been kidnapped by a traveling zoo. The boy resolves to bring them home at all costs. A dangerous journey and a meeting with a new true friend awaits him.

title: บอดี้การ์ดหน้ามน
original_title: บอดี้การ์ดหน้ามน

title: English
overview: Two friends run a gun-selling business in Australia. When one kills the other’s girlfriend and flees to Turkey, the betrayed friend sets out to take revenge. A tale of love, betrayal and revenge in Australia and Turkey.

title: Rubberhead: The Life & Monsters of Steve Johnson
original_title: Rubberhead: The Life & Monsters of Steve Johnson
overview: Known for his intense work ethic, perfectionism, and obsession with breaking new ground, Steve Johnson has created iconic creatures and effects for some of the most beloved genre films in cinema history, working with everyone from John Carpenter, David Cronenberg, and Sam Raimi to James Cameron, Steven Spielberg, and Guillermo del Toro. His drive and ambition also led to heartbreaking acts of self-sabotage, divorce, and a serious drug addiction.

title: Anak-Anak Bambu
overview: Netta planned to sell the orphanage to solve her family's problems. However, after getting to know the orphans living there, especially Gebang, she realized that family isn't just about blood ties, but about caring for each other. This journey led Netta to discover the meaning of family that had been missing from her life.

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.

title: Juminten Edan
overview: Juminten, a mute woman, returns to her hometown with her husband and child after eight years away. Initially welcomed warmly by her family, their happiness changes when Juminten begins to behave strangely and endanger those closest to her. When her dark past is revealed, the safety of her family and the entire island is threatened.

title: THE OATH
overview: From the beautiful team at Filler Arc comes a loud -  raw - short-form documentary - look into hardcore music scene and what it means to be apart of it.

title: Cuz You're Ugly
overview: Avigail, an overweight and insecure 18-year-old midshipwoman, returns home to the stuffy apartment in Jerusalem which she shares with her dysfunctional mother and with her young sister. Avigail hopes to untie the chains of her childhood, But something else happens when she returns home: Her young sister got knocked up. Now, instead of getting rid of her virginity- she has to get rid of a baby.

title: A Friendly Invitation
overview: A trans man tries to educate his new neighbors while his roommate shows his problematic nature.

title: Beyond
overview: Beyond is the story of a little hero as he makes a journey from loneliness to finding community. On this journey, he encounters an array of fascinating creatures and environments, always looking to experience the new opportunities in front of him but hindered by his inability to follow where they are heading. Ultimately, his journey leads him to a place of peace and resolve, within a community that he can fully be a part of.

title: Butterfly Effect: Azzam
overview: Azzam a 12-year-old boy is suddenly transported to an isolated world of butterflies during a family trip to the south of Saudi Arabia. Transformed into a butterfly, he must find himself to find his way back to the real world and his family.

title: Home Bodies
overview: Two children, raised in total isolation by an automated house, begin to confront the mysteries of their existence after an enigmatic stranger arrives from outside.

title: Fruit Gathering
overview: In industrial Yangon, young factory worker San Kyi dreams of returning to her native village. Her relationship with co-worker Theint Theint Oo evolves from closeness to growing distance, revealing tensions between their expectations and life prospects. Amid exhausting labour, social repression, and economic uncertainty, both women seek escape and intimacy.

title: Love in Slow Motion
overview: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

title: Mosquito Halo
overview: Police investigate Dream Harvester, a political faction opposing the digitization of consciousness.

title: Fake Hundreds
overview: After a cancer diagnosis, a man tries to confront God.

title: Idols
overview: A wannabe kpop idol meets her famous lookalike.

title: Motor City
overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

title: Ecos do Teatro Experimental do Negro
original_title: Ecos do Teatro Experimental do Negro

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

title: Contention
overview: Siblings are taken hostage by a young girl with mysterious abilities. However, their captor is on the run from a cunning man who is hellbent on returning the girl to her prison.

title: Etheric Realms of the Night (The Complete Album Film)
original_title: Etheric Realms of the Night (The Complete Album Film)
overview: Etheric Realms of the Night is a feature-length album film that follows a woman slipping between the waking world and a surreal dream dimension. As she journeys deeper into this liminal space, she is pursued by Hypnos, the Greek god of sleep, blurring the boundary between reality and illusion. Structured as a modern Greek tragedy, the film unfolds as a descent into the subconscious, exploring themes of somniphobia, astral projection, and the fragile nature of consciousness, with the band IATT serving as a haunting chorus guiding the narrative.

title: Talking Tom Hero’s on the Big Screen

title: Riviera 76, le Woodstock oublié
overview: This legendary event was meant to be “the French Woodstock.” Almost no one remembers it today, because nothing — absolutely nothing — went according to plan... But in 2020, this extraordinary story resurfaced with the discovery of 153 metal canisters hidden away in a cellar, containing an untold number of film reels. Unseen for decades, these reels preserve the memory of an incredible chapter in music history : three days of a music festival at the height of the summer of 1976. A 350-hectare open-air site at the Paul Ricard Circuit in Le Castellet. The American organizers behind the legendary Woodstock at the helm. Joe Cocker roaring on stage. An expected crowd of 100,000. A budget of $1 million. The Rolling Stones' mobile recording truck on site to capture the performances for a live album... And yet, in the end, it all collapsed into spectacular failure—against the backdrop of the Var region's criminal underworld.

title: To my sisters

Simply put, they were advanced in years, and I wanted to leave some footage as memories for my future children.I shot numerous short films and wrote dozens of screenplays over those years, yet none of them ever went anywhere.My maternal grandmother passed away in 2018, followed by my paternal grandmother in 2020, and my dream of making films crumbled completely during that period.It was not until one day, as I looked at my own child, that it suddenly dawned on me: those trivial daily recordings might well be the most precious footage I had ever captured. title: Rabbit on a Highway
overview: A neurotic, alcoholic trans man struggles through navigating his social and love life.

title: If You Can Make It Here
original_title: If You Can Make It Here
overview: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

title: Lakshmikanthan Kolai Vazhakku
overview: A young man convicted of murder awaits execution, while a conflicted judge, an aging hangman, and a morally torn jailer confront the weight of justice, guilt, and humanity in the final hours before dawn.

title: NAXOS
overview: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

title: Cinco días con Lara
overview: Lara Martorell is a transgender actress working to make a name for herself in the acting world. On a trip to Asturias, where she lives, we’ll take a look at her present and her past to understand the long journey that has led her to become the Lara she is today.

title: Winter Lights
overview: Experimental short movie shot during Christmas and New Year's Eve.

title: All Wishes Come True!
overview: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

title: Ramón Vázquez
overview: His name is Ramón Vázquez. He comes from La Pampa and wants to reach Soto, near Córdoba, to reunite with his father. He has not seen him in thirty years. The difficult journey gives rise to a series of encounters on the threshold. And the light blinds.

title: Life Support
overview: Since October 2023, Gaza has been sealed from the world-except for one group. International doctors breach the blockade, what they find is not just a humanitarian crisis, but a calculated dismantling of life itself.

title: Isso Não é um Violão
overview: The virtuoso guitarist Artur Miranda Azzi shatters the conventions of classical guitar, reinventing the instrument as a dynamic medium for avant-garde experimentation. Through six bold and innovative performances of contemporary works, Azzi dismantles traditional techniques, transforming the guitar into a living, evolving entity—one that defies expectations at every turn.

title: Hen Don't
overview: A late night hen party spirals out of control when the bride's older sister and the maid of honour have conflicting ideas of how the bride should celebrate her last night of freedom.

title: Foam of Worlds
overview: A mother and her young daughter live on the island of Sant’Erasmo, Venice. As the waters continue to rise, each responds in her own way to the ecological emergency, to the risks of destruction and disappearance that compel us to care for all living things.

title: Diary of the Future
overview: To be fifteen, armed with a MiniDV camera, filming one’s adolescence in the 2000s in order to rediscover it later: friends, desires, holidays… Twenty years on, the tapes are unearthed and the diary rewritten in the future perfect, with all the fervour and tenderness of that time.

title: Shit Story
overview: Sid Silver spirals from existential dread to the best way to battle mosquitoes, questions a breakup cliché that makes no sense, revisits the Telegram ban through a corporate analogy, and reflects on the demise of a man on his way to work, only to inevitably end up in a story involving literal shit.

title: Lenin
overview: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

title: Artichoke
overview: Held captive in a violent relationship, Cynara discovers a phoropter that opens a portal to another world. In a terrifying cat-and-mouse chase between realities, Cynara finally comes face to face with her oppressor and must decide what she’s willing to destroy in order to survive.

title: Winnipeg, Seeds of Hope
original_title: Winnipeg, El Barco de la Esperanza
overview: At the end of the Spanish Civil War, almost half a million people moved by fear of reprisals to France. A hundred thousand of them were children. The French Government overflowed by the human avalanche, put them in improvised refugee camps. Chilean poet Pablo Neruda, former consul in Spain before the war, convinced the President of Chile to save more than two thousand refugees. The film tells the story of Julia, a little girl that escapes Barcelona with his father, a young widower. They embarked on the Winnipeg, a ship chartered by Neruda. That saved them from a dark future in Europe. Now, she is “a daughter of Neruda”, as the descendants of the 2,200 refugees call themselves.

title: Aajo Ardhangini
overview: Set against the backdrop of an unexpected wedding invitation, a chance reunion after two years of estrangement forces two women to confront their deeply entangled, hidden past. As their unresolved history resurfaces in the shadows of the Chatterjee household, an unsuspecting husband finds himself increasingly caught in a web of unspoken anxieties.

title: Critical Path
overview: Critical Path offers an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at the engineering marvel that is the SpaceX Starship program. The documentary details the iterative design philosophy, the high-stakes testing, and the relentless drive to build the largest and most powerful rocket ever flown. From the first conceptual sketches to the atmospheric re-entry and landing attempts, this film chronicles the single, complex path of innovation required to make life multi-planetary.

title: The Floaters
overview: Struggling musician Nomi accepts a last-resort job from her overachiever best friend Mara: mentoring misfit campers, the “Floaters,” at their childhood Jewish summer camp. As the camp struggles to survive amidst competition with a longtime rival, Nomi, the Floaters, and Mara must overcome their differences to bring the community together and save the camp.

title: NOXIOUS
overview: Created as his HKU graduation project, Kay Hilman’s animated short film, NOXIOUS, is a haunting exploration of a world reclaimed by nature. Created in Blender with a hand-drawn illustrative style, it imagines a impressive but terrifying new lifeform that has decided to claim our planet for itself. The music and sound design by Mikael Umarov helps set the mood.

title: The One Next Door
overview: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

title: The Witness
overview: After witnessing the death of her roommate, a teenage girl is pursued by the relentless killer who was responsible for the murder.

title: Flowery Voices
overview: After a fight, a young man calls up a friend.

title: Protozoa
overview: Protozoa, a lonely fluke of nature, faces Earth's evolutionary winner, the mussels, to stop their evil plot of devolving all other life on Earth into complete extinction.

title: Love Oh Love
overview: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.

title: Goblin II
overview: Five years later, Sara and Sam face off against a familiar foe amidst a village in chaos, risking everything to protect what they love as evil rises again.

title: Pinjar
overview: ‘Pinjar’ is an evocative meditation on captivity—of bodies, of spirits, of choices—unfolding through the entangled lives of five individuals and a wild bird.

title: Mockbuster
overview: A struggling filmmaker’s opportunity collides with chaos and compromise when Sharknado’s notorious studio, The Asylum, invites him to direct a "mockbuster."

title: The making of "The Kaptain: The story of Francesco Silvestre"
original_title: The making of "Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre"
overview: The story behind the production of "Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre" (2025)

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
overview: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

title: The Misadventures of Girth Brooks
overview: Prequel short film to “BUM” (2025)

title: Idhayam Murali
overview: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

title: Ikka
overview: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

title: Dhamaal 4
overview: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

title: The convent
overview: Lucía and Ana Ma, two young postulants recently arrived at a small convent, find themselves involved in the strange events that occur there.

title: The Outer Threat
overview: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

title: The Isolate Thief
overview: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

title: Down the Long River
overview: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

title: All the Queens Houses
overview: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

title: Laundry day lovers
overview: In conversation over dirty clothes, Paul and Ed air out their true feelings for one another.

title: Love on a Tightrope
overview: In 1960s Spain, legendary trapecist Pinito del Oro hires young poet Natalia Sosa Ayala to help with her memoirs, sparking a profound emotional bond between them. Through historical events, intimate encounters, and decades of letters, their admiration, affection, and creative passion intertwine. The story moves between memory, desire, and imagination, showing how these two artists influence each other’s quests for freedom, artistic expression, and recognition. Rooted in real moments but told with a dreamlike, imaginative lens, it explores what might have been between them, revealing a tender, evocative tale of connection, longing, and the courage to defy societal constraints.

title: L'incasable
overview: Humiliated by feeling rejected yet again, 14-year-old Solal gets into a fight with Thomas, a counselor at his home. Joris, his 10-year-old roommate, fascinated by Solal, has no intention of letting him go.

title: Baby Doe
overview: At 22, Gail gave birth alone and left her newborn in the woods. Decades later, she's arrested for murder, despite claiming the baby was stillborn. This documentary explores the fallout when young women cannot accept the reality of an unplanned pregnancy.

title: Heard
overview: A group of girls are dancing in a field, when suddenly one of them is harmed after seeking shelter from a storm. Struggling to keep up with the herd after the incident, she must choose whether to stay or to face the unknown.

title: Dalai Lama - Ocean of Wisdom
overview: A documentary that depicts the dalai lama between 1991 and 2022 as he conveys inspirational message about secular ethics, non-religious spirituality, inner peace development, loving kindness and the need of change to the education system with emphasis on inner values, mind and emotions.

title: Code for the People
overview: Short documentary by the makers of WordPress about the fight for the open web. Who built it, who’s trying to close it, and what you can do about it.

title: Bump
overview: An expectant mother's world fractures as she obsesses over what her child's future might cost the planet - and what the planet might cost her child.

title: ANSIA(nia)
overview: Nena is a young woman obsessed with her appearance and with the idea of growing old. Influenced by a culture that turns female aging into something to fear, she develops an anxious relationship with both the mirror and her own body. When she buys an anti-wrinkle cream in an attempt to stop time, she begins to realise that her struggle is futile. During a visit to her grandmother, she encounters an elderly woman who is happy, confident and at peace with herself. This meeting changes Nena’s perspective: aging stops being a monster and becomes a natural continuation of life.

title: The Widowmaker
overview: An influencer, Cassia, desperately seeking clout, plays a dangerous game with a dark web seller in this found footage thriller short.

title: Gumashta
overview: Completed in 1991 by the acclaimed director and writer Eng. Latif Ahmadi, "GUMASHTA" stands as a poignant reflection of societal realities, human struggle, and justice.  Due to the outbreak of the Afghan civil war shortly after its completion, this film never received its official theatrical premiere. For over three decades, it remained locked away in the archives—an untouched time capsule of a golden era of Afghan filmmaking.  Now, for the very first time, the original Final Cut of the film is being presented to the public exactly as it was intended to be seen.

title: Depth
overview: It’s a short documentary, supported by Ithra and the Cultural Fund, about Saudi diver Ahmed Al-Jaber, who undertakes one of the most dangerous jobs in the world. The film details Ahmed's daily work at a marine maintenance company, where he dives to great depths to repair and maintain oil pipelines. It also highlights the daily dangers he faces and the intense work pressure.

title: Bobby Josh: Shadow Of Darkness
overview: When a string of mysterious disappearances shakes the city, seven friends uncover a terrifying truth—the mastermind behind the chaos is Bobby Josh, a brilliant but ruthless figure who thrives in the shadows. As Tanner Pridemore, Ian B, Lucas Galloway, Ian Stevenson, Garylee Michael Smith III, Brandon Lopez, and Gavin Latourette race to stop his deadly plan, every clue pulls them deeper into a web of deception, betrayal, and fear. With time running out and darkness closing in, they'll have to risk everything to face the man who always seems one step ahead. In the end, the greatest threat isn't what's hiding in the dark—it's who controls it.

title: Tender and Cruel
overview: Set during the days when all communication is cut off, the film follows a lover stranded in silence, aching for any sign of the woman he loves. With no news and no certainty, his longing stretches across distance and time. Wandering through the quiet, storied streets of Cambridge, he reflects on memory, absence, and the fragile threads that bind him and his beloved. As old streets and gentle rivers surround him, he reads a letter addressed to her, words that become both confession and prayer.

title: Peace, Peace!
overview: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

title: Nocaretown
overview: In the surreal town of Nocaretown, a group of bizarre characters become entangled in a dangerous, absurd quest centered on a mysterious wooden box.

title: Note From a Gutter Boy
overview: After a young man is murdered in a violent street brawl in Melbourne's western suburbs, his best friend Tommy recounts the circumstances that led to his demise during a court-ordered group therapy session.

title: Mercury Dripping Down My Spine
overview: A young woman has her fate decided upon the result of a fatal accident.

title: Murder Game
overview: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: Bad Luck
overview: A suicidal taxi driver must confront his own mortality when he finds himself complicit in the attempted murder of a diabetic cat

title: Rage Against the Dying of the Light
original_title: Rage Against the Dying of the Light
overview: Often described as ‘avant-garde punk’, Dublin musician Meryl Streek is dark and dangerous – a cocktail of rage and despair. Onstage he’s a prowler – menacing, apoplectic, and snarling like a young Joe Strummer. Rage Against the Dying of the Light is not only a portrait of an artist, but a snapshot of a challenging time in Irish culture amid a massive housing crisis and a fear of artistic homogenisation – highlighting the importance of dissenting, unique and rousing voices.

title: Sludge
overview: Sinead Murphy’s debut film, Sludge, follows a young homeless woman living on the fringes of Irish society and deeply in love with her best friend. Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

title: The Echo of You Leaving
overview: Every goodbye is the start of something new.

title: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
original_title: मुखबिर: द स्टोरी ऑफ अ स्पाई - द मूवी
overview: After the Sino-Indian war, a highly trained Indian spy enters Pakistan on a mission to gather crucial intelligence and stop Pakistan from launching an attack against India. Will he succeed?

title: Ficciones sin Futuro
overview: On a frenetic night in the city of Pereira, a nomad sketches the everyday lives of various characters in his old notebook—figures whose paths cross in a universe he dubs "Ficciones sin Futuro" (Fictions Without a Future).

title: The Egotist
overview: Poor and tired, Amaro finds himself in the need of moving. Along the way he takes part in conversations that make him reflect on his changing position in society and on the anxieties of a young adult.

title: Queen Lizzy
overview: This raw and honest documentary portrays the life of Elizabeth Connors, a queer Traveller woman and spoken word poet, and her relationship with her family who have yet to come to terms with her sexuality.

title: The Roast of Caveh Zahedi
overview: A documentary record of the live event hosted by Video Store(age) on February 27 at Life World in New York City. The roasters included the following luminaries, trouble makers, and last-minute substitutions: Yung Chomsky, Lily Lady, Christian Lorentzen, Sharon Mashihi, Peter Rinaldi, Joe Swanberg, Onur Tukel, Pacho Velez, and Joshua Z. Weinstein.

title: IBS
overview: Andie experiences chronic digestive issues but hides it from her roommate. When she is prescribed a stool sample kit for the first time, she has to learn to take care of her health and deal with her own shit (literally and figuratively).

title: Urchins
overview: Follows a college freshman as they embark on a road trip with new friends, finding a renewed life purpose.

title: Schwarze Häuser
overview: After World War II, countless children throughout Germany were sent to health resorts in order to recover; instead they endured systemic abuse. Through survivors’ voices and her own family history, filmmaker Katrin Sikora uncovers this long silenced chapter and its echoes across generations.

title: Трасса «Море — море»
overview: A red convertible is speeding from St. Petersburg to Sochi, driven by the brazen photographer Tyoma. With him are his ex-wife, Sasha, and her new fiancé. Tyoma will do anything to prevent Sasha's new wedding. And the fatal hitchhiker Kira, rescued by the guys, will help him. Tyoma has only one way across the country to change and win back the love of his life-if his brakes don't fail.

title: The Bitches
overview: On a journey through heartbreak, in search of transformation. The film is built through friendship: each person helps in their own way, searches for the story, translates the words into their own language, sings Emily Dickinson, joyfully mends the dress of sorrow.

title: The B-side of the Landscape
overview: Every day, an aging filmmaker whose eyesight is deteriorating spends long hours in a retail park. He waits for his wife, who teaches drawing. A portrait in and of a non-place, shot on 16mm between the supermarket and the carwash, meditations and reveries.

title: Crossings : Kaleh Ziyarat
overview: Between the Caspian Sea and the Strait of Hormuz, through the reanimation of archives and documentary observation, a frenetic plunge into the parallel economies of a region shaped by imperial ambitions and survival instincts.

title: Only the Serpent Knows
overview: Two brothers reunite in their childhood home to speak about the incest one of them suffered there as a child. Over the course of a single day, their conversation intertwines the most difficult questions with the boldest theories, delving deep into our religious and mythological history.

title: Macha
overview: Dismissed after surgery for endometriosis and left without answers,Ana draws on the strength of Macha to reclaim her voice and confront the system ignoring her pain, while her father grapples with the helplessness of loving someone he cannot heal.

title: Mother, You Have Not Died Yet. But You Will. And When You Do, You Will Finally Be Alive Again.
original_title: Mother, You Have Not Died Yet. But You Will. And When You Do, You Will Finally Be Alive Again.
overview: In the Indian township of Durban, where post-apartheid violence still simmers, Lishana cares for her dying mother. Through her photographic practice, she reflects on life and death, past and present, navigating between the tangible and the mystical.

title: Hungry
overview: A high school wrestling coach must overcome addictive behavior in ordere to lead his team to a championship.

title: Beautiful Faces
overview: An old man has turned his solitary journey and homosexual sentimental education into a narrative. From his encounter with the filmmaker emerges a luminous portrait and an unflinching confession.

title: The Ink-Stained Hand and the Missing Thumb
original_title: The Ink-Stained Hand and the Missing Thumb
overview: If the world had an edge, it might look something like the remote corner of northern India where Santosh and Rajji live, collecting highway tolls in dilapidated booths. Work and endless waiting are blurred together. Bound by the power of love, but also by the need to constantly move around in search of work, they dream of the happiness that awaits them in a new place… until one day, a sudden tragedy turns their lives upside down.

title: Against Nature
overview: After many years away, Jonás returns to the countryside to start work as a stonemason. In a place marked by the harshness of life, he opens himself up to something intangible – a force that permeates the landscape, bodies and time itself. An evocatively told story of a silent man whose enigmatic nature stems from the dark side of humanity and from his contact with the sacred, the film moves along the boundary between the physical and the spiritual.

title: Break Free
overview: A gruff yakuza becomes a TikTok sensation thanks to a ridiculous intimidation dance.

title: Simulacra
overview: Nula is a student who has feelings for her old friend, Joel. One day she is caught in a recurring incident while she is with Joel. When Nula finds out that Joel is ready to express his feelings to his crush, that's where the incident continues to repeat itself and stops when Nula feelings that she has been keeping hidden, she expresses to Joel.

title: Uma Princesa
overview: Ten years in the life of Helena Verkoff, according to some of her biographers.

title: Doppelgänger
overview: Two people with the same face live completely different lives. When a horrible incident happens, one of the two finds herself stepping into shoes that aren't hers.

title: Crak Hack
overview: In a near-future ruled by VR intimacy, a lonely man's attempt to save his relationship backfires when hackers take control of his device, dragging him into absurd and terrifying chaos.

title: Election Day
overview: On the election night that will decide her political fate, MP Renata Innocenti sees her career teetering on the brink of ruin when her partner becomes the center of a massive media scandal. Amidst family tensions and political chaos, Renata must fight to save everything she has built.

title: Дети наши
overview: Every year, approximately 48,000 children end up in orphanages. Some find families, others remain in the orphanage until they reach adulthood, and only then set out on their own. But how can you become independent in the adult world without an adult? How do you manage your daily life if you don't know one? How do you find work and save money? And what about finding friends and love? Psychologists, foundation leaders, and the children themselves will discuss the subtle difficulties, stereotypes, and adaptation outside of orphanages. This film is an inside look at the problem of orphanhood in Russia—the perspective of people who are tackling it right now.

title: Chicken Soup
overview: Lili, a young French woman, lives in New York between odd jobs and coffees with friends while overstaying her visa. A chance encounter with two police officers tips her — and the film itself — into another dimension.

title: Home Stories
overview: As a contestant in a singing casting show, Lea is asked by the TV team who she is and what makes her special. She doesn't know and begins to slip into different roles in her search for what makes her special, developing an unexpected fascination for her aunt Kati. Kati's return home as head architect for the renovation of the Residenzschloss after many years abroad reunites the family in one place. This reunion raises the hopes of grandparents Friedrich and Christel that they can join forces to give their pension, which has few visitors, a new lease of life.

title: Shush, Now
overview: A seven year old girl discovers her mum is having an affair.

title: Neon Banana
overview: A seemingly innocent online interaction quickly turns precarious.

title: Unsaid
overview: After missing the chance to express his feelings, a young aspiring writer begins crafting the story he wishes he had lived. As fiction, UNSAID explores love, regret, and the quiet weight of words left unspoken.

title: The Wage of Sin
overview: A group of teenagers goes to hang out in an old house. But once they start drinking alcohol, an unknown figure begins to punish them for their sins.

title: Varav (The Visit)
overview: An unusual day in the life of a detached middle-aged couple, Padmanabhan and Sudha, begins when Sudha asks Padmanabhan to climb up to the terrace to pluck some mangoes for her. This seemingly ordinary incident rekindles their relationship by unveiling a long-buried yet lingering past.

title: Lone Rocks
overview: "Lone Rocks" explores the lesser-known outdoor bouldering possibilities across the Baltic States (Latvia, Estonia, and Lithuania). While indoor climbing gyms have seen explosive popularity in the region, the massive glacial erratic boulders scattered across the natural Baltic landscapes have remained mostly solitary and undocumented. The film interviews local pioneers—including looking back at the 2013/2014 footage of the Lithuanian "The Big Ones" project—and documents attempts to establish lines on unique formations like Latvia’s tallest boulder (Capsadis/Džūkste) and Estonia's giant coastal erratics.

title: Órtro ou Outro
overview: A young woman who lives in isolation clings to a quiet routine as a means of survival, until the instability that holds her back comes to the surface, and she loses the control that keeps her ‘present’.

title: Mama
overview: After many years working far from home, Mila is forced to temporarily leave her seaside mansion—and her secret romance—to return to her family in a remote Polish village. But the long-awaited reunion is far from what she imagined.  As tensions surface, Mila struggles to repair what was lost, confronting the cost of her choices and the woman she has become.

title: Pemikat Jiwa
overview: Jay uses a forbidden love potion to make Wulan love him. However, the ritual instead binds Wulan's soul to a supernatural force that threatens her life, forcing Jay to face the horrific consequences of his actions.

title: Untitled
overview: Short for Portuguese television channel Canal180's "Jogo Cruzado" series.

title: Somewhere Between Sleep
overview: Anke is about to leave her small German town in the Black Forest region, while Lisa finds it hard to feel at home there. They meet by chance on a cold, grey autumn day, and wander the streets together. Cracks in the thin membrane between reality and dream transform their stroll into a journey to new places.

title: Foufo
overview: The encounter of Madurese residents with small aliens that triggers hilarious chaos and unexpected adventures.

title: Faraway Home
overview: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

title: Narcisa's Will
overview: Haunted by memories of her recently deceased mother, former star Narcisa, Ana decides to sell the childhood mansion she inherited and share the proceeds with her brother, Diego. However, the grim cleansing process reveals a legacy quite different from what she imagined.

title: I, Nobody
overview: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

title: Infiltrate
overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: Korean Haunted Hospital
overview: A group of Indonesians: Juna, Adit, Bara, Arum, Yuri, and Tyas set out to live-stream a test of courage at the so-called most haunted hospital in South Korea, Yong-Won Hospital. Rumor has it that the hospital was once a front for a cult whose members chose to die following their leader. Now, the hospital is in a state of disrepair and no one dares to enter. This motivates Juna and his friends to become the first people to live-stream there.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
original_title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
overview: Small-town Kansas hairdresser Gail Daughtry's fiancé uses his 'celebrity sex pass' on Jennifer Aniston, prompting Gail to travel to LA with her friend Otto to find her own pass, Jon Hamm, to even the score.

title: Red Thunder VS The Intrusive Thoughts
original_title: Red Thunder VS The Intrusive Thoughts
overview: A supervillain's plot to take over the world using a helmet that can read minds runs awry after an encounter with a man with some anxious thoughts and a secret identity.

title: Giorgio Moroder & Donna Summer : I Feel Love
original_title: Giorgio Moroder & Donna Summer : I Feel Love
overview: A look back at the meeting in Munich in 1977 between composer and producer Giorgio Moroder and singer Donna Summer, which was to result, amongst other global hits, in the extraordinary “I Feel Love”.

title: Street of Dreams
overview: After her life is disrupted, Calle is seen holding on to soccer as a source of purpose and possibility. As she navigates uncertainty and self-doubt, she is guided by Sir David Beckham who appears as a personification of her inner voice, a guardian only she can see. He’s a powerful symbol of belief and opportunity, standing with her and showing up when it matters.

title: Dots Dots Dots
overview: Mapping and spotting the complicit machinery of Germany. A graphical approach to make transparent the entangled networks between factories, supply chains, politicians, and military, in enabling the genocide of Palestinian people.

title: Macht der Mandate – Ost-Stimmen im Bundestag
original_title: Macht der Mandate – Ost-Stimmen im Bundestag

title: Bigfoot Lover
overview: A heartbroken and lonely Cute is struggling to escape self-destructive patterns in her love life when she meets Bigfoot.

title: Ora pro nobis, òs de mos òssos
original_title: Ora pro nobis, òs de mos òssos

title: Black Treasures of Melancholy
overview: Traveler gets locked inside an empty fortress

title: Barçawash

title: Chants fantômes

title: If Everyone Goes Away
overview: For forty years, the filmmaker’s mother devoted herself to others, first as a primary school teacher and later as the disability coordinator within her school. Her decision to leave the public sector becomes the occasion for a generous portrait that reveals a system in crisis.

title: A Requiem in Bishkek
overview: An Indian refugee living in the capital of Kyrgyzstan, witness to the political instability surrounding him, drifts into a melancholic and elegiac meditation on his condition as a foreigner. Film stock is his last refuge.

title: Nothing to Lose

title: Hospital Británico

title: As the Spring Arrives, Water Recalls the Nomads
overview: A heterogeneous group of shepherds travels through the Çukurova valley in Turkey, following in the footsteps of their nomadic ancestors. Between archives and imaginary correspondence, the film becomes an echo of the memory and disappearance of pastoral ecosystems.

title: Pure Reason

title: Cat's Blood (Proof of Concept)

title: How to Get Filthy Rich with Gary Stevenson
original_title: How to Get Filthy Rich with Gary Stevenson
overview: In this provocative state-of-the-nation film, Stevenson travels across the country meeting those most affected by the widening wealth gap, alongside multi-millionaires and billionaires who sit at the other end of the economic spectrum.  Having made millions during his career in finance, Stevenson now campaigns against the expanding divide between rich and poor, and examines what he believes is driving inequality in Britain today.  The documentary sees him engage with economists, financiers, public sector workers and individuals from across society, going head-to-head with critics of his views while also hearing from those who support his proposed solutions.  At the heart of the film is Stevenson’s belief that meaningful change requires a wealth tax, with the super-rich contributing more to address what he sees as a broken system.

title: The Clearing
overview: Sumatra, early twentieth century. The exploitation of rubber by Dutch colonisers leads to the sexual enslavement of female workers. Archival and contemporary images intertwine in a documentary fabulation that plunges into the depth of a long-erased history.

title: Братья

This is a story about growing up, the fragility of family ties, and the search for intimacy in a world that isn't always willing to accept those who are different.

title: The Mastodon in the Room

overview: A photographer’s journey between past and present, as she develops a project on the concentration camps of the Spanish dictatorship, gradually reveals a cartography of the memory of the defeated.

title: Ontari E-Kaki

title: Permanent Trespass

title: The Crowd

title: The Construction Site

title: Get to Work

title: Love Would Have Sufficed, Even for Nietzsche

title: To Become Ghosts

title: American England

He would like to help everyone, but as he slowly falls into a spiral of conflicts and mounting difficulties, he finds that he, too, is in need of help. title: Unexposed

Shielded by his wealth, influence, and social standing, Gunawan escaped legal consequences. In the end, the mysterious killer becomes the one who delivers the justice that the law failed to provide.

title: Tamsyn Kelly: Hot Titty Bungalow

From awkward encounters with exes to bizarre local experiences and questionable attempts at self-discovery, every story is packed with relatable chaos and unexpected punchlines.  Warm, quirky, and brutally honest, this set showcases Tamsyn Kelly’s unique comedic voice as she turns life’s uncertainties into laugh-out-loud comedy.

Ivan Ostrochovský’s perspective is rare, dynamic and also meditative, while Luther himself co-authored the project during the last few months of his life. Works such as Juraj Jakubisko’s Birds, Orphans and Fools, Volker Schlöndorff’s The Tin Drum and Andrzej Wajda’s Danton, in the persuasive words of their creators, wouldn't have the same timeless energy today if it weren't for Luther's visionary endeavours.

title: The Friend's House is Here

The situation of both women becomes more complicated, but their friendship is strong in the face of political oppression. The Friend’s House is Here is a rewarding cinematic experience, conveying a sense of freedom and hope, even though it originated under the exact opposite conditions. Just a few days after the June War in Iran, the crew, headed by directing duo Hossein Keshavarz and Maryam Ataei, took to the streets of Tehran to make a film about a generation that no longer wants to live according to imposed rules and is striving to achieve one of the fundamental human rights, the right to freedom of artistic expression.

Glen describes in detail the mindset of the UK in the early 70's and divulges a mine of information; Steve's thievery, Wally Nightingale, the search for a singer, the exploding punk scene and a bleak backdrop providing a contrast to the excitement and energy of McLaren's shop. title: YMCA - The Invention of the Village People
original_title: YMCA - Die Erfindung der Village People
overview: In the mid-1970s, disco emerged in the underground clubs of New York. Seduced by this phenomenon about to conquer the world, French producers Henri Belolo and Jacques Morali created the Village People from scratch, a group inspired by iconic figures of American popular culture. Success was meteoric with hits like Macho Man, In the Navy, Go West, and above all Y.M.C.A., which sold millions of copies and became one of the biggest hits in pop history. Behind these festive choruses, however, lies a complex story: that of a group alternately celebrated as an icon of gay liberation or viewed as a pure marketing product. Through the accounts of former group members and disco specialists, Sascha Schmidt's documentary traces the rise of the Village People, from their beginnings in underground clubs to their global consecration.

title: Whirlwind
overview: On the outskirts of town, in a small house beneath a hill, Bela lives in the quiet rhythm of her daily household routines. After hanging laundry, she is approached by Nada, a Roma girl, who tells her fortune from the coffee grounds. Guided by this small sign, Bela spends the rest of the day awaiting her son. When she learns that he will not come, silence settles back into the house. In that silence, Bela turns inward, where she begins to feel the presence of her late husband return.

title: The Crucian
overview: Born never to cry, Fish seeks his missing mother through the underworld. He believes her ghost is imprisoned within a deity puppet — yet, it conceals neither his mother nor an informant, but a survivor. Through the puppet’s mouth, the seaside street’s buried past unfolds.

title: Marcas de um Império
overview: At the height of the rubber boom, the British presence transformed the Amazon. Ports, railways, mansions, and river transport connected Manaus and Belém to the world. Behind this legacy, however, lay a profound human cost. Revisiting this period, the documentary reveals how modernization was sustained through the exploitation and erasure of Indigenous peoples and Black communities, questioning the enduring marks left by this past.

title: Grandes maricas y bolleras de la historia
original_title: Grandes maricas y bolleras de la historia
overview: Rodrigo Cuevas serves as a guide in this museum of history's great gay and lesbian figures. Over the course of 90 minutes, the program approaches 16 historical figures from a queer perspective. Guests such as Bob Pop, Laura del Val, Valeria Vegas, Ángel Ruiz, María Peláe, and Ramón Martínez contribute their knowledge and viewpoints to highlight the sexual diversity—which history has hidden—of figures as diverse as Queen Christina of Sweden, Marlene Dietrich, Miguel de Molina, Chavela Vargas, Hans Christian Andersen, Jacinto Benavente, Leonardo Da Vinci, and Lili Elbe. Irony, humor, and an accessible, modern language are the defining features of an educational and original historical narrative. It is based on solid documentation and uses AI-generated images to recreate passages from the lives of these historical figures.

title: Courtney Barnett: Creature of Habit - Live At Levon Helm Studios
original_title: Courtney Barnett: Creature of Habit - Live At Levon Helm Studios

title: The Second Child

As the two collide in a quest to discover the past and present reality, they come across Jae-in, an exact look-alike of the deceased sister.

title: François.e

title: Flies

Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

title: Playground
overview: A lonely teenage girl joins a school for promising killers and trains hard to become an professional assassin as she uncovers the mysteries of her parents' death.

title: Miss Mermaid

Despite her burning need for freedom, this cleaning lady finds herself stuck back at her parents' house.  That is, until the day she crosses paths with Anemone, a professional mermaid passing through the region. She decides to take the plunge and dive into the world of mermaiding.

title: Veranda

As details surrounding her husband's death begin to surface, she is drawn into an increasingly complex web of secrets and suspicion.

title: Nightborn

Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she's forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

title: Smile Back

title: The Crown Prince & The President

It had been seven years since a Saudi hit squad murdered journalist Jamal Khashoggi, in an operation U.S. intelligence assessed MBS had approved.Now, Trump hailed MBS as a friend. The two men announced from the Oval Office that Saudi Arabia planned to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in the U.S.FRONTLINE's new documentary "The Crown Prince & the President" draws on over 100 interviews to investigate what forces bind the two men and their countries together, and what each stands to gain.

Orevwa is a heartfelt, romantic dramedy about saying goodbye to who we were and daring to embrace who we’re becoming
