With nowhere else to go, he escapes the chaos below by climbing to the rooftops that overlook the city he has always called home. As he journeys across London's hidden skyline, each rooftop offers a new perspective, not just of the capital, but of himself. Blending urban exploration with a deeply personal coming-of-age story, the film explores resilience, freedom, and the search for belonging through the eyes of someone determined to rise above his circumstances.

title: Waiting Exercise

title: Oplan Tokhang: Katarungan at Pananagutan
overview: This gripping investigative documentary exposes the human cost of the Philippine "War on Drugs" through the tragic story of Myca Ulpina, a three-year-old girl killed in June 2019, who remains the campaign's youngest victim. The narrative is anchored by her mother, Nanay Lydjay, who bravely recounts the harrowing events of that fateful day. Through her raw and emotional testimony, she fiercely debunked the official police narrative, clearing her husband and their family of the allegations used to justify the bloody raid.

title: AFTER HOURS

What begins as an ordinary evening of shared silences, stolen glances and unfinished conversations slowly becomes a turning point, forcing them to confront the feelings they've both hidden for far too long. As dawn approaches and life threatens to pull them in opposite directions, they must decide whether some connections are meant to remain beautiful memories or whether love is worth the risk of changing everything.

original_title: Morristown: A Tale As Old As Time

Blending heartfelt storytelling with the landscapes and landmarks of Lamoille County, the documentary offers an intimate portrait of a rural Vermont community and the people who continue to define its character and legacy.

title: La conexión Intergaláctica

Beneath the Ashes shares the voices of those who lived it: homeowners who lost everything, renters searching for stability, business owners rebuilding from scratch, and community leaders fighting to preserve what took generations to create. Through intimate conversations and powerful storytelling, the film reveals both the pain of loss and an inspiring vision for what comes next.

overview: A collision of bizarre characters, senseless situations and countless styles (like eight) that is bound to leave you speechless. Join our lucky audience, giving praises in the likes of "I don't get it.", "This should win the grand prize!" and "Huh?".

title: Matryoshka
overview: Daniel struggles to write his new script about Lily, a young photographer and escort. Confused and lost, he sets out to explore her world in a narrative that walks the line between fiction and documentary.

title: RokuGatsu
overview: 晴れた日を待ち望む中で、  若い女性は雨の多い春の美しさに気づく。  While longing for a sunny day, a woman learns to appreciate the beauty of a rainy spring.

title: The Perfect Family
overview: The Perfect Family follows 12-year-old Margot as she navigates life in a damaged household. Her parents, Mia and Jack, mask their failing marriage with moments of forced normalcy, but Margot is constantly affected by the arguments and resentment between her parents.

title: Suitcased
overview: When a struggling student discovers his late father left him a locked pendrive containing a massive fortune in Bitcoin, he and his friends must crack a highly secure password with only one attempt remaining—unknowingly holding the key to a long-buried family secret.

title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'Stard
overview: From early sketches to standout performances, Mayall's fearless comedy bursts with energy and intent, capturing a pivotal moment in British comedy while delivering pure entertainment.

title: last room
overview: After a car accident, Elad wakes up in a mysterious hotel. While searching for a way out, he is exposed to memories from his past and is forced to confront them.

title: Alaska
overview: Seraphim journeys to Alaska, the most beautiful place in this child's mind's eye.

title: FarEye
overview: Fleeing the chaos of home, a young Jamaican boy finds refuge within a community guided by music, spirit and faith, awakening something deep within that will change the course of his life forever.

title: HAMSTAGEDDON
overview: A normal day soon turns to hell...

title: Rodrigo Lira
overview: A collective portrait in which friends and acquaintances explore the complexities of Rodrigo Lira, a pivotal poet on the national scene of the 1980s. The short film exposes diverse literary and personal facets of Lira, while simultaneously fragmenting, reiterating, and juxtaposing the speeches of the group of interviewees, making it in itself a work of audiovisual experimentation. Originally filmed months after Lira's suicide, this film was recuperated and preserved by Universidad de Chile's Film Archive, who were able to release it in 2026.

title: When I Was Older
overview: Haunted by a drawing she made as a child, a young mother is pulled back toward the sea — and the self she left behind.

title: The Journey
overview: Or, a young transgender woman in her early years, goes out with her two closest friends for the first time in female clothing to test her limits. The journey is disrupted by a car breakdown, past resentments towards her friends, and traumatic encounters on the public transportation they are forced to take.

title: I Love Charlène
overview: It is the day of the Miss Eternal Grace pageant—the beauty contest popularized by the famous Charlène. Cléo, the heavy favorite, is competing under her mother's tyrannical supervision. But as the evening unfolds and the pressure mounts, something cracks within her, allowing a new emotion to surface.

title: Parce Que Les Roses Ont Des Épines
original_title: Parce Que Les Roses Ont Des Épines
overview: While spending the afternoon with his grandmother, Solange, Noah receives a call from his boyfriend, Théo. Théo brings up their breakup, accusing Noah of not fully embracing his sexuality. Noah decides to go see him in an attempt to save their relationship. Solange decides to tag along, hoping to finally meet the "girlfriend" Noah rarely talks about.

title: Abata
overview: In 1955, fascinated by the ingenious pigeon hunting with wooden paddles and nets, Orson Welles directed the documentary The Land of the Basques. Today, from a mountain hut on the border between Navarre and France, Gerardo Damboriena, a veteran pigeon hunter, reveals to us in basque the secrets of this more than 700-year-old tradition, now on the verge of extinction.

title: White Italian Truffles in Brine
overview: When her old friend Leslie comes to Los Angeles on a work trip, Camille attempts to reconnect with her by making her a home-cooked meal.

title: Rik Mayall's Sketches: Rare And Unseen
original_title: Rik Mayall's Sketches: Rare And Unseen
overview: A selection of rarely seen comic moments from the actor and comedian, who rose to fame as Kevin Turvey and as Rick in The Young Ones, a show he helped create. Rik Mayall later achieved more widespread fame in Bottom, and The New Statesman.

title: Bukan Paru-Paru Basah, Bro!
overview: When his chronic cough escalates to coughing up blood, a student in denial must confront both his failing health and the severe social stigma of Tuberculosis.

title: Voices
overview: Three mothers share harrowing experiences of coercive control, exposing warning signs, abusers' tactics, and harsh reality that leaving didn't end the abuse.

title: Tom Cashman: The Formula for Happiness
original_title: Tom Cashman: The Formula for Happiness
overview: Tom Cashman's third stand up special, which may or may not include the formula for happiness. Toured in 2025 as '2 Truths, 1 Lie and 17 Slight Exaggerations' and filmed at the Brisbane Powerhouse on 31 October 2025.

title: Unknown Chase
overview: Orit, a young girl from Arad in the 90s, struggles with her mother’s death in the Gulf War. Through magical dreams of blue jellyfish and a mysterious seahorse, she finds her father’s protection and releases her grief.

title: After-School Exorcism Club: Girls' Night
overview: At Palja Girls' High School, where ominous energy seems to be part of the curriculum, strange incidents unfold one after another. The principal secretly recruits five girls whose fates are perfectly aligned, tasking them with a mission to exorcise ghosts haunting the school. After 30 years, the After-School Exorcism Club of Palja Girls' High returns!

title: Headline
overview: One headline, countless questions, and the fight for a single truth. What lies hidden behind the overnight changed story?

title: Are You Human?
overview: On a mysterious game show a young woman is forced to prove herself more human than her competitor.

title: Combined Funerals
original_title: ពិធីបូជាសពរួម
overview: Khmer horror film.

title: Enter
overview: Set against the backdrop of school memories and first love, ENTER explores the emotions we carry long after moments have passed. Through silence, longing and nostalgia, a young boy confronts the feelings he never expressed and discovers the courage to begin.

title: Hippie Hollow
overview: Construction worker Uriel’s private escape to a nude beach takes an unexpected turn when he encounters his son Jorge there with his boyfriend.

title: Starflyer
overview: Niki and Aurora meet on a winter night at Allou Fun Park, the biggest theme park in Athens. Soon they will discover that they come from the same world.

title: Spring is here.
overview: An experimental short film that contrasts the beauty and intrinsic optimism of the coming of Spring with the grimy digital textures of lo-fi video. Backed by an atmospheric soundscape of distant birdsong, distorted static, and otherworldly sounds, the work explores evocative and contemplative themes of reminiscence, nostalgia and environmentalism.

title: Soldier's Bones
overview: In 1971 reporter Alec Shimkin discovers a secret US-led military campaign: Operation Speedy Express. This discovery may reveal war crimes on an immense scale. Yet nobody knows about Alec’s scoop, who went missing-in-action in Vietnam himself. In Alec’s footsteps, Soldier’s Bones searches for Speedy’s deadly echo in the Mekong Delta.

title: Landslide
overview: Amidst the riots in Poso, Kai and his older brother, Ringgo, who has Down Syndrome, are separated from their mother, Emmy. While searching for their mother, they encounter a police officer named Idham, who is on duty handling the riots. Idham helps search for Emmy, while taking Kai and Ringgo along on his journey through dangerous situations. An emotional bond like family begins to emerge between Idham, Kai, and Ringgo.

title: Ananthan Kaadu
overview: This is a tale, which almost became a true story. It unfolds in the late Eighties and early Nineties, when the country was going through a dark phase both politically and socially a time when turmoil was writ all over the political scape of the nation.

title: If You had Stayed
overview: After a tragic choice leads him to the brink, a disillusioned artist named Michael awakens on a mysterious beach. a liminal space where lost souls come to confront their pasts. Guided by Bob, a charismatic yet enigmatic caretaker, Michael embarks on a surreal journey through the pivotal moments of his life: love, heartbreak, and devastating loss. As he confronts hidden truths and unspoken regrets, Michael is faced with one profound question: Was it worth it, and what would life be like if he had stayed?

title: Unboxing
overview: Popular blogger Vlad tries to attract attention to his concert in an original way - he puts himself up for auction. The lot immediately goes to the son of a rich businessman. Now Vlad is obliged to entertain Borya for a whole week. All attempts to break the contract run into huge fines, and then Vlad decides to really piss off Borya and make a video blog out of his life. In response, Borya arranges more and more new challenges for him.

title: Understand?
overview: After finding himself in debt, Baxter has been told that if he manages to get a confession for a crime out of someone his debt will be forgiven, however he's shocked to find the person he needs to gain the confession from is his old friend

title: Phylum
overview: A wordless 16mm experimental short film exploring the human relationship to nature, labor, and the evolution of machinery.

title: The Life and Lens of Colin H. Law
original_title: The Life and Lens of Colin H. Law
overview: Colin Law just wants to be a great artist, so what if his photos aren't any good? Armed with theory, delusion, two eyeballs, and a camera, Colin sets out to prove that "good art" is all about perspective.

title: Meet Me at the Club: The Castro Country Club Story
original_title: Meet Me at the Club: The Castro Country Club Story
overview: On April 1, 1983 at the frightening start of the AIDS epidemic, gay businessman and restaurateur Steve Harris opened the doors to the Castro Country Club as a refuge where folks could gather and find community outside of the bars and clubs in the Castro. For 40 years, the CCC has saved thousands of lives from the grips of addiction and alcoholism from its humble perch on 18th Street, one block from Castro Street. Meet Me at the Club captures the history of early trans experiences, the role that the AIDS epidemic played in addiction and alcoholism, and the miraculous recoveries from hopeless states of mind and body in San Francisco. When 295 people die every day from overdoses, the story of how this beautiful community came together to survive and thrive, there's no more important time than now to tell this story.

title: The Blistering Blundering West
overview: A bumbling, lovestruck cowboy stumbles through the western frontier, overcoming a series of comical obstacles in the hopes of making it on time for a date with the potential love of his life.

title: Nikola, Nikola
overview: In the dead of night, a Macedonian teenager sneaks out to meet a 40-year-old man he’s been messaging online. When their car gets stuck in the remote woods, isolation strips away fantasy, forcing him to reckon with power, desire, and the possibility of real danger.

title: TAEMONG
overview: During a pregnancy photoshoot, a woman sells her taemong - a baby conception dream - which contains a dark desire triggered by her past.

title: Corn
overview: After getting a promotion, Dennis gets invited to his boss's house for dinner, which turns into a living nightmare when Dennis eats corn the "wrong" way.

title: Le jour porte conseil
overview: Every night, a young man forgets the woman he loves. Every morning, she owes him relearning their story. For one other day, they experience love as intense as ephemeral, until even written memories start to disappear, only remains then, a love that continues to exist, despite forgetness.

title: Because of you Ka Kui
overview: A documentary feature celebrating the music, life, and artistic pursuit of Canto rock music legend Wong Ka Kui, whose voice and vision defined the sound of Beyond- the most influential Canto rock band of all time. Featuring rare concert footage, never-before-seen archives of Ka Kui's early years, and unreleased work, this documentary offers an intimate portrait of Wong Ka Kui- not through nostalgia, not as a distant legend, but as he truly was. At its heart is the precious legacy of his character and convictions—one that continues to transcend generations, his music still lifting spirits and inspiring hope today.

title: Tanah Sengketa
overview: Yuni, a research student, opens a free learning class for children in Kampung Degong. Raka, a local youth who supports her, provides some needed books for the children. Terror begins to haunt Yuni. Despite warnings, Yuni refuses to give up and seeks to uncover the truth behind the strangeness.

title: Million Dollar Man
overview: A timid man does something by himself for once.

title: Saving Spoonie
overview: Spoonie, the spoon-billed sandpiper, would have long since gone extinct without Dr. Christoph Zöckler and a tight-knit group of international ornithologists. As if that weren’t bad enough, the migration route of this sparrow-sized wading bird—with its peculiar spoon-shaped bill—runs from Russia through North Korea and China all the way to Myanmar, passing through several of the world’s crisis regions of the past decade. The work of the task force is therefore also a political challenge. It requires diplomatic sensitivity in coordinating with the countries along the flyway. In the tragicomic story of Spoonie’s fate, the struggle for threatened biodiversity in an increasingly fragile world is reflected.

title: Good Vibes Only
overview: A woman desperately wants to cry following a painful breakup. But her AI companion won't let her.

title: Rescue
overview: As the full-scale war in Ukraine forces millions to flee, rescuers move in the opposite direction - toward destroyed villages, active shelling, and mined roads - to save animals left behind when humans are forced to escape.

title: Pauline
overview: In a bar, Pauline writes to a man she does not know. Between desire, art, and projection, reality eventually begins to crack the story she has invented for herself.

title: Forgetting Cacá
overview: After ruining yet another friendship, Alina finds herself tormented by the fear of eternal loneliness and decides to try to reconnect with Cacá, the only girl she never fought with.

title: The King of Black Goo
overview: A bitter, lonely man undergoes a personality-altering medical procedure in the hope that it will make him worthy of love.

title: The Invite
overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: Brotherhood of the Court: Beginning
overview: An intimate sports documentary drama showcasing the historic rise of the Slovenian men's national volleyball team from 64th in the world rankings to a global powerhouse. Through archival footage and previously unseen behind-the-scenes and locker-room moments, the film reveals the genuine relationships, defeats, and unwavering bond of the boys who became brothers on and off the court.

title: Feed
overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

title: Rescued
overview: A homeless man finds the motivation to turn his life around after a stray dog saves his life and refuses to leave his side.

title: Avemmaria
overview: Felice lives in two dark rooms of a crumbling building with his father Raffaele, recently laid off, his mother Antonietta, too young and worn down by grief, his grandmother Filomena, always dressed in black and filled with resentment, and three brothers, with another on the way. In that world of poverty and violence, a boy like him can either be crushed or cling to his dreams. His imagination is his refuge, but in Pianura there's no room for fantasy - being poor and a dreamer is a fault. Yet his teacher, Giulia, recognizes his singing talent and tries to offer him new horizons. When Felice sees Neil Armstrong's footprint in his textbook, he realizes he too might leave Pianura and reach the moon.

title: Летом всякое бывает. Побег из Сколбора
original_title: Летом всякое бывает. Побег из Сколбора
overview: Eleven-year-old Zlata becomes overly engrossed in gaming during the holidays, ignoring her parents requests to clean up the dishes, review math homework, and walk the dog. Her father confiscates Zlata's gaming devices for the rest of the holidays. Zlata is deeply upset and, before going to bed, wishes, "To play forever, without any limits!" In the morning, Zlata's wish comes true, and she finds herself playing the game, but soon realizes that playing 24/7 isn't as exciting as she thought.

title: Meeting the Buddha
overview: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Truly Mine
overview: Leila, an 18-year-old girl who is on the brink of adulthood. As the pressure of her family's expectations grows, Leila has to choose between a life laid out for her or freedom, risking everything she loves for a life that's truly hers.

title: CHANGE
overview: Three people walk down the street.

title: Euro Dome Simulator
overview: While Virtual Reality promises a whole world, in fact it offers only a view within the strictly defined boundaries of a sphere. Is this also the case for the strictly defined boundaries of the European Union? When crossing the borders of the European Union, one is not allowed to film. This also applies to Google and their Street View cars, resulting in gaps in the available Street View coverage within the area of EU border control posts. The Euro dome is increasingly made more visible and intimidating from the outside: high fences with barbed wire stand tall along the border and armed border patrols pass by on a regular basis. While from inside the dome, one can only see a virtual glimpse of its borders. A faint reflection or a delayed feedback version.

title: Presagio
overview: A 16-year-old girl and her mother attempt to conceal the girl's biological maturity in a desperate plan to escape an oppressive community before she is forced to marry the elderly cult leader.

title: Movement
overview: Georgy travels illegally on freight trains across Ukraine with his friends, driven by a search for new pleasures, but this leads to unexpected consequences.

title: SEED 0
overview: In an era when physical space has been thoroughly explored, virtual spaces harken back to the romance of the colonial frontier  -Jules Skotnes-Brown, Video Games and the Global South

title: Det Forsvindende
overview: As an attempt to end the dynasty of the mask is made, figures from his past start to appear. Witness the final conclusion to the saga, where choices matter more than ever before. Will he keep running, or put an end to it once and for all.

title: When The Birds Return
overview: In a world consumed by chaos, a young girl left to fend for herself sets out in search of her mother with the help of a strange neighbor. But there are mysteries that only chaos can reveal.

title: Чужая версия меня
overview: A boy attempts to understand a girl through the memories of others. As different versions emerge, the truth becomes unclear. A story about perception, memory, and the impossibility of a single truth.

title: PATOLI
overview: A peculiar young man embarks on a colorful food trip across Cagayan with his equally eccentric best friend in search of comfort through familiar flavors, only to discover that what he truly misses is not the food itself, but the memories of home, struggle, and love attached to it.

title: Welcome to the Jungle
overview: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

title: Piccolo miracolo
overview: Davide Lancia, a wealthy forty-year-old with refined tastes and a weakness for all things beautiful, from women to art, owes his fortune to being the son of one of Rome's most powerful and unscrupulous builders. To spur him on, his father offers him the opportunity to finally prove himself a worthy heir to his empire: he must demolish a run-down building and build a luxury residence in its place. A deal Davide cannot refuse. However, a tenant still lives in the building who refuses to leave her apartment: Ursula, a blind, beautiful, determined, and feisty woman. His encounter with Ursula will upend Davide's plans and allow him to embrace a new way of living and seeing things.

title: Death by Roux
overview: A married couple throws a dinner party for their neighbors, with a special gumbo recipe on the menu.

title: Dreamboi
overview: A trans woman becomes entranced by the voice of an underground audio porn star. Torn between fantasy and reality, she drifts through the neon haze of Quezon City on a journey of desire, pain, and self-discovery.

title: Ingeborg Bachmann – Jemand, der einmal ich war
original_title: Ingeborg Bachmann – Jemand, der einmal ich war
overview: Sandra Hüller portrays Ingeborg Bachmann on an imaginary day in Rome. Regina Schilling’s hybrid film weaves together reenactments, archival footage, and Bachmann’s own writings into a portrait that offers a refreshing new perspective on the author and positions her writings as a reference point in current debates on gender relations and power.

title: Three Heroes. Daily Tales 3
original_title: Три богатыря. Ни дня без подвига 3

title: Black Box
overview: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

title: ForeFans
overview: A naive international student struggling to make ends meet decides to try webcam modeling to support herself financially. But within the lurid online world where every body is treated as a commodity, what will the ultimate price be?

title: Berlin Kills Me
overview: Jacky (30), who lives in Berlin, falls into a deep void after the death of her mother and losing her job. Unable to succeed in her attempt to commit suicide, she decides to hire a hitman. Unbeknownst to her, she meets Çello (33), the killer assigned to commit murder. Çello and Jacky fall in love with each other. The loving couple decides to go into hiding, but their happiness doesn’t last long. A major confrontation takes place at Madam Bora’s Pissoir Bar.

title: Azart Come Make Art
overview: The documentary tells the colourful and cheerful history of Amsterdam's narrator ship Azart, or The Ship of Fools, which sailed around the world for over 30 years bringing music and theatre. At the helm the creator of this sailing work of art: captain and actor August Dirks, who lived and worked on the Azart for over 30 years. Amsterdam's Azartplein is named after the ship.

title: A Matter of Life and Death
overview: Haya's convinced she's going to die before thirty, so she's living like it — loud, reckless, completely unfiltered, no brakes. Then one of her stunts goes wrong and lands her in the ER... right into Youssef. A heart surgeon. Calm, controlled, lives by a schedule. The human opposite of her in every way.  Naturally, she decides he's her destiny.  What follows is chaotic, funny, and a little bit ridiculous — neon nights, strange rituals, the kind of moments you can't plan for. Her countdown keeps ticking. His walls keep cracking. And somewhere in between, they both start remembering what it actually feels like to be alive.  A love story for anyone who's ever felt like too much.

title: The Djinn's Curse 2
overview: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

title: Novak
overview: An ageing Serbian neuroscientist lives a reclusive life in Athens, having been branded as a paranoid schizophrenic for his radical research on the effects of electromagnetic radiation on humans. But when, decades later, he is rediscovered by a group of young dreamers who are trying to change the world through his ideas, he decides to quit his medication and join them in their scientific commune, risking his sanity in pursuit of a higher goal.

title: Return to Your Dreams
overview: Waking up from a dream he can’t seem to forget, Faizan struggles to maintain the newly structured life he’s built for himself, dazed and lost in thought. And as more memories from his past continue to resurface, he soon learns that the nightmarish ones still refuse to let him go.

title: Death on the Brandywine
overview: U.S. Senator Daniel Riley is found dead at his grand estate. While the police quickly rule his death a suicide, his daughter Jackie refuses to believe it. Suspecting murder, she asks her life partner, forensic psychologist and professor Millie Park, to investigate the case in secret. As Jackie and Millie dig into the family's past, they uncover a web of dark political secrets, bitter sibling rivalries, and dangerous ambitions. Set against the high-stakes backdrop of a tight election, the couple faces growing danger as they get closer to the truth. They must untangle the lies of a powerful family to expose the real killer before it is too late.

title: Sugar Beach
overview: A grief-stricken valedictorian spirals into a consuming throuple in the wake of her twin brother's death, and must confront the past she's been outrunning before it swallows her whole.

title: Где ты?
overview: Maks and Anna's lives are destroyed by the theft of their only three-month-old child. Six years later, Anna finds the strength to start living again, and Maks does not give up and continues to search for his son.

title: The Great Massacre of Alimos
original_title: Η Μεγάλη Σφαγή των Β' ΚΑΠΗ Αλίμου
overview: The movie follows an LGBTQI+ film crew making a documentary about an explosion that killed 70 senior citizens at an elderly home. One of the three main suspects carried out a suicide mission, taking everyone else with them. But which one?

title: Jangan Buang Ibu
overview: Ristiana, a single mother, struggles to raise her three children after her husband left her with significant debt. Her decisions strain her relationship with her children. Despite the distance and longing, her three children remain devoted to their mother and strive to repair their relationship before it's too late.

original_title: Kung Fu – A Arte de Lutar Sem Lutar

overview: Danielle and Aviv are twins living between Israel and France. This year’s birthday visit is  different, as Danielle escapes her reality in Israel to cling to a past life and a possible  future.  Lacking a sense of identity and belonging, the twins come  to realize they are mirror images of one another.

As cases rise, the board realizes with horror that they’ve got to do what they swore they never would: make a choice that won’t please absolutely everybody.

title: Los peces no saben leer la hora
original_title: Los peces no saben leer la hora
overview: When she waited impatiently for him, he never showed up for their date. He can't tell time; he's a fish out of water.

overview: In a small French village under German occupation, Marceau and Gustave, two carefree and resourceful young friends, lead a mundane life. One day, a trip that promised to be ordinary gradually takes a dramatic turn...  Between camaraderie and rising tension, their journey will lead them to a decisive choice, where the innocence of youth brutally clashes with the harshness of war.

overview: While brushing his teeth, he finds a red dot. It seems to be leading him somewhere.

title: Alices
overview: Haunted by the image of the "ideal girl" that captivates the world, Alice Liddell embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Through travel, art and family bonds, she learns to reconcile with her identity, ultimately transforming a lifelong curse into a blessing.

title: CATÁBASE
overview: A girl spends the night working alone in an empty university building, when an unexpected call from a friend interrupts her routine and triggers a growing unease. The feeling of being watched turns the silent surroundings into something oppressive.

Royce is a young, successful director trying to come up with a new idea, putting unnecessary pressure on his shoulders to stay in the spotlight and not let His fans, agents, and studio execs down. He falls into his mind, getting lost, and wrestles with his conscience, but still has a hard time coming up with an idea. As his girlfriend is on the rise and taking the spotlight from him, as tonight is her huge movie premiere, he learns that his agent invited the studio execs to the premiere. At the last second, he gets a new idea, but is distracted and ultimately blows up their relationship.

title: Labios de fresa
overview: When introverted Max meets with his childhood friend Leo and discovers he's now Anita, a fun, sexy girl, Max discovers he's fighting against his emotions by realizing he feels for her more than he'd like to admit.

Through archival footage, recordings, photographs, and interviews filmed across Rome, Milan, Paris, and Berlin, the film explores the enduring impact of Balestrini’s artistic and political vision, from Gruppo 63 to the social movements of 1969 and 1977, and the way his work continuously challenged the boundaries between literature, art, and activism. title: Zara Larsson: Pinkpop Festival 2026

Standout performances of “Midnight Sun,” “Blue Moon,” “Pretty Ugly,” and “Stateside” showcase the heart of her latest chapter, blending euphoric pop, fearless self-expression, and emotional storytelling. Alongside beloved hits such as “Lush Life,” “Never Forget You,” and “Symphony,” this electrifying performance captures Zara Larsson at her most confident, ambitious, and unforgettable.

title: Alice

title: La maldición del sauce

overview: A piano tuner wanders through the streets of New York after dark, seeking artistic inspiration. Sketchbook in hand, he observes the city’s lovers, mourners, and giant ants from afar. title: Book U Can Ask ???s
overview: Mikey likes to get high. Especially before bed. But you know what ruins a good high? A ghost with bloody teeth standing in Mikey's kitchen just breaking her ikea dishes. So Mikey goes to check it out and ask the ghost wtf his problem is. It's simple, he was killed in this house 150 years ago to the day and he's here to haunt the descendants of the man who murdered him. Fair enough, says Mikey. But a corporation actually bought the building back in the '80s so the descendants are long gone. The ghost is sad. But Mikey can still help. A targeted internet search will do the trick. And in the process, she'll teach the ghost about modern times while she helps him find the right jerk to haunt.

title: Yene Semay
overview: A Film By Kirubel Seyoum

title: Salt
overview: “What do we say anymore to conjure the salt of our earth?”  400 meters under the surface in coastal Antrim, machinery and poetry echo out from the depths of Ireland's only active salt mine. Featuring and inspired by Seamus Heaney’s “The Singers House”, this short documentary takes a poetic view of the salt mine as both an artificial space and a natural environment, finding a sense of humanity in its alien sounds and structures.

title: Musiques en fête des Chorégies d'Orange
original_title: Musiques en fête des Chorégies d'Orange

title: Cheer Dad
overview: When a young girl and her family move to a new town, she yearns for a sense of belonging. She finds it by joining her school's cheerleading squad. Inspired by her new found love and dedication to the sport, her adoptive father comes out for support and is soon recruited as the assistant coach. As the father and daughter grow together, they'll see if they have what it takes to win the championship.

title: Red Rabbit Lodge
overview: In an attempt to put her traumatic past behind her Abigail Mason moves to Red Rabbit Lodge, a sanctuary for foreign students. Unbeknownst to her, he house has a history of blood, mayhem and a sadistic killer residing within the walls.

title: Stuck
overview: Kamila has an epiphany about time spent at a place that makes her feel stuck.

title: Punk State

overview: Nora's life, marked by a regimen of self-improvement and recovery from codependency, is interrupted when Callie appears on her doorstep, suitcase in tow, emanating vulnerability and chaos.

title: LGBT - A Legal Battle
overview: The movie follows the intense legal battle of a transgender woman fighting for justice and dignity after surviving a horrific crime. It highlights her struggle against societal prejudice and systemic bias.

title: Hanuman Ansh
overview: After the death of his mother, a young boy leaves his home in grief, believing that only by finding God can he meet her again. His search takes him across temples, forests, rivers and villages, where he lives in silence, discipline and devotion, slowly shedding all attachments. Through years of wandering and inner struggle, he discovers that God is not found in escape from the world, but in serving it. As his compassion grows, so do stories of quiet miracles, healing, and grace. Renouncing identity and ownership, the boy transforms into Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba, dedicating his life to feeding the hungry, loving all without distinction, and blessing humanity through humility, service and silent faith.

title: RUN AWAY AND HIDE
overview: The New Zealand Government has issued a warning to stay indoors and avoid anyone unfamiliar.

title: La Loca de los Sueños | Acto II: Puta Traumada (Short Film/Visual Album)
original_title: La Loca de los Sueños | Acto II: Puta Traumada (Short Film/Visual Album)

title: The Clash of Nations: Joe Louis vs. Max Schmeling
original_title: The Clash of Nations: Joe Louis vs. Max Schmeling
overview: Follows the parallel lives and careers of American Joe Louis and German Max Schmeling as they overcome social and political obstacles while hurtling on a collision course to two historic matchups in the ring, and a pivotal place in history.

title: Aparição

title: Pickleball
overview: When foreclosure threatens their community center, Father Joseph rallies his late friend’s sons into an underdog pickleball team for a $100,000 tournament—against a cocky tennis legend determined to seize the courts and steal the spotlight.

title: Every Detail
overview: One day, Jiang Xiaobai and his mother—who had fled their home years ago to escape the debt collectors from loan sharks—received news that his father, Jiang Daming, had suddenly passed away from an acute illness, leaving behind a substantial insurance payout. Chen Hao, an old friend of the deceased who came to break the news, along with Wang Cici, a livestreamer who sells funeral products, then joined Xiaobai on a journey from Beijing to Changsha to claim the compensation.

title: Be Hippie – Made in Poland
overview: What does it mean to be a “HIPPIE”?  In the road movie ”Be Hippie – Made in Poland“, Ronald and Tomek set out in search of Poland’s last remaining hippies and explore what defines the essence of a hippie.  The ideals and ideas of that era reflect a hopeful and mindful approach to people and nature.

title: This Is Horror
overview: Yulia works as a florist in a flower shop, and since the beginning of the war, "Horror" - a faceless fear of death-has returned to her, forcing her to almost never leave her apartment, losing in her anxieties.  Everything changes when Yura, her childhood friend, arrives, they begin to develop feelings for each other. However, this illusion shatters when Yura admits that, in just a few days, he will be heading to the front line, as it is the only way to fulfill his greatest wish - to return home.

title: Skylark
overview: Post-Soviet border demarcations in Central Asia fuel lasting territorial conflicts. Centered on Kyrgyz teen Abek’s coming-of-age, the story unfolds in a village near the Tajik border, where he was brought up by his grandmother Ene.After her death, Abek tries to inter her beside his grandfather, whose grave now lies across the redrawn frontier in Tajikistan. Amid local folklore and persistent border tensions, his tomb-seeking journey unveils lingering historical wounds plaguing Central Asian borderlands.

title: Under Your Skin
overview: Ever since Gabe moved away, Evelyn has been desperate to hang out with him again. But he's changed... Will she be able to handle it?

title: Jindagi Once More
overview: A son discovers the legend his father once was, and sets out to bring him back.

title: Her First Taste
overview: Wen Yuwen, a cute and naive high school girl, loves Chinese far more than math. She tentatively steps into billiard halls, clothing stores and hotels — places of the adult world. She also begins to confront growing pains: relationships with the opposite sex, studying abroad, and her father’s infidelity. Confused yet brave at times, she embarks on a stumbling adventure of youth.

title: Strangers in the Mountain
overview: In the 1990s, two police officers ventured into the mountains along Zhejiang's Shanxi Stream to track down a suspect from an old case. As they dug deeper into the past, long-buried memories resurfaced, stirring poignant recollections among everyone involved about Zhang Xue, the person who had gone missing.

title: Cruising Lesbiana
overview: Select characters from Barcelona's flinta community sit in a driving car and and talk about cruising, desire and different forms of spaces. Rough HDV material and selected images draw on the city of Barcelona and a fictional narrative of a cab driver who explores various forms of cruising areas, creating an experimental docu-fiction narrative.

title: Method Cowboy
overview: When a struggling actor feigns being gay to land the role of a lifetime in an Oscar-bait Cowboy Western, he decides to transform himself for the role, blurring the lines between reality and performance.

title: TƎMPEST

title: Mesdames Thanh Sắc

Though she rises through Madame Sắc’s ranks to become one of Saigon’s most celebrated dancers in the 1960s, Cầm Thanh longs to break free from her patron’s control. As their ambitions and desires collide, the two women become locked in a tense power struggle that sets off a series of shocking and far-reaching events.

title: Loves Company
overview: Washed-up TV guest star Blake de Troy is rescued after a car crash by his devoted fan, Antoinette Funk, who lives in the Florida Everglades. Believing he's been kidnapped, Blake initially tries to escape, but after the death of his life partner and manager, Jimmy, he realizes he has nowhere else to go and begins exploiting the situation as a potential publicity stunt. Their increasingly dysfunctional arrangement spirals into a dark comedy about celebrity, loneliness, obsession, and fandom.

title: I Cover Memories

title: The Bait

title: Chinna Chinna Aasai
overview: On the enchanting shores of Varanasi, two souls meet by chance. Somewhere within this unfolding chaos, an unspoken bond begins to form, slowly slipping beyond friendship.

title: Unidentified
