title: Magical Secret Tour
original_title: マジカル・シークレット・ツアー
overview: A mother of two who suddenly learns of her husband’s embezzlement and crushing debts; a researcher buried in debt; and an unmarried, pregnant woman with no savings. Three women who seem to have nothing to do with crime cross paths by chance and, through gold smuggling, form an unexpected bond as partners in crime. As they seize money and freedom, a revenge game begins—one that allows each of them to reclaim and rebuild their lives. The sight of women who have long gone with the flow of life, choosing to take their fate into their own hands even if it means crossing the line into crime, shines with a dazzling intensity.

title: I am Jit Bahadur
overview: Jit Bahadur’s journey from a struggling dreamer to a celebrated actor reveals the harsh price of fame, as his relentless ambition gradually distances him from the very family that once supported him.

title: Cat House
overview: A long-overdue reunion between two friends spirals into a confrontation with a childhood secret that refuses to stay buried.

title: Peace Corps
overview: Drifting directionlessly around her hometown after unexpectedly being dismissed early from a stint in the Peace Corps, a 30-year-old Asian American woman butts heads with her mother, goes on an ill-advised date with a figure from her past, and ruminates on the meaning of her life.

title: Static
overview: A rising 2000’s Rock band’s breakout night unravels while fractured memories expose the truth.

title: You Are the Film
overview: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

title: Abhhiman
overview: An emotionally layered drama about memory, legacy, and the cost of love, set against the haunting world of music and cinema.

title: Mystic Stylez
overview: A struggling rapper performs an occult ritual to climb the ladder of the Memphis hip hop scene, only to find himself haunted by sinister forces that begin to twist his reality.

title: Love in Old York
overview: A bored student, trapped in a black and white world finds unexpected colour, when he meets his true love.

title: Deewana
overview: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

title: Chaali Din
overview: Chaali Din is an adaption of best selling punjabi novel of the same name. This gripping story by Gurpreet Dhugga delves into the complexities of human emotions and relationships over a transformative 40-day journey. The book explores themes of love, loss, redemption, and self-discovery through vivid storytelling and well-drawn characters. With its gripping narrative and profound insights, this work captures the essence of life’s challenges and triumphs.

title: Natural Balance
overview: A film student obsessed with making a movie about loneliness grabs his camera and sets out chasing old men. It seems he finally manages to catch up with one of them.

title: Goodbye My Car
overview: A veteran movie star faces a career crisis after a misinterpreted remark sparks public backlash and scrutiny over his driving and reputation.

title: Effi o Blaenau
overview: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

title: The Pink Funeral
overview: A transgender Chinese girl on the brink of crossing over to the afterlife embarks on a comedic struggle back on Earth to ensure the proper burial of her body, ultimately leading to a profound reconciliation with her mother and acceptance of her true identity.

title: Coo Coo Quark Quark
overview: A group of young people born in or after 1995 from Hangzhou set out on a quest for a cherished item they lost in their childhood, a journey that unexpectedly changed their lives in the process.

title: Wishful Thinking
overview: Woo-joo, who makes movies, and Hee-chan, who writes poetry. Finding a house that they can live in is not easy.

title: Magical Girl Mr. Kim
overview: A male actor who voices a beautiful anime character named Genie suddenly becomes the target of an obsessed fan's romantic delusions.

title: INDEPENDIENTE
overview: Three Mexican filmmakers — Max del Río, Gabriela Ivette Sandoval, and Hugo Villaseñor Alcázar — share their processes and challenges around a single question: How can an independent film get seen? Through the eyes of insiders, the documentary reveals the complex journey behind making cinema visible in Mexico.

title: For You
overview: The near future of the outbreak of the new HIV virus. One day Seong-han, who has a child through artificial insemination, visits Young-sook after being called by her.

title: Standby, Mom
overview: Yeon-ju follows her on set as manager of her daughter Lia, who is a child actor. When the actress who plays Lia's mother flake, Yeon-ju suddenly acts as a substitute. However, She has camera phobia.

title: A Lesson in Repetition
overview: Jaehyun, a high school freshman, visits the teacher's counseling room to take the baseball team selection test.

title: Bootstrapped
overview: A time travel conundrum plays out in one minute.

title: My Aunt
overview: Sunhee, who runs a modest animal clinic, is fostering a puppy whose owner never returned. Out of the blue, the niece she had raised as her own shows up after ten years, only to announce that she is leaving for New Zealand the very next day.

title: ave HRUBÁ
overview: Poet, performer, and local legend Eva Hrubá is a woman of contradictions, sparking both devotion and public outcry. This documentary dives into her dual existence of vibrant joy and silent suffering. Moving beyond her reputation as the  "eccentric lady on a purple bike," the film explores how she transforms loneliness into art and pain into a shared celebration of life. The film explores the world of a remarkable woman, seeking the boundary between her persona as an author and her performance.

title: On the Board
overview: Dojin is particularly nervous ahead of a Go competition with her close friend Se-kyung. Se-kyung is nervous, too.

title: Alive
overview: After coming face to face with death, 40-year-old Nora is consumed by an urgent need to feel alive. She dives into passionate relationships with two very different men, Tom and Max, whose opposing natures reflect her own inner conflict. But when neither can fill the void, Nora is forced to face the truth, she will have to confront a deeper fear driving her hunger for life.

title: The Chattanooga Syndrome - NOCLIP 3
overview: In this meta found-footage / documentary escapade, Gavin and Alex head to Tennessee to document the premiere of their previous film, and to follow a tip that will lead them to the most liminal spaces in Chattanooga...

title: Black Men in Uniform
original_title: Black Men in Uniform: The Untold Story
overview: Pata Seca  (1828), a man whose back bore the whip marks of his enslavers , whose eyes held the haunted memory of being forced to breed over 200 slave children in order to sustain his master’s plantation.  Men broken but unbowed, transformed from field hands into soldiers from the civil war to Vietnam.  This documentary weaves together authentic narratives from the 1800s, accompanied by original images and footage, highlighting the significant influence that Black men in uniform had in Hollywood and addressing ongoing relevant issues to date.

title: Nooru Sami
overview: Selvi, a widowed mother, devotes her life to raising her two sons in a conservative village. Years later, unfulfilled life comes back into focus, challenging deep-rooted traditions. As family and society strongly oppose change, Selvi must choose between societal expectations and her own happiness.

title: Goodbye to All That
overview: In a dusty apartment, Gabo mourns the end of a difficult relationship. Soon, reality gives way to a dreamlike delirium…

title: Stepfather
overview: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

title: Four Itchy Boys
overview: Four young men quarantined for a unexplainable, unrelenting itch prepare for a live-stream press event to prove they’re not the monsters the world believes them to be. But behind the scenes, a ruthless producer is plotting a more grotesque spectacle.

title: Kid Vereje
overview: Kid Vereje was a Spanish amateur boxing champion. Fast, accurate and unbeatable, he mastered the art of resistance in the ring. But outside it, the real fight was always against an invisible pain: having had a loveless childhood. He grew up losing rounds against silence, loneliness and abandonment. During his teens he turned his rage into muscle, fear into determination, and pain into sacrifice. He became strong. The legend survived. Today, in the twilight of his life, this old champion is facing an unexpected fight.

title: West by Northwest
overview: The film interweaves three RV travel stories across China, exploring themes of family connection, generational conflict, and finding closure among different age groups facing life's emotional and existential challenges.

title: Our Effed Up World
overview: Sheri thought her biggest problem in life was dealing with the recent loss of her beloved grandma.  But when a mysterious entity crash lands in the woods, only she and her group of shitkicker friends are what stands in the way of an insatiable, intergalactic hunger.

title: Synthetic Sincerity
overview: Marc Isaacs makes a deal with The Synthetic Sincerity Lab, an AI research project affiliated with the University of Southern England. There, researchers are investigating the possibility of teaching AI characters authenticity, using characters from Isaacs’ documentaries to do so. In return, they allow Isaacs to film the process.

title: Flood
overview: A filmmaker revisits her evangelical roots to find connection with her estranged father.

title: In Search of Stolen Time
original_title: Auf der Suche nach der gestohlenen Zeit
overview: «Time is money» is an oft-repeated expression in our modern performance-oriented society. But how does it affect us as individuals, and influence our society? Director Konrad Wakolbinger deconstructs this common and unquestioned concept, and shows, with subtle humor, how our understanding of time, work, and their interdependence has changed over the centuries.

title: Love & Other Crimes
overview: Noah Thomas's life takes a dangerous turn when a chance reunion with an old high school friend entangles him in a ruthless crime ring. As he falls deeper into the syndicate's violent world, his budding romance with Shaye Matthews offers a fragile glimmer of hope. Torn between love and survival, Noah must navigate betrayals, escalating stakes, and deadly choices that threaten to destroy everything he values.

title: Peter Asher: Everywhere Man
overview: Peter Asher’s extraordinary life has intersected with some of the greatest artists and musical moments of the last six decades. A child actor who became a pop star and then a manager and producer to the likes of James Taylor and Linda Ronstadt, he is a Zelig-like figure who remains a vital creative force to this day. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Carole King, and many more.

title: Chuckle Chuckle
overview: Aiming to become comedians, Sahara and his comedy partner Setoguchi work together on their act, "Ultrasweet Sourpork", until unfortunate circumstances lead to their disbandment. Hindered by roadblocks on the path to success, Sahara suddenly encounters an "ideal" version of himself—an ultra-famous comedian. Boasting rich knowledge for success as a comedian, this "ideal" Sahara begins meddling with the real Sahara's life.

title: Transfer Trimurthulu
overview: Fearless cop Trimurthulu's chance find drags him into a web of conspiracy. Standing alone against influential enemies who will stop at nothing, he risks everything to expose the truth and deliver justice.

title: Benigno
overview: There are people who spend their entire lives in the same house, their childhood home where their family history rests. Benigno, at eighty-eight years old, still sleeps, eats, and dreams in the home where he was born, the home that is rooted in the earth to reach for the sky. The house stands alone, alongside Benigno and his tortoise Totó, adrift in the limbo of memories, the ritual of daily life, and the anticipation of the final day. Adjacent to the house is his vegetable garden, which he visits daily to tend to his chickens and work the soil with the seeds inherited from his ancestors, which he ceremoniously catalogs and preserves.

title: Bittersuite
overview: During a wedding at a hotel, Bety, a young receptionist, becomes intrigued by Vicki, a mysterious older guest. The night lures them to the pool, the tension builds, and everything ends with an unexpected disappearance.

title: Deadbeat
overview: Journey into the lives of Father's fighting to be with their children. As they face an uphill battle against a biased system pushing a Fatherless agenda. Wrongfully Accused, False Accusations, Child Support and Meritless Restraining Orders

title: FUNHOUSE
overview: Freya is a fun, extroverted party-goer like most uni students. When she’s invited to a night out with her friends, she’s determined to go. But as she gets ready, her Body Dysmorphic Disorder takes over and sends her down a spiral of compulsions, making it harder and harder to leave.

title: The Americans Are Coming!
overview: An American filmmaker comes to a Romanian village to make a documentary about a forgotten Cold War story.

title: Copyright infringement
overview: A group of teens are trying to make a horror short film for a summer class but they cant get it right.

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Seducing My Hockey Rival
overview: Connor loses everything when his curling team disbands. His girlfriend, Ivy, dumps him. She leaves him for Hunter Strand. Hunter is a billionaire hockey captain. Connor blames Hunter for his ruin. He devises a revenge scheme. He joins Hunter's hockey world. Connor plans to seduce Hunter. This will sabotage the engagement. Connor insists he is straight. His clumsy seduction attempts create intense tension. Soon, fake attraction becomes real love. Ivy discovers the original plot. She successfully breaks them apart. Connor makes a dramatic confession. Hunter forgives him. They reconcile and choose love over societal expectations.

title: Node
overview: A poignant exploration of childhood illness, resilience, and family.

title: The Deep Vessel
overview: When a folk band struggles completing their sophomore album, they summon a Norse god to help them finish it.

title: Symbiosis
overview: A weekend reunion at an isolated house turns sinister when old friends realise their host, and the house itself, may want more than their company.

title: It's My Time
overview: Grandma Zhao Yanhong, whose mental state is "30 years ahead of her age," refuses to admit defeat, is fearless, and loves to cause trouble! After meeting the genius but ultimately useless Wu Youwei, who "would rather lie down than sit," she becomes involved with the Rubik's Cube, and together with her mentor, best friend, and family, stumbles and bravely ventures into the "Rubik's Cube world"! What kind of magic will she achieve after picking up a Rubik's Cube at 70? What bizarre opponents and chaotic unexpected events will she encounter...?

title: Citizen Vigilante
overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

title: Invictus
overview: In both work and life, Liu Hao had always been the one looked down upon. That is, until he met Cai Cai—two young souls who fell deeply in love. Just as they were brimming with confidence, ready to embark on a bright future, a sudden accident overturned their lives completely. Faced with a cruel world and a humiliating existence, they chose divergent paths of resistance...

title: The Vacation Begins
original_title: バカンスは始まったばかり
overview: The beginning of summer. Yuka, who has just divorced Haruki after three years of marriage, goes on vacation to a seaside town with her best friend Shina and her boyfriend Dazai. Reunited with Dazai, who she was once in love with, after a long time, Yuka's feelings for him gradually begin to rekindle. Meanwhile, Shina is attracted to Tenma, a poet who lives in the seaside town. Unrequited feelings and a peaceful daily life. The vacation has only just begun.

title: Balan - The Boy
overview: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

title: The Tiger of the East
overview: Andrés, a young Chilean cowboy and self-taught musician decides to leave the town where he lives to fulfill his life's dream; become a real musician and play in Mexico. The desire to give a song of his authorship to the Northern Tigers band will be the impulse that finally leads him to undertake this important journey.

title: Cocktail 2
overview: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

A hopelessly dreamy young man, convinced that an evil corporation is behind all his failures, stumbles upon a turning point when his suspicious neighbor accidentally drops a mysterious business card. Seizing the moment, he finally sets out to confront the enemy he's always blamed for his misfortune.

title: Secert in the Box
overview: Remake and update on Au Yeung Ping Keung’s murder mystery after his death

title: I Know Who You Are
overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
overview: In 1910 London, independent-minded Katharine Hilbery defies her family's expectations of marriage to pursue a career in astronomy. But when her father pressures her into an unwanted engagement, her resolve is tested. Through new friendships—including a bold suffragette and a thoughtful editor—Katharine begins to question the limits placed on her by society, love, and tradition, ultimately searching for a path that is truly her own.

title: The Boy Who Counted Cars
overview: Have you ever felt incredibly alone in the world? Have you ever suspected that everything around you is unreal?  Ah Zhi is a strange young man who spends his spare time searching for evidence that this world is a virtual world. He spends his spare time searching for proof that this world is a virtual one, until the appearance of a quirky girl named Xiao Yi, who makes him almost give up on the search for the truth. Through the fast-igniting love between Ah Zhi and Xiao Yi, life seems so romantic and real. But is Xiao Yi an NPC in a virtual game or the perfect lover in real life, and can they live happily ever after in this world? ......

title: Hachazo
overview: A bachelor party becomes a mystery when the groom disappears without a trace.

title: Gainesville Takes to the Streets
overview: A docu short film captured at the "No Kings" protests in Gainesville, GA.

title: All of a Sudden
overview: Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of a nursing home in the Paris suburbs, defies convention by adopting the 'Humanitude' method despite her team’s resistance. Her encounter with Mari Morisaki, a terminally ill Japanese playwright, transforms her life. Together, they turn the facility into a symbol of resistance and humanity against the system’s limits.

title: The Experiment
overview: What if a man and a woman switch roles, and she decides to wash her honor by killing her husband?

title: Maddie's Secret
overview: Plucky dishwasher Maddie vaults into viral superstardom at a trendy food content company, but beneath her seemingly picture-perfect life, mounting professional pressures threaten to expose a dark secret from her past.

title: The Gilded Mirror
overview: The Gilded Mirror follows Charles Randolph, a once-renowned performer haunted by his wife’s death. When a young woman comes to audition for him, their encounter reveals a charade of illusion and obsession.

title: Shoot the People
overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
overview: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

title: Sizzler '77
overview: In the summer of 1977, a group of working girls are being coerced by a mysterious and sinister pimp Bossy Jim and his young partner Chaka, to become involved in a profit-share scheme.

title: The Prince of Nanawa
overview: On a bustling footbridge separating Argentina and Paraguay, where people traffic all kinds of things in a mix of Guarani and Spanish, we meet Angel. Over the course of the next ten years, Angel will have to make decisive choices for his future.

title: Under the Same Sun
overview: 1819. A young Spanish heir, a Chinese weaver, and a Haitian deserter struggle to find their place and humanity in the tense cultural crossroads of the colonial Caribbean. They embark on the ambitious endeavor of establishing a silk factory in the very heart of the island of Hispaniola.

title: They Slay
overview: Longtime friends Raemee, Maggie and Lee come together for an annual Halloween hang-out at Lee’s house. Things are different this year when Maggie's new partner, Sam, and Lee’s younger sibling, Charlie, join the group. When they reignite their tradition of playing with a spirit board, they accidentally invite a supernatural being to join in the party. Uncomfortable truths rise to the surface and things take a dark turn, calling into question if the friendships will survive the night- or if the friends will survive at all.

title: Amala Dianor and Les Arts Florissants: Gesualdo Passione @ Nuits de Fourvière 2026
original_title: Amala Dianor et Les Arts Florissants : Gesualdo Passione Nuits de Fourvière 2026
overview: With their performance of “Gesualdo Passione” at the Nuits de Fourvière, choreographer Amala Dianor and Les Arts Florissants, conducted by Paul Agnew, strike up a dialogue between hip-hop dance and Baroque music that is as unexpected as it is captivating.

title: Gassed Up
overview: A day in the life of rap superstar, Clarence.

title: Jayamundhi Bhayamela Manasaa
overview: Follows three best friends on an 800-kilometer bicycle ride as they navigate friendship, self-discovery, and life's fears.

title: If You See the Buddha in the Road
original_title: If You See the Buddha in the Road
overview: Meditative diary film invoking reflection through low resolution

title: Huí Jiā
overview: An aging restaurant owner reflects on an old letter she once sent to her father in her homeland.

title: Death House
original_title: ផ្ទះស្នាក់អាស្រ័យ
overview: Khmer horror film.

title: Southern Fuel
overview: Across the American South, gas stations are more than pit stops. They are places to eat, gather, and share stories. Photographer Kate Medley explores how these everyday spaces sustain rural communities in North Carolina.

title: B.I.G - A World First
overview: On September 20, 2023, Jakob Schubert was able to climb “B.I.G.” (formerly known as “Project Big”) in Flatanger, Norway—one of the most demanding sport climbing routes in the world.  Originally bolted by Adam Ondra, the route remained a project for over a decade. After working on it together in 2022, Jakob returned the following year with a new idea: attempting the climb while livestreaming my tries.  “B.I.G. – A World First” documents this journey—capturing not only the ascent itself, but also the mental side of pushing Jakob’s limits on a route that once felt impossible.

title: Crossed Wires
overview: Alone on a battlefield far from home, a young soldier is close to death - until he gets a mysterious phone call...

title: Chapters of Presence
overview: An experimental dance film set in Brittany, France, it follows two dancers going through different phases of their presence and emotional state. The film was created in collaboration with choreographer Teresa CUROTTI and was realized during a self-organized week-long residency.

title: Léonie
overview: Léonie, a young artist, goes to the museum to practice her drawing. Meanwhile, the paintings about wilderness seem to change her...

title: her MAGNUM OPUS
overview: A photographer struggling with a growing sense of loss begins to lose faith in both his craft and the city he once loved. Wandering through Jeddah in search of the feeling he used to find within it

title: Scene 13
overview: Three friends shoot a film in the woods. They’re not the only ones filming.

title: Geraldine Hickey: Of Course We've Got Horses
original_title: Geraldine Hickey: Of Course We've Got Horses
overview: In her hit 2023 show Of Course We’ve Got Horses, Geraldine Hickey reflects on new‑found privileges like getting married, owning horses and buying a very nice camera for bird photography. (Okay, technically the horses belong to her wife Cath… and one of them is a pony. But as they say, what’s mine is yours.)

title: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu
overview: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.

title: Yutkunmak
overview: After years of marital abuse, a woman celebrates her husband's fatal car crash with a quiet dinner. However, a second phone call from the hospital announces a medical miracle, instantly crushing her newly found sense of freedom.

title: Blind spot
overview: After committing an irreparable act, a young deaf man seeks oblivion by isolating himself in a country house. As he resumes his normal life, paranormal phenomena begin to haunt his daily existence.

title: Im Himmel Verschwunden
overview: After her boyfriend’s mysterious disappearance, Amelie confides in her therapist that she believes he is still alive, after receiving strange signs from the sky.

title: ROH Global Wars - Cincinatti
overview: ROH x CMLL x Stardom Global Wars, promoted as Global Wars Cincinnati was a professional wrestling event produced and co-promoted by the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH), the Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL), and the Japanese women's wrestling promotion World Wonder Ring Stardom (Stardom). It was the 23rd Global Wars event and took place on June 10 and June 11, 2026 at the Andrew J. Brady Music Center in Cincinnati, Ohio and aired on June 18, 2026 and part two aired on June 25, 2026 as a special episode of Ring of Honor Wrestling.

title: Menarca
overview: As Lia, a quiet and shy preteen, begins to experience unexpected changes in her body, what initially seems like just another stage of growing up soon takes on new dimensions. Amid discoveries and transformations, her transition into adolescence transcends the boundaries of the ordinary as it takes on supernatural proportions: Lia is becoming a vampire.

title: Maiin Haan
overview: Inspired by true events from 2007, Main Haan follows Seerat, a young woman haunted by an unseen presence after moving to Delhi. As terrifying incidents escalate, a shocking truth emerges—a restless spirit is using her to reveal an unfinished story connected to Sarab, the man she loves.

title: Confined
overview: The story of a gang put together by a crime boss in order to pull off a heist. It all seems to be going well, until it’s not. The crew gets broken up after the heist due to external circumstances, and upon reuniting, there is undeniable tension between the men. They are confined to a hideout in a remote location, waiting to hear from the boss. But the question is - how long will they be able to trust each other?

title: We're Close
overview: A simple phone call between two friends.

title: Frashah Meshmesh
overview: When Meshari reunites with his former friends, he learns they’ve stolen a car, unaware that it belongs to his father.

title: The Sun Comes Up
overview: Amidst the suffocating isolation of a prolonged COVID lockdown as a single mother, Caitlin struggles to find hope.

title: Les Heures Mortes
overview: Camel, 20 years old, stifled by the violence of his social condition and his factory job, one day unintentionally triggers a global shutdown with a single sentence he utters. He nevertheless meets a girl his own age, unlike any other, who will offer him answers and a day outside of time that he will be forced to forget forever.

title: Rusty Bearclaw and The Rucket List
original_title: Rusty Bearclaw and The Rucket List
overview: An LDS teenager receives his call to serve a mission for his church. Realizing he doesn't have long before he leaves for two years, he creates a "pre-mission bucket list" to complete alongside his two idiotic best friends.

title: Original Night
overview: Told in two semi-fictional acts, this 16mm film serves as an elegy for Europe’s last wallabies — a marsupial animal from Australia, introduced in Scotland in the 1940s. Reflecting on humanity’s enduring urge to record animals, from prehistoric cave art to early cinema, Alasdair Asmussen Doyle links the extinction of species with the evolution of image-making.

title: X-Ray Katx
overview: Bradley Eros companion piece to X-Ray Eros.

title: Honey, I’m Home
overview: An abnormal world seen through the eyes of a psychotic. All on video.

title: Les Dreamables
overview: A film about a guy struggling with Les Dreamables.

title: Back To Black
overview: A young woman, unable to move on from a failed relationship, spirals into depression, drugs, and alcohol.  Haunted by memories of the man she once loved, she struggles to escape the past that continues to consume her.  Desperate for answers, she seeks him out, only to uncover a devastating truth he has been hiding from her all along.  But once she learns the truth, she makes a choice that can never be undone

title: Entre o Sucesso e a Lama
original_title: Entre o Sucesso e a Lama

title: The Light We Carry
overview: A young woman is offered the gift of light by her grandmother. The gift has been in her family for generations. But can she accept it?

title: Cantuta: La Orden Secreta
overview: A journalist receives a clandestine confession from a former agent of the Colina Group, who reveals the secrets behind the La Cantuta disappearances and the brutal war against terrorism that shook Peru in the 1990s.

title: Dan Mintz: Well Rounded Entertainer
overview: Best known as the voice of Tina Belcher on Bob's Burgers, Dan Mintz began his career doing standup comedy, and is now releasing his first full-length special only 27 years later. Recorded live at Dynasty Typewriter in Los Angeles, Dan Mintz: Well Rounded Entertainer was then animated by the team behind Bob's Burgers, bringing to life Dan's deadpan one-liners with vivid colors and surreal animated bits.

title: Roadkill
overview: An unknown man is on the loose, murdering people and leaving them on the side of the road. You must be careful when driving, or you could be next.

title: Thank You Subbarao
overview: An accidental recording reveals a chilling crime, pushing Vaishnavi into a dangerous fight for truth and justice.

title: From Hope to Home: The Obama Presidential Center
original_title: From Hope to Home: The Obama Presidential Center
overview: The Obama Presidential Center's star-studded grand opening ceremony brings a slew of celebrities and dignitaries to Chicago for the big event.  The festivities feature what organizers said would be "legendary performances by global icons and powerful remarks from today's most prominent voices."  Bruce Springsteen, Stevie Wonder, Christina Aguilera, John Legend and Bono are just some of the many big names slated to perform.

title: Wills Home Movies
overview: Home movies are immortal through moments frozen in time but also forever changing as our life evolves and our perspectives shift. The further you look back the harder it becomes to find what you once were, but home movies can act as a reminder of the pieces of your life that have made you what you are. This film is an honest snapshot of my life, but its core is rooted in universal life experiences that anyone can find glimpses of themselves in.

title: Hala! Naiwan Si Rocky!
overview: A chance reunion during a ride from Manila to Atimonan, Quezon forces three estranged friends to confront buried wounds, lingering guilt, and the unspoken truths that drove them apart years ago.

title: Free Lyric
overview: Set against the rise of social media, Free Lyric revisits one of rap culture’s earliest viral moments: the public shaming of a 17-year-old female rapper after a sexual confession spreads online. Through Niki’s story, the film explores gender, consent, and the early roots of online call-out culture.

title: Bem bolado
overview: An unexpected encounter breaks the routine and awakens a desire impossible to silence. In vertical format, the film follows two young women who, between tension and curiosity, cross the line between control and surrender, revealing the intensity of a sapphic romance that is born in the moment and asserts itself without warning.

title: Les abeilles ne sont pas encore mortes.
original_title: Les abeilles ne sont pas encore mortes.
overview: After receiving devastating news one morning, Esther, a silent young girl, goes through her daily routine while a darker reality gradually unfolds.

title: Everyone Gets Bored of Everything
overview: A young girl loses her job, prompting a day of mundane and surprisingly deep conversations.

title: Anna Reads for Delilah
overview: An actor shows up for the last audition of the day; the director's last chance to get the performance he wants.

title: Anna is Still Reading for Delilah
original_title: Anna még mindig a Delilah szerepre készülődik
overview: An actor refuses to let her audition end until she gets the line just right.

title: Panda & Peanut
overview: It's Thursday morning, and siblings Hubie and Valentina must get through their shared birthday while navigating money problems, purpose, and their ever-changing relationship as Val enters the next stage of her life.

title: Shine As You Are
overview: A feature-length documentary that explores the lived experiences of the LGBTQIAPN+ community in Goiás through intimate accounts of identity, belonging, and resistance. The film examines the shared threads that connect these personal journeys, as well as the challenges imposed by prejudice and invisibility. Through stories of love, resilience, and confrontation, the documentary celebrates the unique light of each individual and the collective power of existing, belonging, and claiming space within the city.

title: Meet Me in the Margins
overview: A book editor secretly pens her own romance manuscript, only to find unexpected editorial notes from a mysterious critic in the margins. The film is a witty, heartwarming story about finding love between the lines.

title: Double meurtre pour la danseuse
overview: Student film using film noir codes.

title: Slackers
overview: A slingshot is loaded, the stone flies and crashes - the neighbor's window breaks. Ramona and Nico are friends, lazy bums and fresh out of school. But instead of thinking about their future, they prefer to let the hot Berlin summer get the better of them. When they release a beloved neighbor's bird, they have to flee - into the politically charged world that they really don't want to be in. A road trip through Berlin begins - but on foot.

title: Batik, Beats & Bumbu
overview: A film about third-generation artists with Indonesian roots who embrace their cultural heritage in their work.  Director Claire Pijman portrays Nusantara Beat, the popular band that sings in Bahasa Indonesia and Sundanese. Vanja van der Leeden, a culinary artist who looks beyond the ‘rijsttafel’. Myrthe Groot & Romee Mulder of fashion atelier Guave, who design clothing made from batik. And Sekan, DJ / photographer / founder of record label Jiwa2, who is putting Indonesian pop music from the ’70s and ’80s back on the map. All artists collaborate with artists from Indonesia, allowing the viewer to also be taken into present-day Indonesia.

title: SHADOW TOWN: IS AIT AN MAC AN SAOL
original_title: SHADOW TOWN: IS AIT AN MAC AN SAOL
overview: A rural town in Ireland swells to a population of half a million for one week during the world’s largest annual celebration of Irish music, transforming it into a major metropolis of culture, diversity and decadence.

title: Each Other
overview: Enemies at school. friends at home. Two brothers navigate childhood with and without each other.

title: Sumpa Kingdom
overview: Raised in inland China, the protagonist Yangqing Lamu meets Baima, a young local guide, during an accidental trip to the plateau. The two travel deep into pastoral grasslands, embarking on a spiritual exploration of marriage, life and death, and morality amid the conflicts between dreams and reality, tradition and individuality. In the end, she achieves a profound reconciliation with both her homeland and her inner self in the vast wilderness.

title: Tristán and the Days to Come
original_title: Tristán y los días por venir
overview: Tristán is navigating his teenage years in an exceptional way: navigating his gender transition alongside his mum Virginia, his friends, his school and the Argentine State, whilst discovering his passion for drawing. But when the pressures of adulthood begin to mount and a shift in the political landscape threatens his rights, he is faced with a question: is it possible to be trans without suffering so much?

title: Modem
overview: A digital detox vacation goes wrong when a teenager discovers a MODEM.

title: You Can't Fly
overview: Follows Matt Lewis, aka Silverback Tarzan, as he comes to terms with being grounded following a near fatal hang-gliding accident. For someone with as much energy and “seize the day” drive as Tarzan, this isn’t easy, but, with the support of his loving partner Tara, Tarzan’s almost aggressive positivity wins through.

title: Cassowary
overview: Three generations of women — grandmother, mother and daughter — live in a house on a remote island. The grandmother remains silent all day long, while the mother drowns her sorrows in alcohol. The younger brother never truly grows up. The daughter Su Min chooses to leave and works as a bird scarer at an airport. After a fire breaks out at home, she returns to the island with tangled emotions. The arrival of a mysterious fire-eating bird shatters the long-standing peace, gradually unearthing the family’s long-buried secrets and repressed feelings.

title: All in light ebbed aside
original_title: Ogni cosa nella luce si ritrae
overview: Started as a filmdiary, “Ogni cosa nella luce si ritrae” is an attempt at assembling all the footage shot over the course of thirteen months through a logic capable of showing both its intimacy and distance. A hendiadys turned towards its incompleteness, towards the margin itself (here, each time: the film leader, the cut that links and separates the images), always and yet never entirely continuous/discontinuous, at the same time.

title: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
original_title: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
overview: After his hit show "GOAT," Ge Pamungkas is back with fresh material — exploring love, marriage and the battle of the sexes in this comedy special.

title: ELEFANTE
overview: Maria reunites with her friend Eliza after a long time, however, the discomfort and tension between them quickly grow when the topic of Eliza's pregnancy comes up.

title: This party is DEAD
overview: When responsible Alice, superficial Sofie, crazy Hanka, and insecure Roman head out to a Halloween party, they have no idea that a night of madness and chaos is about to begin. A chain of arguments, embarrassing moments, and bad decisions quickly spirals out of control, leading to absurd and wild situations involving zombies, police officers, and frustrated romantic comedy actors. On her mission to rescue her younger sister Kristýna, Alice discovers that the real danger lies not so much in the zombies as in mutual prejudices and poor role models.

title: Nowhere Coast
overview: a man visits his ex-lover who is suffering from symptoms of early onset dementia

title: Here the Whole Time
overview: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

title: Arborea
overview: In a near future, vegetation has mysteriously stopped reproducing.  A scientist monitors the sound frequencies of an oak tree, until one day she hears a new sound.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: METILNATOR I
overview: After a serious accident, Metil dies, but his brother decides to turn him into a cyborg. Following a psychotic episode, Metilnator kills his brother and embarks on a quest for revenge against an unexpected figure.

title: Saat Aku Bersuara
overview: Nadia, a bright young lawyer, finds her life shattered when her wedding is canceled at the last second. But that bitterness did not make him submit. She rose up and dedicated herself to defending women's rights. Together with her two friends, Andien and Riana, and Adrian, a Public Prosecutor who is an important part of her journey, Nadia struggles to rebuild her life, including her broken relationship with her father. As the wounds of the past slowly find their way, Nadia becomes increasingly convinced that as long as she dares to speak out and doesn't give up, hope will never be extinguished.

title: Una directora Extraordinaria
overview: In December 2018, Mónica, the principal of the Pehuajó National College, hands over the keys to the high school so the bathrooms can be renovated. The work is delayed, and classes begin with portable toilets. One day, the architect disappears. Mónica must fight against bureaucracy and maintain order at the school. The students will join her in her struggle. The film is inspired by a true story.

title: Tracing Paper
overview: Follow the preservation of vintage paper through past, present, and future.

title: Atlantic Rhapsody
overview: Ding Mao, a supermarket employee, accidentally cooks the ornamental shark kept in the store. Soon after, he starts hearing a strange voice. Travelling from a southern city to the wilds of Northeast China, he sets out to trace his father’s whereabouts. During this journey, he pieces together his father’s bizarre life through an abandoned amusement park, a zoo in winter, and the supermarket where shark meat is sold. A quirky experimental musician, a blind fortune-teller who can understand animal language, a trainer whose legs were bitten off by a shark, and a female picture book painter — guided by the mysterious voice, all these souls become intertwined.

title: On a Stringer
overview: At noon, in the shade of riverside trees — as if in the middle of life — you lose something. Yet love is as strong as the river. A man is going through abrupt changes in his life — both personal and caused by the war. He spends a day alone by the river, revisiting a forgotten hobby — fishing. A sense of love and acceptance fills him, but only for a brief moment — he must return to the war.

title: Kill your Darlings
overview: Alan is presented with a unique opportunity by a mysterious woman. But what seems to be a satisfaction of his darkest desires escalates in a way he couldn’t have seen coming…

title: ترايثليت
overview: A triathlete living and training in Al-Naseem district, exploring how the sport becomes more than just competition, but a way of life built on discipline, endurance, and commitment. Through his daily routine and personal journey, the film highlights the challenges of pursuing an intense sport while balancing everyday life, offering a closer look at ambition and perseverance within an unexpected environment.

title: Secret of Kalinga
overview: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

title: vestige
overview: Returning to his old neighborhood before its demolition, Ahmed revisits  memories. As he wanders its streets, he recalls something that forever  changed the way he sees the place he once called home

title: Time In a Bottle
overview: After receiving the devastating news of his father’s death in reserve duty, Alon is mysteriously transported to a surreal room where he is given a device that allows him to travel back in time. Driven by grief and regret, Alon tries repeatedly to change the past and prevent his father from leaving, only to discover that some things cannot be changed-but they can be faced differently. A moving story about sacrifice, memory, and the power of a final goodbye.

title: The Matchmaker
overview: Amar is a creature of habit — quiet, solitary, and most at home among his matchboxes. So when a shy colleague at the match factory works up the courage to ask him out, his instinct isn’t to say yes. It isn’t even to say no. Instead, he decides to play matchmaker — steering her toward the charming regular at the village pub. A tidy solution. Except, of course, it isn’t.

title: Papa Terrible
overview: Musician Thijs embodies everything filmmaker Jeroen, by now a burnt-out father, seems to have lost: freedom, courage, and unconditional love. When Thijs announces that he is going to be a father, Jeroen decides to follow him during his preparation for fatherhood. As he observes Thijs, he also begins to re-examine his own life and get a grip on what fatherhood entails.

title: JACKPOT!
overview: When a young man hides the truth about his lottery ticket winnings from his friend, conflict erupts.

title: Two Times João Liberada
overview: João, an actress from Lisbon, as she stars in a biopic about Liberada, a gender-nonconforming figure persecuted by the Portuguese Inquisition in the 18th century. The film's production becomes a battleground as João clashes with the director over how Liberada’s legacy should be portrayed. These tensions deepen as João's dreams are increasingly haunted by Liberada's ghost, blurring the lines between past and present. When the director succumbs to a mysterious paralysis, leaving the film unfinished, João is left to navigate the unfolding chaos. She faces unanswerable questions, not only about the film's future but also about her own connection to Liberada’s spirit and story.

title: Two stories: In the same place
original_title: Dos historias: En un mismo lugar
overview: A compilation of the two "Explorador Anormal" and "Hecho realidad..." stories. Here, someone is cleaning up the folders on their Mac and discovers two mysterious videos.

title: Reminiscence of a Moviegoer
overview: For Reminiscence of a Moviegoer, filmmaker Christiane Büchner works extensive interviews with the late Werner Dütsch, a commissioning editor at the German television station WDR, and massively influential figure in postwar West German film culture, into a moving portrait of cinephilia through time.

title: Andy Lau “TODAY…is the Day” Hong Kong Concert Tour 2024/25
original_title: 刘德华《今天…is the Day》迴演唱會2024/2025 - 香港站
overview: This concert was professionally filmed for the Hong Kong show, as part of Andy Lau's most recent tour across 72 shows from 5th July 2024 to 10th January 2025

title: Canto da Gente: Um Filme Sobre os Tápes
original_title: Canto da Gente: Um Filme Sobre os Tápes
overview: Documentary about Brazilian folk music group Os Tápes.

title: Small Clouds
overview: Two siblings escape into a world of adventure aboard a broken ship—until growing up starts to pull them apart.

title: Traces of What Remains
overview: Full of tenderness and love, Selma and Nori look forward to their first child together and a future as a family. But one morning, Nori finds himself confused and injured in the park, with no memory of the last few hours. The mysterious circumstances surrounding his amnesia and a miscarriage put their relationship to the test.

title: GƎNƎSIS
overview: Eva, raised in an artificial Eden to obey the voice of a god who controls her, discovers a message revealing that her world is a carefully constructed lie. Driven by her need for freedom, she must challenge the system to escape the only place she has ever known.

title: Six Weeks On
overview: While the world is in lockdown as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, Lore has to cope with a painful loss: her mother has died. Back in the small town of Erkelenz in North Rhine-Westphalia, she struggles against entrenched family structures and a paralyzing bureaucracy. Above all, she has to find a way to come to terms with the death and say goodbye to her mother.

title: Night After Night
overview: A reclusive night guard at a private university investigates the circumstances surrounding a coworker’s disappearance and a secret room in which an ever changing entity reappears night after night.

title: Sergio e Mirta: Storia di un matrimonio in 8mm
original_title: Sergio e Mirta: Storia di un matrimonio in 8mm
overview: A classic found-footage film, revealing a story that would otherwise have been lost: the love between Sergio Corbucci and Mirta Guarnaschelli.

title: Cerita Lila

title: Remake

title: Superbuhei
overview: Jesse Bronske runs the melancholy bar Klaus Meine, navigating love, work, and paranoia while haunted by his twin, as daily life and risky plans spiral amid alcohol and obsession.

When her sister, too, is widowed while carrying a child and already raising three others, Zahide is compelled, against her will, to marry the surviving brother of her deceased husband. Bound by the constraints of their time, the two sisters come to share not only the same household but also the same destiny.  Their lives unfold as a profound testimony to the harshest realities imposed upon women, where personal desire yields to societal pressure, and survival necessitates the surrender of choice. This narrative portrays the endurance of two sisters navigating an oppressive system, their shared sorrow echoing the struggles of countless women silenced by history.

title: Return to the Moon (or Nothing)
overview: "For months we experimented and represented ourselves, starting with simple walks in search of material for a thesis. How can we visually recreate a memory? We walked and filmed, photographed and painted, got to know each other and told our stories. An experience transformed into a story that speaks of a shared journey, made up of filming, changes of season, conversations about the moon, and exchanges of techniques. Inspired by “Dark Side of the Moon,” we tried to represent the intimate and personal emotions that came to us through the album. Each song has a language, each movement a color, each sound an expression. What remains today, half a century later? Something inexplicable, perhaps. A wonderful creation of friendship and mutual artistic esteem, the (re)creation of multiple memories, which overlap like membranes on the screen. - Erik Negro

As in much of Menick’s work, the film links the history of technology with contemporary anxieties about artificial intelligence and the mechanization of creative labor.

title: Sunspots
overview: Jack, a young adult living in The Entrance, feels lonelier than ever. Consumed by his own overthought narrative, he releases an outburst on Instagram Live, declaring that he would leave town to never be seen again. Through his actions, the potential last day in The Entrance provides the challenges required to change his perspective.

title: Shroomery

The couple's initial curiosity leads to terror as the mushrooms take over their kitchen, minds, and ultimately bodies.

title: The Entwinement of Fate
overview: Su Kinadsusumpat nu Bagi (The Entwinement of Fate) follows siblings Aisha and Ali as they navigate grief and survival within their Moro community after the death of their parents. The only inheritance left behind is their father’s small tinagtag business—a Maguindanaon delicacy that becomes both their livelihood and their last connection to home.  Determined to preserve her father’s legacy, Aisha continues making and selling tinagtag. But as a young lady forced to take her mother’s roles, the burden of keeping the business alive slowly wears on her.  Meanwhile, Ali struggles with the weight of their circumstances. Torn between keeping his father’s memoir and moving forward with his dreams, he began to question whether holding onto tradition is worth the cost. As circumstances deepen, the siblings are forced to confront the grief they have long avoided, the fractures within their identity, and the fragile bond that continues to entwine them together.

title: Nizhal
